10: 				if ($(this).parents('tr.type-eb_course').hasClass('contains_enrolment')) {
11: 					containsEnrolment = true;

13: 				return (false === containsEnrolment);

16: 				return confirm(adminStrings.bulkTrashWarning);

163:     function wi_cf_set_pop_up_data(edit_obj)
164:     {

169:     	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-placeholder"]').val($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-placeholder').val());
170:     	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-class"]').val($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-class').val());

172: 	   	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-enabled"]').prop('checked', false);
173:     	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-required"]').prop('checked', false);
174:     	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-sync-moo"]').prop('checked', false);
175:     	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-woo-my-accnt"]').prop('checked', false);

177:        	if ($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-enabled').val() != 0) {
178: 	    	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-enabled"]').prop('checked', true);
179:     	}
180:     	if ($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-required').val() != 0) {
181: 	    	$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-required"]').prop('checked', true);
182:     	}
183:     	if ($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-sync-on-moodle').val() != 0) {
184:     		$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-sync-moo"]').prop('checked', true);
185:     	}
186:     	if ($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-woo-my-accnt').val() != 0) {
187:     		$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-woo-my-accnt"]').prop('checked', true);
188:     	} else {
189:     	}
190:     	if ($(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-edwiser-user-accnt').val() != 0) {
191:     		$('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-eb-user-accnt"]').prop('checked', true);
192:     	}

194:     		var options = $(parent_tr).find('.eb-wi-cf-tbl-options').val();
195:     		options = JSON.parse(options.replace(/\'/g, '"'));
196: 	    	if($('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').length){
197: 	    		$('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').removeClass('eb-wi-cf-hide');
198: 	    		var counter = 1;
199: 	    		$('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').each(function(index, element){
200: 	    			if(counter > 1){
201: 	    				$(element).remove();
202: 	    			}
203: 	    			counter++;
204: 	    		});
205: 	    		var counter = 0;
206: 				$.each(options, function(index, value) {
207: 	    			if (counter == 0) {
208: 			    		$('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').find('.eb-wi-cf-dialog-option-val').val(index);
209: 			    		$('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').find('.eb-wi-cf-dialog-option-txt').val(value);

267:     function wi_cf_get_pop_up_data()
268:     {
269: 	    data_array = {};
270:     	data_array['type']               = $('select[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-type"]').val();
271:     	data_array['name']               = $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-name"]').val();
272:     	data_array['label']              = $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-label"]').val();
273:     	data_array['placeholder']        = $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-placeholder"]').val();
274:     	data_array['default-val']        = $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-default-val"]').val();
275:     	data_array['class']              = $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-class"]').val();
276:     	data_array['enabled']            = 0;
277:     	data_array['required']           = 0;
278:     	data_array['sync-on-moodle']     = 0;
279:     	data_array['woo-my-accnt']       = 0;
280:     	data_array['edwiser-user-accnt'] = 0;
281:     	data_array['options']            = {};
282:     	if ('select' == data_array['type']) {
283: 	    	jQuery('.eb-wi-cf-pop-up-options-field').each(function(index, element){
284: 				data_array['options'][$(element).find('.eb-wi-cf-dialog-option-val').val()] = $(element).find('.eb-wi-cf-dialog-option-txt').val();
285: 			});
286:     		data_array['options'] = JSON.stringify(data_array['options'],null,0).replace(/\"/g, "'");
287:     	}
288:     	if( $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-enabled"]').prop("checked") == true ) {
289:     		data_array['enabled'] = 1;
290:     	}
291:     	if( $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-required"]').prop("checked") == true ) {
292:     		data_array['required'] = 1;
293:     	}
294:     	if( $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-sync-moo"]').prop("checked") == true ) {
295:     		data_array['sync-on-moodle'] = 1;
296:     	}
297:     	if( $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-woo-my-accnt"]').prop("checked") == true ) {
298:     		data_array['woo-my-accnt'] = 1;
299:     	}
300:     	if( $('input[name="eb-wi-cf-dialog-eb-user-accnt"]').prop("checked") == true ) {
301:     		data_array['edwiser-user-accnt'] = 1;
302:     	}
303:     	return data_array;
304:     }

 8: 	    	$( 'input:checkbox' ).each(function () {

12: 			});
13: 			if (jQuery( '#bridge_woo_synchronize_product_create' ).is( ':checked' ) === false && jQuery( '#bridge_woo_synchronize_product_update' ).is( ':checked' ) === false && jQuery( '#bridge_woo_synchronize_product_categories' ).is( ':checked' ) === false ) {
14: 				jQuery( '.response-box' ).append( '<div class="alert alert-error">' + bridge_woo_product_obj.select_least_option_message + '</div>' );
15: 				return;
16: 			}
17: 			else
18: 			{
19: 				$( '.load-response' ).show();

23: 					dataType: "json",

34: 			}
35: 	    });
36: 	});
37: })( jQuery );

188:             {
189:                 $.ajax({
190:                     method      : "post",
191:                     url         : admin_js_select_data.admin_ajax_path,

194:                         'action'           : 'all_users_sync',

199:                         'offset'           : offset,
200:                     },
201:                     success:function(response) {
202:                         if (response.data) {
203:                             var html       = '';
204:                             offset         = offset + response.data.processed_users;
205:                             /**
206:                              * added below line as the query result from the moodle has not removed the gurst user after removing the guest user from moodle result itself then remove this line
207:                              */
208:                             display_offset = display_offset + response.data.display_offset;
209:                             total_users    = response.data.total_users;
210:                             var msg        = response.data.msg;
211:                             if (response.success) {
212:                                 // offset is less than the total no. off users the start the loop.
213:                                 if (offset < total_users) {
214:                                     msg = '<div class="eb-ss-user-warning-msgs"><span class="dashicons dashicons-warning"></span> ' + admin_js_select_data.all_user_synch_warning + '</div>' + msg;
215:                                     //get count of no. of users processed and add them to the offset from the response and add it to the old count
216:                                     eb_ss_synch_all_users(create_users, link_users, display_offset, offset, total_users);
217:                                 } else {
218:                                     //show the link to the popup if any of the users linking or creation is failed.
219:                                     if (response.data.error) {
220:                                         $('.eb-ss-users-migration-error-tbl tbody').html(response.data.error_response);
221:                                     }
222:                                     $('body').css('cursor', 'default');
223:                                     $('.load-response').hide();
224:                                 }
225:                             } else {
226:                                 $('body').css('cursor', 'default');
227:                                 $('.load-response').hide();
228:                             }
229:                             $('.response-box').html(msg);
230:                         }
231:                     },
232:                     error: function(response){
233:                         alert(admin_js_select_data.ajax_error);
234:                     }
235:                 });
236:             }

271:     function updateDataTableSelectAllCtrl(table){
272:         var $table                  = table.table().node();
273:         var $chkbox_all             = $('tbody input[type="checkbox"]', $table);
274:         var $chkbox_checked         = $('tbody input[type="checkbox"]:checked', $table);
275:         var chkbox_select_all       = $('thead input[name="select_all_course"]', $table).get(0);
276:         var chkbox_select_all_foot  = $('tfoot input[name="select_all_course"]', $table).get(0);
277:        if($chkbox_checked.length === 0){
278:           chkbox_select_all.checked = false;
279:           chkbox_select_all_foot.checked = false;
280:           if('indeterminate' in chkbox_select_all){
281:              chkbox_select_all.indeterminate = false;
282:              chkbox_select_all_foot.indeterminate = false;
283:           }
284:        } else if ($chkbox_checked.length === $chkbox_all.length){
285:           chkbox_select_all.checked = true;
286:           chkbox_select_all_foot.checked = true;
287:           if('indeterminate' in chkbox_select_all){
288:              chkbox_select_all.indeterminate = false;
289:              chkbox_select_all_foot.indeterminate = false;
290:           }
291:        } else {
292:           chkbox_select_all.checked = true;
293:           chkbox_select_all_foot.checked = true;
294:           if('indeterminate' in chkbox_select_all){
295:              chkbox_select_all.indeterminate = true;
296:              chkbox_select_all_foot.indeterminate = true;
297:           }
298:        }
299:     }
300: })( jQuery );

433: 	/* This function send ajax request to save custom field data. */
434: 	function eb_cf_save_data(data_array, obj = false) {
435: 		$.ajax({
436: 			url: eb_custom_fields.ajax_url,
437: 			type: 'POST',
438: 			dataType: 'json',
439: 			data: {
440: 				'action': 'eb_cf_save_data',
441: 				'nonce': eb_custom_fields.nonce,
442: 				'data': data_array
443: 			},
444: 			success: function(response) {
445: 				if(response.status == 'success'){
446: 					if(obj == false){
447: 						eb_cf_create_new_row(data_array);
448: 					} else {
449: 						eb_cf_modify_existing_row(obj);
450: 					}
451: 					$('.eb-cf-loader').remove();
452: 					$('.eb-cf-dialog-btn').text(eb_custom_fields.dialog_success_btn);
453: 					setTimeout(function(){
454: 						$('.eb-cf-pop-up-cont').dialog("close");
455: 					}, 1000);
456: 				} else {
457: 					$('.eb_cf_delete_error_msg').css('display', 'block');
458: 					$('.eb_cf_error_msg').html(response.message);
459: 					$('.eb-cf-loader').remove();
460: 				}
461: 			}
462: 		});
463: 	}

1362: 			function enroll_csv_users_recursively(cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users) {
1363: 				offset = 5;
1364: 				if (processed_users + offset >= total) {
1365: 					offset = total - processed_users;
1366: 				}
1367: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_processed_users_count' ).html( processed_users );
1368: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_total_users_count' ).html( total );
1369: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_users_progress_percent' ).html( Math.round( processed_users * 100 / total ) + '%' );
1370: 				$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).show();
1371: 				$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
1372: 				jQuery.ajax(
1373: 					{
1374: 						type: 'POST',
1375: 						url: ebbpManageGroup.ajax_url,
1376: 						dataType: 'json',
1377: 						data: {
1378: 							action: 'create_wordpress_user',
1379: 							mdl_cohort_id: cohortId,
1380: 							cohortName: cohortName,
1381: 							firstname: return_set_of_array( firstname, processed_users, offset ),
1382: 							lastname: return_set_of_array( lastname, processed_users, offset ),
1383: 							email: return_set_of_array( email, processed_users, offset ),
1384: 							processed_users: processed_users,
1385: 							total: total,
1386: 							nonce_bp_enroll: ebbpManageGroup.nonce_bp_enroll,
1387: 						},
1388: 						success: function (response) {
1389: 							var data = response.data;
1390: 							if (response.success == true) {
1391: 								processed_users = processed_users + data.processed_users;
1392: 								if (processed_users < total) {
1393: 									enroll_csv_users_recursively( cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users );
1394: 								} else {
1395: 									jQuery( "#wdm_user_delete_msg" ).html( data.msg );
1396: 									$( "#wdm-eb-enroll-msg" ).css( "display", "none" );
1397: 									$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
1398: 									jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
1399: 									$( ".wdm_success_message" ).css( "display", "block" );
1400: 									$( '#edb_course_product_name' ).find( ":selected" ).text( data.cohort );
1401: 									getEnrolledUsers( 1 );
1402: 								}
1403: 							} else {
1404: 								errorMsgDialog( data );
1405: 							}
1406: 						},
1407: 						error: function (error) {
1408: 							errorMsgDialog( error );
1409: 							$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
1410: 							jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
1411: 							$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
1412: 						}
1413: 					}
1414: 				);
1415: 			}

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/admin/assets/js/edwiser-multiple-users-course-purchase-refund.js
```javascript
 1: (function( $ ) {
 2: 	'use strict';
 3: 	$( '#woocommerce-order-items' ).on(
 4: 		'click',
 5: 		'button.refund-items',
 6: 		function(){
 7: 			if ($( '.bp-refund-wrapper' ).length === 0) {
 8: 				$( '.refund-actions' ).before( bpRefund.html );
 9: 			}
10: 		}
11: 	);
12: 	$( '#woocommerce-order-items' ).on(
13: 		'click',
14: 		'.refund-actions .do-manual-refund',
15: 		function(){
16: 			var objParam            = {};
17: 			objParam["action"]      = "bp_save_refund_data";
18: 			objParam["refund-type"] = $( 'select[name="bp-refund-type"]' ).val();
19: 			objParam["full-refund"] = "";
20: 			objParam["order-id"]    = $( "#bp_order_id" ).val();
21: 			objParam["nonce"]       = ebbpRefund.nonce_refund;
22: 			if ($( 'input[name="bp-full-refund-check"]' ).prop( "checked" ) == true) {
23: 				objParam["full-refund"] = "on";
24: 			} else if ($( 'input[name="bp-full-refund-check"]' ).prop( "checked" ) == false) {
25: 				objParam["full-refund"] = "off";
26: 			}
27: 			$( ".bp-partial-refund-fields" ).each(
28: 				function(index) {
29: 					objParam[$( this ).attr( "name" )] = $( this ).val();
30: 				}
31: 			);
32: 			$.post(
33: 				ajaxurl,
34: 				objParam,
35: 				function(response){
36: 				}
37: 			);
38: 		}
39: 	);
40: 	$( '#woocommerce-order-items' ).on(
41: 		"change",
42: 		"select[name='bp-refund-type']",
43: 		function(){
44: 			if ("bp-partial-refund" == $( this ).val()) {
45: 				$( ".bp-refund-qty-wrapper" ).css( "display", "table-row" );
46: 				$( ".bp-refund-checkbox-wrapper" ).css( "display", "none" );
47: 			} else if ("bp-full-refund" == $( this ).val()) {
48: 				$( ".bp-refund-qty-wrapper" ).css( "display", "none" );
49: 				$( ".bp-refund-checkbox-wrapper" ).css( "display", "table-row" );
50: 			} else {
51: 				$( ".bp-refund-qty-wrapper" ).css( "display", "none" );
52: 				$( ".bp-refund-checkbox-wrapper" ).css( "display", "none" );
53: 			}
54: 		}
55: 	);
56: 	$( document ).on(
57: 		'input',
58: 		'.bp-partial-refund-fields',
59: 		function () {
60: 			var maxQty     = $( this ).data( "availqty" );
61: 			var toolTipDiv = $( this ).parent();
62: 			toolTipDiv     = toolTipDiv.find( ".eb-tooltiptext" );
63: 			if ($( this ).val() > maxQty) {
64: 				toolTipDiv.css( "visibility", "visible" );
65: 				$( this ).val( "" );
66: 			}
67: 		}
68: 	);
69: 	// This lets enter only 1-9 numbers in input box and not enything else.
70: 	$( document ).on(
71: 		'keypress',
72: 		'.bp-partial-refund-fields',
73: 		function(e) {
74: 			if (e.which != 8 && e.which != 0 && (e.which < 48 || e.which > 57)) {
75: 				// Display error message.
76: 				$( "#errmsg" ).html( "Digits Only" ).show().fadeOut( "slow" );
77: 				return false;
78: 			}
79: 		}
80: 	);
81: 	$( document ).on(
82: 		'focusout',
83: 		'.bp-partial-refund-fields',
84: 		function () {
85: 			var toolTipDiv = $( this ).parent();
86: 			toolTipDiv     = toolTipDiv.find( ".eb-tooltiptext" );
87: 			toolTipDiv.css( "visibility", "hidden" );
88: 		}
89: 	);
90: })( jQuery );
```

40:         public function handle_template_actions() {
41:             if ( isset( $_GET['action'] ) && isset( $_GET['nonce'] ) && wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['nonce'] ) ), 'eb_pro_elementor_template' ) ) {
42:                 $template = sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_GET['template'] ) );
43:                 require_once EB_PRO_PLUGIN_PATH . 'includes/class-eb-pro-activator.php';
44:                 if ( 'product_archive' === $template ) {
45:                     $activator = new includes\Eb_Pro_Activator();
46:                     $post_id   = $activator::create_elementor_shop_page_template();
47: 					wp_safe_redirect( admin_url( 'post.php?post=' . $post_id . '&action=elementor' ) );
48:                 } elseif ( 'product_single' === $template ) {
49:                     $activator = new includes\Eb_Pro_Activator();
50:                     $post_id   =$activator::create_elementor_product_page_template();
51: 					wp_safe_redirect( admin_url( 'post.php?post=' . $post_id . '&action=elementor' ) );
52:                 }
53:             }
54:         }
55: 	}
56: endif;
57: return new Eb_Pro_Elementor_Template_Settings();

102: 		private function get_existing_redir_rules( $settings ) {
103: 			$redirect_data = array();

105: 				foreach ( $settings as $key_id => $value ) {
106: 					if ( strpos( $key_id, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_' ) !== false ) {
107: 						$key                   = str_replace( 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_', '', $key_id );
108: 						$redirect_data[ $key ] = $value;

118: 		 * @global Object $wp_roles This is the global variable defined for the user roles by WP.
119: 		 * @param array $exisiting_rules The array of the roles previously added in setting.
120: 		 * @return array array of the role names where roles are not associated with the url in the sso settings.
121: 		 */
122: 		private function get_user_roles( $exisiting_rules ) {
123: 			global $wp_roles;

126: 				return $roles;

129: 				if ( isset( $roles[ $key ] ) ) {
130: 					unset( $roles[ $key ] );

133: 			}

 21: 			$settings         = new Sso_Settings_Social_Login();

 23: 			$form_data        = $this->get_form_data( $options, $data );
 24: 			$upd_opt_filtered = array_filter( $form_data );
 25: 			if ( isset( $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) && ! empty( $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ) {
 26: 				$upd_opt_filtered['eb_sso_secret_key'] = $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'];
 27: 			}

 30: 		private function remove_data() {
 31: 			$data = array(
 32: 				'ebsso-role-top',
 33: 				'ebsso-role-bottom',
 34: 				'ebsso_selected_login_redirect_url_top',
 35: 				'ebsso_selected_login_redirect_url_bottom',
 36: 				'save',
 37: 				'subtab',
 38: 				'_wpnonce',
 39: 				'_wp_http_referer',
 40: 			);
 41: 			foreach ( $data as $key ) {
 42: 				if ( isset( $_POST[ $key ] ) ) {
 43: 					unset( $_POST[ $key ] );
 44: 				}
 45: 			}
 46: 			return $_POST;
 47: 		}
 48: 		public function save_general_settigns( $data ) {
 49: 			global $current_tab;
 50: 			$old_settings                      = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 51: 			$settings                          = new Sso_Settings_General();
 52: 			$options                           = $settings->get_general_settings();
 53: 			$form_data                         = $this->get_form_data( $options, $data );
 54: 			$upd_opt_filtered                  = array_filter( $form_data );
 55: 			$old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] = $upd_opt_filtered['eb_sso_secret_key'];
 56: 			update_option( 'eb_' . $current_tab, $old_settings );
 57: 		}
 58: 		private function get_form_data( $options, $data ) {
 59: 			$update_options = array();
 60: 			foreach ( $options as $value ) {
 61: 				if ( ! isset( $value['id'] ) || ! isset( $value['type'] ) ) {
 62: 					continue;
 63: 				}
 64: 				if ( strstr( $value['id'], '[' ) ) {
 65: 					parse_str( $value['id'], $option_name_array );
 66: 					$option_name  = current( array_keys( $option_name_array ) );
 67: 					$setting_name = key( $option_name_array[ $option_name ] );
 68: 					$option_value = null;
 69: 					if ( isset( $data[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] ) ) {
 70: 						$option_value = wp_unslash( $data[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] );
 71: 					}
 72: 				} else {
 73: 					$option_name  = $value['id'];
 74: 					$setting_name = '';
 75: 					$option_value = null;
 76: 					if ( isset( $_POST[ $value['id'] ] ) ) {
 77: 						$option_value = wp_unslash( $data[ $value['id'] ] );
 78: 					}
 79: 				}
 80: 				$option_value = $this->get_field_type_value( $value, $option_value );
 81: 				if ( ! is_null( $option_value ) ) {
 82: 					if ( $option_name && $setting_name ) {
 83: 						if ( ! isset( $update_options[ $option_name ] ) ) {
 84: 							$update_options[ $option_name ] = get_option( $option_name, array() );
 85: 						}
 86: 						if ( ! is_array( $update_options[ $option_name ] ) ) {
 87: 							$update_options[ $option_name ] = array();
 88: 						}
 89: 						$update_options[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] = $option_value;
 90: 					} else {
 91: 						$update_options[ $option_name ] = $option_value;
 92: 					}
 93: 				}
 94: 			}
 95: 			return $update_options;
 96: 		}
 97: 		private function get_field_type_value( $value, $option_value ) {
 98: 			switch ( sanitize_title( $value['type'] ) ) {
 99: 				case 'checkbox':
100: 					if ( is_null( $option_value ) ) {
101: 						$option_value = 'no';
102: 					} else {
103: 						$option_value = 'yes';
104: 					}
105: 					break;
106: 				case 'textarea':
107: 					$option_value = wp_kses_post( trim( $option_value ) );
108: 					break;
109: 				case 'text':
110: 				case 'email':
111: 				case 'url':
112: 				case 'number':
113: 				case 'select':
114: 				case 'color':
115: 				case 'password':
116: 				case 'single_select_page':
117: 				case 'radio':
118: 					$option_value = wpClean( $option_value );
119: 					break;
120: 				case 'multiselect':
121: 					$option_value = array_filter( array_map( 'wpClean', (array) $option_value ) );
122: 					break;
123: 				default:
124: 					do_action( 'eb_update_option_' . sanitize_title( $value['type'] ), $value );
125: 					break;
126: 			}
127: 			return $option_value;
128: 		}
129: 	}
130: }

19: 			$this->_id                   = 'sso_settings_general';

21: 			add_filter( 'eb_settings_tabs_array', array( $this, 'addSettingsPage' ), 20 );
22: 			add_action( 'eb_settings_' . $this->_id, array( $this, 'output' ) );
23: 			add_action( 'eb_settings_save_' . $this->_id, array( $this, 'save' ) );
24: 			add_action( 'eb_sections_' . $this->_id, array( $this, 'outputSections' ) );

35: 			global $current_section;
36: 			$settings = $this->getSettings( $current_section );
37: 			\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\Eb_Admin_Settings::outputFields( $settings );
38: 		}
39: 		public function getSettings( $current_section = '' ) {
40: 			if ( 'redirection' === $current_section ) {
41: 				$settings = array();
42: 				$this->redirect_settings->get_user_redirection_settings();
43: 			} elseif ( isset( $_GET['section'] ) && 'social_login' === $_GET['section'] ) {
44: 				$settings = $this->social_login_settings->get_social_login_settings( $_POST );
45: 			} else {
46: 				$settings = $this->general_settings->get_general_settings();
47: 			}
48: 			return apply_filters( 'eb_get_settings_' . $this->_id, $settings );
49: 		}

51: 			if ( empty( $_POST ) ) {
52: 				return false;

56: 				$save_settings->save_redirection_settigns( $_POST );
57: 			} elseif ( isset( $_GET['section'] ) && 'social_login' === $_GET['section'] ) {

59: 			} else {
60: 				$save_settings->save_general_settigns( $_POST );

62: 		}

108: 		}
109: 		public function refund_handler( $order_id, $refund_id ) {
110: 			global $wpdb;
111: 			$order = wc_get_order( $order_id );
112: 			$refund_data = $order->get_meta( 'bp-refund-data', 1 );
113: 			$refund_id   = $refund_id;
114: 			if ( isset( $refund_data['refund-type'] ) && ! empty( $refund_data['refund-type'] ) ) {
115: 				$cohorts   = $order->get_meta( 'eb_bp_mdl_cohort_id', 1 );
116: 				if ( 'bp-partial-refund' === $refund_data['refund-type'] ) {
117: 					foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
118: 						$quantity = $quantity;
119: 						if ( isset( $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] ) && ! empty( $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] ) ) {
120: 							$this->decreasebulk_quantity( $cohort_id, $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ], $order_id );
121: 						}
122: 					}
123: 				}
124: 				if ( 'bp-full-refund' === $refund_data['refund-type'] ) {
125: 					if ( isset( $refund_data['full-refund'] ) && ! empty( $refund_data['full-refund'] ) && 'on' === $refund_data['full-refund'] ) {
126: 						$email_args      = array();
127: 						$table_name      = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
128: 						$cohort_id_array = array_keys( $cohorts );
129: 						foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
130: 							$row            = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT NAME, COHORT_NAME, COHORT_MANAGER, PRODUCTS FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d;", $cohort_id ) );
131: 							$cohort_manager = get_user_by( 'ID', $row->COHORT_MANAGER );
132: 							$products       = maybe_unserialize( $row->PRODUCTS );
133: 							$quantity       = 0;
134: 							foreach ( array_values( $products ) as $qty ) {
135: 								$quantity = $qty;
136: 								break;
137: 							}
138: 							array_push(
139: 								$email_args,
140: 								array(
141: 									'username'         => $cohort_manager->user_login,
142: 									'user_email'       => $cohort_manager->user_email,
143: 									'first_name'       => $cohort_manager->first_name,
144: 									'last_name'        => $cohort_manager->last_name,
145: 									'order_id'         => $order_id,
146: 									'bulk_refund_type' => 'fully',
147: 									'refunded_bulk_quantity' => $quantity,
148: 									'group_name'       => $row->NAME ? $row->NAME : $row->COHORT_NAME,
149: 								)
150: 							);
151: 						}
152: 						$cohort_manger = new includes\bulkPurchase\Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
153: 						$result        = $cohort_manger->delete_cohort( $cohort_id_array );
154: 						if ( $result ) {
155: 							$order->delete_meta_data( 'eb_bp_mdl_cohort_id' );
156: 							foreach ( $email_args as $args ) {
157: 								do_action( 'eb_bp_bulk_purchase_refund', $args );
158: 							}
159: 						}
160: 					}
161: 				}
162: 			}
163: 			$order->delete_meta_data( 'bp-refund-data' );
164: 			$order->save();
165: 		}
166: 		public function decreasebulk_quantity( $cohort_id, $quantity, $order_id ) {
167: 			global $wpdb;
168: 			if ( $quantity ) {
169: 				$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
170: 				$row        = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cohort_id ) );
171: 				$products   = array();
172: 				foreach ( maybe_unserialize( $row->PRODUCTS ) as $product_id => $qty ) {
173: 					if ( $qty >= $quantity ) {
174: 						$qty = $qty - $quantity;
175: 						if ( $qty >= 0 ) {
176: 							$products[ $product_id ] = $qty;
177: 						}
178: 					}
179: 				}
180: 				$wpdb->update(
181: 					$table_name,
182: 					array(
183: 						'PRODUCTS' => maybe_serialize( $products ),
184: 					),
185: 					array(
186: 						'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id,
187: 					)
188: 				);
189: 				$cohort_manager = get_user_by( 'ID', $row->COHORT_MANAGER );
190: 				$args = array(
191: 					'username'               => $cohort_manager->user_login,
192: 					'user_email'             => $cohort_manager->user_email,
193: 					'first_name'             => $cohort_manager->first_name,
194: 					'last_name'              => $cohort_manager->last_name,
195: 					'order_id'               => $order_id,
196: 					'bulk_refund_type'       => 'partially',
197: 					'refunded_bulk_quantity' => $quantity,
198: 					'group_name'             => $row->NAME ? $row->NAME : $row->COHORT_NAME,
199: 				);
200: 				do_action( 'eb_bp_bulk_purchase_refund', $args );
201: 			}
202: 		}
203: 		public function save_refund_data() {
204: 			if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'ebbp_refund_nonce' ) ) {
205: 				print 'Sorry, your nonce did not verify.';
206: 				exit;
207: 			}
208: 			$post_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
209: 			if ( isset( $post_data['refund-type'] ) && ! empty( $post_data['refund-type'] ) && isset( $post_data['order-id'] ) ) {
210: 				$order_id    = $post_data['order-id'];
211: 				$refund_data = array(
212: 					'refund-type' => $post_data['refund-type'],
213: 					'full-refund' => $post_data['full-refund'],
214: 				);
215: 				$order   = wc_get_order( $order_id );
216: 				$cohorts = $order->get_meta( 'eb_bp_mdl_cohort_id', true );
217: 				foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
218: 					$quantity = $quantity;
219: 					$refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] = $post_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ];
220: 				}
221: 				$order->update_meta_data( 'bp-refund-data', $refund_data );
222: 				$order->save();
223: 			}
224: 		}
225: 	}
226: }
```

529: 	public function unenrol_check_status() {
530: 		check_ajax_referer( 'wi_refund_unenrol', 'security' );
531: 		$checked  = isset( $_POST['unenrol'] ) && 'checked' === $_POST['unenrol'] ? 'checked' : '';
532: 		$order_id = absint( $_POST['order_id'] );
533: 		$order = wc_get_order( $order_id );
534: 		$order->update_meta_data( 'wi_refund_checked', $checked );
535: 		$order->save();
536: 		$response_data['status'] = 'updated';
537: 		wp_send_json_success( $response_data );
538: 	}
539: 	public function unenrol_update_html() {
540: 		check_ajax_referer( 'wi_refund_unenrol', 'security' );
541: 		$order_id = absint( $_POST['order_id'] );
542: 		$order                    = wc_get_order( $order_id );
543: 		$is_processed             = $order->get_meta( '_is_processed', true );
544: 		$response_data['display'] = empty( $is_processed ) ? 'false' : 'true';
545: 		wp_send_json_success( $response_data );
546: 	}
547: 	public function refund_html_content( $order ) {
548: 		$enrolled_courses = array();
549: 		$order_id         = $order->get_id();
550: 		$user_id          = $order->get_user_id();
551: 		$is_for_someone_else = $order->get_meta( '_order_for_someone_else', true );
552: 		if ( 'yes' === $is_for_someone_else ) {
553: 			$user_email = $order->get_meta( '_recipient_email', true );
554: 			$user       = get_user_by( 'email', $user_email );
555: 			$user_id    = $user->ID;
556: 		}
557: 		$order_manager = new inlucdes\wooInt\Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
558: 		$courses = $order_manager->get_moodle_course_ids_for_order( $order );
559: 		foreach ( (array) $courses as $course_id ) {
560: 			if ( \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->enrollmentManager()->userHasCourseAccess( $user_id, $course_id ) ) {
561: 				$enrolled_courses[] = $course_id;
562: 			}
563: 		}
564: 		if ( ! count( $enrolled_courses ) ) {
565: 			return;
566: 		}
567: 		$order->update_meta_data( 'wi_refund_checked', '' );
568: 		$order->save();
569: 		$checked = $order->get_meta( 'wi_refund_checked', true );
570: 		ob_start();
571: 		?>
572: 		<div class="wi-refund-wrapper">
573: 			<table class="wc-order-totals">
574: 				<tr title="<?php esc_attr_e( 'You cannot rollback this action!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?>">
575: 					<td class="label">
576: 						<label for="wi_unenrol"><?php esc_attr_e( 'Unenroll from purchased courses?', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?></label>
577: 					</td>
578: 					<td class="total">
579: 						<input type="checkbox" class="text" id="wi_unenrol" name="wi_unenrol" <?php echo esc_attr( $checked ); ?> />
580: 						<div class="clear"></div>
581: 					</td>
582: 				</tr>
583: 			</table>
584: 			<input type="hidden" id="wi_order_id" name="wi_order_id" value="<?php echo esc_attr( $order_id ); ?>" />
585: 			<?php wp_nonce_field( 'wi_refund_unenrol', 'wi_refund_unenrol' ); ?>
586: 			<div class="clear"></div>
587: 		</div>
588: 		<?php
589: 		$html = ob_get_clean();
590: 		wp_localize_script(
591: 			'admin_refund_js',
592: 			'wiRefund',
593: 			array(
594: 				'order' => $order,
595: 				'html'  => $html,
596: 			)
597: 		);
598: 		wp_enqueue_script( 'admin_refund_js' );
599: 	}
600: 	public function order_refunded( $order_id, $refund_id ) {
601: 		$order    = wc_get_order( $order_id );
602: 		$order_manager = new inlucdes\wooInt\Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
603: 		$courses       = $order_manager->get_moodle_course_ids_for_order( $order );
604: 		if ( ! count( $courses ) ) {
605: 			return;
606: 		}
607: 		$checked = $order->get_meta( 'wi_refund_checked', true );
608: 		if ( 'checked' === $checked ) {
609: 			$order_manager->handle_order_cancel( $order_id );
610: 			wp_localize_script(
611: 				'admin_refund_js',
612: 				'wiRefunded',
613: 				array( 'display' => false )
614: 			);
615: 		}
616: 		do_action( 'wooint_order_refunded', $order_id, $refund_id, $checked, $courses );
617: 	}
618: 	public function add_contains_enrolment( $actions, $post ) {
619: 		if ( 'eb_course' === $post->post_type && isset( $actions['trash'] ) ) {
620: 			global $wpdb;
621: 			$enrols = $wpdb->get_row( "SELECT user_id FROM {$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment WHERE course_id={$post->ID}", ARRAY_A );
622: 			if ( isset( $enrols ) && is_array( $enrols ) && count( $enrols ) ) {
623: 				$actions['trash'] = str_replace( 'submitdelete', 'submitdelete contains_enrolment', $actions['trash'] );
624: 			}
625: 		}
626: 		return $actions;
627: 	}
628: 	public function update_settings() {
629: 		$setting_woo_integration = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
630: 		$setting_keys            = array_keys( $setting_woo_integration );
631: 		if ( ! in_array( 'wi_enable_redirect', $setting_keys, true ) ) {
632: 			$setting_woo_integration['wi_enable_redirect'] = 'yes';
633: 		}

62: 			$post_id   = isset( $post_data['ID'] ) ? $post_data['ID'] : 0;
63: 			$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
64: 			if ( $variation_id ) {
65: 				$post_id = $variation_id;
66: 			}
67: 			$the_post = wp_is_post_revision( $post_id );
68: 			if ( $the_post ) {
69: 				$post_id = $the_post;
70: 			}
71: 			if ( $post_id ) {
72: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'product_options', true );
73: 				if ( ! isset( $product_options ) || ! is_array( $product_options ) ) {
74: 					$product_options = array();
75: 				}
76: 				if ( isset( $_POST['moodle_course_group_purchase_hidden'][ $key ] ) && 'on' === $_POST['moodle_course_group_purchase_hidden'][ $key ] ) {

124: 								'actions'  => '<i title="' . __( 'Edit user.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-edit edit-enrolled-user"></i>
125:                                     <i title="' . __( 'Unenroll user from Group.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-trash bp-delete-enrolled-user"></i>',
126: 							);
127: 							$tbl_data  = apply_filters( 'eb_bp_enroll_user_tbl_data', $tbl_data, $this->mdl_cohort_id, $user->user_id );
128: 							?>
129: 							<tr class ="<?php echo esc_html( $user->user_id ); ?>">
130: 							<?php
131: 							foreach ( array_keys( $tbl_col ) as $key ) {
132: 								echo '<td>' . wp_kses( $tbl_data[ $key ], eb_bp_get_allowed_html_tags() ) . '</td>';
133: 							}
134: 							?>
135: 							</tr>
136: 							<?php
137: 						}
138: 					}
139: 					?>
140: 				</tbody>
141: 			</table>
142: 			<?php
143: 			$form     = ob_get_clean();
144: 			$responce = array(
145: 				'seats'          => $avail_seats,
146: 				'enrolled_users' => count( $enrolled_users ),
147: 				'html'           => $form,
148: 			);
149: 			return $responce;
150: 		}
151: 		private function get_user_roles( $user ) {
152: 			$user_role = $user->roles;
153: 			$str       = '';
154: 			$count     = count( $user_role );
155: 			for ( $i = 0; $i < $count; $i++ ) {
156: 				$str .= 0 !== $i ? ', ' : '';
157: 				$str .= 'non_editing_teacher' === $user_role[ $i ] ? 'Non Editing Teacher' : $user_role[ $i ];
158: 			}
159: 			return $str;
160: 		}
161: 	}
162: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/bulk-purchase/class-eb-bp-cohort-manage-user.php

  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\bulkPurchase;

  9: 		private $con_helper;
 10: 		public function __construct() {
 11: 			$this->con_helper = Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort::get_connection_helper();
 12: 		}
 13: 		public function add_user_to_cohort( $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id, $user_role, $enrolled_by = 0, $send_mail = 1 ) {
 14: 			if ( 0 !== $enrolled_by ) {
 15: 				$cohort_manager_id = $enrolled_by;
 16: 			} else {
 17: 				$cohort_manager_id = $user_id;
 18: 				$user_role         = 'manager';
 19: 			}
 20: 			$moodle_function = 'core_cohort_add_cohort_members';
 21: 			$users_moodle_id = $this->get_users_moodleid( $user_id );
 22: 			$args            = array(
 23: 				'cohorttype' => array(
 24: 					'type'  => 'id',
 25: 					'value' => $mdl_cohort_id,
 26: 				),
 27: 				'usertype'   => array(
 28: 					'type'  => 'id',
 29: 					'value' => $users_moodle_id,
 30: 				),
 31: 			);
 32: 			$responce = $this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'members' => array( $args ) ) );
 33: 			if ( isset( $responce['success'] ) && 1 === $responce['success'] ) {
 34: 				if ( 'manager' === $user_role ) {
 35: 					$this->update_user_role( $user_id, 4 );
 36: 				} else {
 37: 					$this->update_user_role( $user_id, 5 );
 38: 				}
 39: 				$args = $this->prepare_email_args( $cohort_manager_id, $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id );
 40: 				if ( $send_mail ) {
 41: 					do_action( 'eb_bp_new_user_to_cohort', $args );
 42: 				}
 43: 				return true;
 44: 			}
 45: 			return false;
 46: 		}
 47: 		private function get_users_moodleid( $user_id ) {
 48: 			return get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id', true );
 49: 		}
 50: 		private function update_user_role( $user_id, $role ) {
 51: 			$user_data = array(
 52: 				'userid' => $this->get_users_moodleid( $user_id ),
 53: 				'roleid' => $role,
 54: 			);
 55: 			$this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( 'moodle_role_assign', array( 'assignments' => array( $user_data ) ) );
 56: 		}
 57: 		public function delete_user_from_cohort( $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id, $enrolled_by ) {
 58: 			if ( isset( $user_id ) && ! empty( $user_id ) && isset( $user_id ) && ! empty( $mdl_cohort_id ) ) {
 59: 				$moodle_function = 'core_cohort_delete_cohort_members';
 60: 				if ( 0 !== $enrolled_by ) {
 61: 					$cohort_manager_id = $enrolled_by;
 62: 				} else {
 63: 					$cohort_manager_id = $user_id;
 64: 				}
 65: 				$moodle_user_id = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id', true );
 66: 				$args           = array(
 67: 					'cohortid' => $mdl_cohort_id,
 68: 					'userid'   => $moodle_user_id,
 69: 				);
 70: 				$details = get_cohort_details( $mdl_cohort_id );
 71: 				update_user_meta( $user_id, 'eb_pending_enrollment', $details['courses'] );
 72: 				$responce = $this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'members' => array( $args ) ) );
 73: 				if ( 1 === $responce['success'] ) {
 74: 					$this->delete_cohort_user_from_wordpress( $mdl_cohort_id, $user_id );
 75: 					$response = array(
 76: 						'status'  => true,
 77: 						'message' => __( 'Unenrolled successfully!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 78: 					);
 79: 				} else {
 80: 					$response = array(
 81: 						'status'  => false,
 82: 						'message' => __( 'Unable to remove user from the cohort', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 83: 					);
 84: 				}
 85: 				if ( $response['status'] ) {
 86: 					$qty             = $this->reuse_qty_after_user_removed_from_group( $mdl_cohort_id );
 87: 					$response['qty'] = $qty;
 88: 					$args            = $this->prepare_email_args( $cohort_manager_id, $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id );
 89: 					do_action( 'eb_bp_remove_user_from_cohort', $args );
 90: 				}
 91: 				return $response;
 92: 			}
 93: 		}
 94: 		private function reuse_qty_after_user_removed_from_group( $cohort_id ) {
 95: 			global $wpdb;
 96: 			$table_name         = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
 97: 			$result             = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cohort_id ) );
 98: 			$new_products_array = array();
 99: 			$update             = 0;
100: 			$prevent            = 0;
101: 			$products           = isset( $result->PRODUCTS ) ? $result->PRODUCTS : array();
102: 			foreach ( maybe_unserialize( $result->PRODUCTS ) as $product_id => $qty ) {
103: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', 1 );
104: 				if ( isset( $product_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) && 'on' === $product_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) {
105: 					$update                            = 1;
106: 					$new_products_array[ $product_id ] = ++$qty;
107: 				} else {
108: 					$prevent = 1;
109: 				}
110: 			}
111: 			if ( $update && ! $prevent ) {
112: 				$wpdb->update(
113: 					$table_name,
114: 					array( 'PRODUCTS' => maybe_serialize( $new_products_array ) ),
115: 					array( 'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id )
116: 				);
117: 				return 1;
118: 			}
119: 			return 0;
120: 		}
121: 		private function prepare_email_args( $cohort_manager_id, $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id ) {
122: 			$user = get_userdata( $user_id );
123: 			return array(
124: 				'user_email'        => $user->user_email,
125: 				'username'          => $user->user_login,
126: 				'last_name'         => $user->last_name,
127: 				'first_name'        => $user->first_name,
128: 				'mdl_cohort_id'     => $mdl_cohort_id,
129: 				'cohort_manager_id' => $cohort_manager_id,
130: 			);
131: 		}
132: 		private function delete_cohort_user_from_wordpress( $cohort_name, $user_id ) {
133: 			global $wpdb;
134: 			$wpdb->delete(
135: 				"{$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment",
136: 				array(
137: 					'mdl_cohort_id' => $cohort_name,
138: 					'user_id'       => $user_id,
139: 				)
140: 			);
141: 		}
142: 		public function delete_all_users_from_cohort( $cohort_id ) {
143: 			global $wpdb;
144: 			return $wpdb->delete( "{$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment", array( 'mdl_cohort_id' => $cohort_id ) );
145: 		}
146: 		public function update_moodle_user_profile( $role_id, $user_id ) {
147: 			$user_id = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id' );
148: 			$moodle_function = 'core_role_assign_roles';
149: 			$user_data       = array(
150: 				'roleid'    => $role_id,
151: 				'userid'    => $user_id[0],
152: 				'contextid' => 1,
153: 			);
154: 			$response        = $this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'assignments' => array( $user_data ) ) );
155: 			return( 1 === $response['success'] ? true : false );
156: 		}
157: 	}
158: }

238: 		public function get_enrolled_users_details() {
239: 			global $wpdb;
240: 			$avail_seats    = 0;
241: 			$tbl_name       = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
242: 			$result         = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT PRODUCTS, 	COHORT_MANAGER FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE mdl_cohort_id = %d", $this->mdl_cohort_id ) );
243: 			$products       = maybe_unserialize( $result[0]->PRODUCTS );
244: 			$cohort_manager = $result[0]->COHORT_MANAGER;
245: 			$avail_seats = min( $products );
246: 			if ( null === $avail_seats ) {
247: 				$avail_seats = 0;
248: 			}
249: 			$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
250: 			$enrolled_users = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT DISTINCT `user_id` FROM `{$tbl_name}` WHERE `mdl_cohort_id` = '%d'", $this->mdl_cohort_id ) );
251: 			$tbl_col        = apply_filters(
252: 				'eb_bp_enroll_user_tbl_header',
253: 				array(
254: 					'cb'       => '<input type="checkbox" id="ebbp_enroll_student_cb_head">',
255: 					'name'     => __( 'Name', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
256: 					'email'    => __( 'Email Id', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
257: 					'progress' => __( 'Progress', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
258: 					'actions'  => __( 'Actions', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
259: 				)
260: 			);
261: 			ob_start();
262: 			?>
263: 			<table id='eb-enrolled-user-admin'>
264: 				<thead>
265: 					<tr>
266: 					<?php
267: 					foreach ( $tbl_col as $tbl_header ) {
268: 						echo '<th>' . wp_kses( $tbl_header, eb_bp_get_allowed_html_tags() ) . '</th>';
269: 					}
270: 					?>
271: 					</tr>
272: 				</thead>
273: 				<tbody>
274: 					<?php
275: 					if ( ! empty( $enrolled_users ) ) {
276: 						foreach ( $enrolled_users as $user ) {
277: 							$user_data = get_userdata( $user->user_id );
278: 							$user_role = $this->get_user_roles( $user_data );
279: 							$tbl_data  = array(
280: 								'cb'       => '<input data-id="' . $user->user_id . '" type="checkbox" class="ebbp_ebroll-students_cb">',
281: 								'name'     => $user_data->first_name . ' ' . $user_data->last_name,
282: 								'email'    => $user_data->user_email,
283: 								'progress' => '<a> <span data-cohortid = ' . $this->mdl_cohort_id . ' data-userid = ' . $user->user_id . ' class="ebbp_course_progress">' . __( 'View Progress', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</span> </a>',
284: 								'actions'  => '<i title="' . __( 'Edit user.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-edit edit-enrolled-user"></i>
285:                                     <i title="' . __( 'Unenroll user from Group.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-trash bp-delete-enrolled-user"></i>',
286: 							);
287: 							$tbl_data  = apply_filters( 'eb_bp_enroll_user_tbl_data', $tbl_data, $this->mdl_cohort_id, $user->user_id );
288: 							?>
289: 							<tr class ="<?php echo esc_html( $user->user_id ); ?>">
290: 							<?php
291: 							foreach ( array_keys( $tbl_col ) as $key ) {
292: 								echo '<td>' . wp_kses( $tbl_data[ $key ], eb_bp_get_allowed_html_tags() ) . '</td>';
293: 							}
294: 							?>
295: 							</tr>
296: 							<?php
297: 						}
298: 					}
299: 					?>
300: 				</tbody>
301: 			</table>
302: 			<?php
303: 			$form     = ob_get_clean();
304: 			$responce = array(
305: 				'seats'          => $avail_seats,
306: 				'enrolled_users' => count( $enrolled_users ),
307: 				'html'           => $form,
308: 			);
309: 			return $responce;
310: 		}
311: 		private function get_user_roles( $user ) {
312: 			$user_role = $user->roles;
313: 			$str       = '';
314: 			$count     = count( $user_role );
315: 			for ( $i = 0; $i < $count; $i++ ) {
316: 				$str .= 0 !== $i ? ', ' : '';
317: 				$str .= 'non_editing_teacher' === $user_role[ $i ] ? 'Non Editing Teacher' : $user_role[ $i ];
318: 			}
319: 			return $str;
320: 		}
321: 	}
322: }
```

134: 		public function email_template_parser( $data ) {
135: 			$args = $data['args'];
136: 			if ( empty( $args ) || count( $args ) <= 0 ) {
137: 				$args = array(
138: 					'product_id'        => '1',
139: 					'mdl_cohort_id'     => '1',
140: 					'order_id'          => 231,
141: 					'cohort_manager_id' => 1,
142: 				);
143: 			}
144: 			$tmpl_content = $data['content'];
145: 			$tmpl_const   = $this->get_tmpl_constant( $args );
146: 			foreach ( $tmpl_const as $const => $val ) {
147: 				if ( empty( $val ) ) {
148: 					$val = '';
149: 				}
150: 				$tmpl_content = str_replace( $const, $val, $tmpl_content );
151: 			}
152: 			return array(
153: 				'args'    => $args,
154: 				'content' => $tmpl_content,
155: 			);
156: 		}
157: 		private function get_tmpl_constant( $args ) {
158: 			$constants['{BULK_ENROL_PAGE_URL}']         = $this->get_bulk_enroll_page_url();
159: 			$constants['{BULK_PRODUCT_LIST}']           = $this->get_product_list( $args );
160: 			$constants['{BULK_PRODUCTS_COURSES}']       = $this->get_products_courses( $args );
161: 			$constants['{BULK_ENROLLED_COURSES}']       = $this->get_cohort_courses( $args );
162: 			$constants['{COHORT_MANAGER_DISP_NAME}']    = $this->get_manager_name( $args );
163: 			$constants['{COHORT_NAME}']                 = $this->get_cohort_name( $args );
164: 			$constants['{COHORT_CURRENT_USER_COURSES}'] = $this->get_cohort_unenrolled_courses( $args );
165: 			$constants['{GROUP_NAME}']                  = $this->get_group_name( $args );
166: 			$constants['{BULK_REFUND_TYPE}']            = $this->get_bulk_refund_type( $args );
167: 			$constants['{REFUNDED_BULK_QUANTITY}']      = $this->get_refunded_qty( $args );
168: 			$constants['{ORDER_ID}']                    = $this->get_order_id( $args );
169: 			$constants['{NEW_GROUP_PRODUCT_LIST}']      = $this->get_new_product_list( $args );
170: 			$constants['{NEW_GROUP_PRODUCTS_COURSES}']  = $this->get_new_products_courses( $args );
171: 			$constants['{NEW_GROUP_NAME}']              = isset( $args['group_name'] ) ? $args['group_name'] : '';
172: 			return $constants;
173: 		}

358: 		private function get_products_courses( $args ) {
359: 			if ( ! isset( $args['order_id'] ) || '12235' === $args['order_id'] ) {
360: 				return '';
361: 			}
362: 			$order_id = $args['order_id'];
363: 			if ( 'shop_order' === OrderUtil::get_order_type( $args['order_id'] ) ) {
364: 				$order    = new \WC_Order( $order_id );
365: 				$products = $order->get_items();
366: 				$data     = '<div>';
367: 				foreach ( $products as $item_id => $product ) {
368: 					$prod_id  = $product['product_id'];
369: 					$_product = wc_get_product( $prod_id );
370: 					if ( ! $this->check_was_group_purchase( $product, $item_id ) ) {
371: 						continue;
372: 					}
373: 					if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $product['variation_id'] ) ) {
374: 						$prod_id = $product['variation_id'];
375: 					}
376: 					$prod_name = $product['name'];
377: 					$courses   = get_post_meta( $prod_id, 'product_options', true );
378: 					$data     .= "<div><p><strong>$prod_name</strong></p><ol>";
379: 					foreach ( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] as $course_id ) {
380: 						$data .= '<li><a href=' . get_permalink( $course_id ) . '>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</a></li>';
381: 					}
382: 					$data .= '</ol></div>';
383: 				}
384: 				$data .= '</div>';
385: 				return $data;
386: 			}
387: 		}
388: 		private function get_new_products_courses( $args ) {
389: 			if ( isset( $args['courses'] ) ) {
390: 				$data  = '<div>';
391: 				$data .= '<div><ol>';
392: 				foreach ( $args['courses'] as $course_id ) {
393: 					$data .= '<li><a href=' . get_permalink( $course_id ) . '>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</a></li>';
394: 				}
395: 				$data .= '</ol></div>';
396: 				$data .= '</div>';
397: 				return $data;
398: 			}
399: 		}
400: 		private function check_was_group_purchase( $product, $item_id ) {
401: 			$is_gp     = true;
402: 			$prod_name = $product['name'];
403: 			$prod_id   = $product['product_id'];
404: 			$_product = wc_get_product( $prod_id );
405: 			if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $product['variation_id'] ) ) {
406: 				$prod_id = $product['variation_id'];
407: 			}
408: 			$courses = get_post_meta( $prod_id, 'product_options', true );
409: 			if ( ! isset( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] ) || count( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] ) < 1 ) {
410: 				$is_gp = false;
411: 			}
412: 			if ( ! isset( $courses['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) || 'on' !== $courses['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
413: 				$is_gp = false;
414: 			}
415: 			$order_meta = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, 'Group Enrollment' );
416: 			if ( 'no' === $order_meta ) {
417: 				$is_gp = false;
418: 			}
419: 			return $is_gp;
420: 		}
421: 		private function get_cohort_courses( $args ) {
422: 			if ( ! isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
423: 				return '';
424: 			}
425: 			$cohort_id = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
426: 			global $wpdb;
427: 			$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
428: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "select COURSES from {$tbl_cohort_info} where MDL_COHORT_ID=%s", $cohort_id ) );
429: 			$results = maybe_unserialize( $results->COURSES );
430: 			$out_put = '<div><ul>';
431: 			foreach ( $results as $course_id ) {
432: 				$out_put .= '<li>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</li>';
433: 			}
434: 			$out_put .= '</ul></div>';
435: 			return $out_put;
436: 		}
437: 		private function get_manager_name( $args ) {
438: 			if ( ! isset( $args['cohort_manager_id'] ) ) {
439: 				return '';
440: 			}
441: 			$manager_id = $args['cohort_manager_id'];
442: 			$manager    = get_userdata( $manager_id );
443: 			return $manager->display_name;
444: 		}
445: 		private function get_cohort_name( $args ) {
446: 			if ( isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
447: 				global $wpdb;
448: 				$cohort_id       = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
449: 				$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
450: 				$cohort_name     = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COHORT_NAME FROM {$tbl_cohort_info} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %s", $cohort_id ) );
451: 				$manager_name    = get_userdata( $args['cohort_manager_id'] );
452: 				return str_replace( $manager_name->user_login . '_', '', $cohort_name );
453: 			}
454: 			return 'cohort';
455: 		}
456: 		private function get_cohort_unenrolled_courses( $args ) {
457: 			if ( ! isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
458: 				return '';
459: 			}
460: 			$cohort_id = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
461: 			global $wpdb;
462: 			$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
463: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "select COURSES AS courses from {$tbl_cohort_info} where MDL_COHORT_ID=%s", $cohort_id ) );
464: 			$results = maybe_unserialize( $results->courses );
465: 			$out_put = '<div><ol>';
466: 			foreach ( $results as $course_id ) {
467: 				$out_put .= '<li>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</li>';
468: 			}
469: 			$out_put .= '</ol></div>';
470: 			return $out_put;
471: 		}

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/bulk-purchase/class-eb-bp-enrollment-manager.php
```php
  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\bulkPurchase;
  3: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
  4: 	exit;
  5: }
  6: if ( ! class_exists( '\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\bulkPurchase\Eb_Bp_Enrollment_Manager' ) ) {
  7: 	class Eb_Bp_Enrollment_Manager {
  8: 		public function add_columns_to_manage_enroll_table( $col_members ) {
  9: 			$col_members['cohort'] = __( 'Cohort', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
 10: 			return $col_members;
 11: 		}
 12: 		public function manage_enrollment_table_data( $tbl_rec ) {
 13: 			global $wpdb;
 14: 			$tbl_rec = array();
 15: 			$results = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment" ) );
 16: 			foreach ( $results as $result ) {
 17: 				$row                  = array();
 18: 				$row['user_id']       = $result->user_id;
 19: 				$row['user']          = get_user_profile_url( $result->user_id );
 20: 				$row['course']        = '<a href="' . esc_url( get_permalink( $result->course_id ) ) . '">' . get_the_title( $result->course_id ) . '</a>';
 21: 				$row['enrolled_date'] = $result->time;
 22: 				$row['ID']            = $result->id;
 23: 				$row['rId']           = $result->id;
 24: 				$row['course_id']     = $result->course_id;
 25: 				if ( null !== $result->mdl_cohort_id ) {
 26: 					$row['manage'] = false;
 27: 					$str           = '<div><p>' . $this->get_cohort_disp_name( $result->mdl_cohort_id ) . '</p>
 28:                          <lable class="ebbp-cohort-details-link" data-cohort-manager="' . $result->enrolled_by . '" data-mdl-cohort-id="' . $result->mdl_cohort_id . '" data-user-id="' . $result->user_id . '" data-record-id="' . $result->id . '">' . __( 'View Details', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</lable></div>';
 29: 				} else {
 30: 					$row['manage'] = true;
 31: 					$str           = '---';
 32: 				}
 33: 				$row['cohort']      = $str;
 34: 				$row['enrolled_by'] = $result->enrolled_by;
 35: 				$tbl_rec[]          = $row;
 36: 			}
 37: 			return $tbl_rec;

239: 		private function delete_groups( $group_ids ) {
240: 			global $wpdb;

242: 			$group_ids = array_map( 'intval', $group_ids );
243: 			$group_ids = implode( ',', $group_ids );
244: 			$mdl_cohort_ids = $wpdb->get_col( "SELECT MDL_COHORT_ID FROM `{$tbl_name}` WHERE `ID` IN ({$group_ids})" );
245: 			$conhort_manage = new Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
246: 			$conhort_manage->delete_cohort( $mdl_cohort_ids );
247: 			$wpdb->query( "DELETE FROM `{$tbl_name}` WHERE `id` IN ({$group_ids})" );
248: 			echo '<div class="notice notice-success is-dismissible">';
249: 			echo '<p>' . esc_html__( 'Selected groups deleted successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</p>';
250: 			echo '</div>';

171: 		private function is_product_bulk( $product_id, $product_meta ) {

173: 			if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) && 'on' === $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
174: 				if ( isset( $product_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) && 'yes' === $product_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) {
175: 					return 1;
176: 				}
177: 			}
178: 			return 0;
179: 		}

183: 			$result          = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "select COHORT_NAME AS cohort_name, NAME AS name from {$tbl_cohort_info} where MDL_COHORT_ID='%d'", $cohort_id ) );
184: 			$name = $result->cohort_name;

187: 			}

189: 				'name'        => $name,
190: 				'cohort_name' => $result->cohort_name,
191: 			);

193: 		private function get_courses_from_product( $product_id ) {
194: 			global $wpdb;

196: 			$result     = $wpdb->get_col( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT moodle_post_id FROM {$table_name} WHERE product_id = %d", $product_id ) );

199: 		private function get_bulk_product_array_from_order( $order_id ) {
200: 			$order_obj     = new \WC_Order( $order_id );
201: 			$order_item    = $order_obj->get_items();
202: 			$product_array = array();
203: 			$bulk_product  = 0;
204: 			foreach ( $order_item as $single_item ) {
205: 				if ( isset( $single_item['product_id'] ) ) {
206: 					$_product = wc_get_product( $single_item['product_id'] );
207: 					if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $single_item['variation_id'] ) ) {
208: 						$product_id = $single_item['variation_id'];
209: 					} else {
210: 						$product_id = $single_item['product_id'];
211: 					}
212: 					$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
213: 					if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) && 'on' === $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
214: 						if ( isset( $single_item['Group Enrollment'] ) && 'yes' === $single_item['Group Enrollment'] ) {
215: 							$bulk_product                 = 1;
216: 							$product_array[ $product_id ] = 0;
217: 						}
218: 					}
219: 				}
220: 			}
221: 			return array(
222: 				'bulkProduct' => $bulk_product,
223: 				'product'     => $product_array,
224: 			);
225: 		}
226: 		public function update_cohort_info( $course_ids, $order_id, $user_id, $products, $cohort_name, $use_same_cohort = false, $name = '' ) {
227: 			global $wpdb;
228: 			if ( ! empty( $order_id ) ) {
229: 				$orders = array( $order_id );
230: 			} else {
231: 				$orders = array();
232: 			}
233: 			$courses      = $course_ids;
234: 			$cohort_exist = $this->add_in_same_cohort( $cohort_name, $course_ids );
235: 			$tbl_cohort   = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
236: 			$products     = serialize( $products );
237: 			if ( $use_same_cohort ) {
238: 				$cohort_exist['cohort_name']        = $cohort_name;
239: 				$cohort_exist['add_in_same_cohort'] = true;
240: 			}
241: 			if ( true === $cohort_exist['add_in_same_cohort'] ) {
242: 				$cohort_name = $cohort_exist['cohort_name'];
243: 				$result      = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT `INCOMP_ORD`,`COURSES` FROM {$tbl_cohort} where cohort_name='%s'", $cohort_name ), ARRAY_A );
244: 				if ( count( $result ) > 0 ) {
245: 					$orders = $this->un_uerialize( $result[0]['INCOMP_ORD'] );
246: 					array_push( $orders, $order_id );
247: 				} else {
248: 					$orders = array( $order_id );
249: 				}
250: 				$wpdb->update(
251: 					$tbl_cohort,
252: 					array(
253: 						'NAME'           => $name,
254: 						'COHORT_MANAGER' => $user_id,
255: 						'INCOMP_ORD'     => serialize( $orders ),
256: 					),
257: 					array(
258: 						'cohort_name' => stripslashes( $cohort_name ),
259: 					)
260: 				);
261: 			} else {
262: 				$cohort_name = $this->genrate_cohort_name( $cohort_name, $user_id );
263: 				$user        = get_userdata( $user_id );
264: 				$wpdb->insert(
265: 					$tbl_cohort,
266: 					array(
267: 						'NAME'           => $name,
268: 						'cohort_name'    => stripslashes( $cohort_name ),
269: 						'PRODUCTS'       => $products,
270: 						'COURSES'        => serialize( $courses ),
271: 						'COHORT_MANAGER' => $user_id,
272: 						'INCOMP_ORD'     => serialize( $orders ),
273: 						'idnumber'       => $this->genrate_cohort_idnumber( $user->user_login ),
274: 					)
275: 				);
276: 			}
277: 		}
278: 		private function un_uerialize( $serialize ) {
279: 			$data_array = maybe_unserialize( $serialize );
280: 			if ( is_array( $data_array ) && count( $data_array ) > 0 ) {
281: 				return $data_array;
282: 			}
283: 			return array();
284: 		}
285: 		private function get_order_courses_ids( $order ) {
286: 			$list_of_course_ids = array();
287: 			$items = $order->get_items();
288: 			foreach ( $items as $single_item => $item_meta ) {
289: 				$single_item = $single_item;
290: 				$product_id  = '';
291: 				if ( isset( $item_meta['product_id'] ) ) {
292: 					$_product = wc_get_product( $item_meta['product_id'] );
293: 					if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $item_meta['variation_id'] ) ) {
294: 						$product_id = $item_meta['variation_id'];
295: 					} else {
296: 						$product_id = $item_meta['product_id'];
297: 					}
298: 				}
299: 				if ( is_numeric( $product_id ) ) {
300: 					$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
301: 					$group_purchase  = 'no';
302: 					if ( 'yes' === apply_filters( 'is_order_group_purchase', $group_purchase, $single_item ) ) {
303: 						if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && isset( $item_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) && 'yes' === $item_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) {
304: 							$line_item_course_ids = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
305: 							if ( ! empty( $list_of_course_ids ) ) {
306: 								$list_of_course_ids = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_course_ids, $line_item_course_ids ), SORT_REGULAR );
307: 							} else {
308: 								$list_of_course_ids = $line_item_course_ids;
309: 							}
310: 						}
311: 					}
312: 				}
313: 			}
314: 			return $list_of_course_ids;
315: 		}
316: 		private function add_in_same_cohort( $cohort_name, $course_ids ) {
317: 			global $wpdb;
318: 			$table_name      = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
319: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $table_name WHERE cohort_name like '%s'", $cohort_name . '%' ), ARRAY_A );
320: 			$new_cohort_name = null;
321: 			foreach ( $results as $res ) {
322: 				$existing_courses = maybe_unserialize( $res['COURSES'] );
323: 				sort( $existing_courses );
324: 				sort( $course_ids );
325: 				if ( $existing_courses === $course_ids && $cohort_name === $res['COHORT_NAME'] ) {
326: 					$new_cohort_name = $res['COHORT_NAME'];
327: 					break;
328: 				}
329: 			}
330: 			if ( null !== $new_cohort_name ) {
331: 				return array(
332: 					'add_in_same_cohort' => true,
333: 					'cohort_name'        => $new_cohort_name,
334: 				);
335: 			}
336: 			return array( 'add_in_same_cohort' => false );
337: 		}
338: 		private function genrate_cohort_name( $cohort_name, $user_id ) {
339: 			global $wpdb;
340: 			$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
341: 			$result = $wpdb->get_var( "SELECT ID FROM $table_name ORDER BY ID DESC LIMIT 1" );
342: 			$result = ++$result;
343: 			$user_info   = get_userdata( $user_id );
344: 			$cohort_name = $user_info->user_login . '_' . $cohort_name;
345: 			if ( $result > 0 ) {
346: 				$cohort_name = $cohort_name . '_' . $result;
347: 			}
348: 			return $cohort_name;
349: 		}
350: 		private function genrate_cohort_idnumber( $user_login ) {
351: 			$idnumber_exists = true;
352: 			while ( $idnumber_exists ) {
353: 				$idnumber = $user_login . current_time( 'timestamp' );
354: 				global $wpdb;
355: 				$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
356: 				$results    = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $table_name WHERE idnumber like '%s'", $idnumber . '%' ), ARRAY_A );
357: 				if ( $wpdb->num_rows > 0 ) {
358: 					$idnumber_exists = true;
359: 				} else {
360: 					$idnumber_exists = false;
361: 				}
362: 			}
363: 			return $idnumber;
364: 		}
365: 		private function update_cohort_on_order_complete( $user_id, $incompl_ord, $cur_ord_id, $cohort_name, $product_array ) {
366: 			global $wpdb;
367: 			$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
368: 			$key             = array_search( $cur_ord_id, $incompl_ord, true );
369: 			if ( false !== $key ) {
370: 				unset( $incompl_ord[ $key ] );
371: 			}
372: 			$result = $wpdb->update(
373: 				$tbl_cohort_info,
374: 				array(
375: 					'COHORT_MANAGER' => $user_id,
376: 					'INCOMP_ORD'     => serialize( $incompl_ord ),
377: 					'PRODUCTS'       => serialize( $product_array ),
378: 				),
379: 				array(
380: 					'COHORT_MANAGER' => $user_id,
381: 					'cohort_name'    => $cohort_name,
382: 				)
383: 			);
384: 			return $result;
385: 		}
386: 		private function get_pending_orders( $order_id, $incomp_order ) {
387: 			$key = array_search( $order_id, $incomp_order, true );
388: 			if ( false === $key ) {
389: 				unset( $incomp_order[ $key ] );
390: 			}
391: 			return $incomp_order;
392: 		}
393: 		private function get_cohort_products( $cohort_name ) {
394: 			global $wpdb;
395: 			$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
396: 			$prodcts    = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT PRODUCTS FROM {$table_name} WHERE cohort_name = %s", $cohort_name ) );
397: 			return $prodcts;
398: 		}
399: 		public function mdl_create_cohort( $user_id, $cohort_name, $idnumber ) {
400: 			$rev_cohort_name = strrev( $cohort_name );
401: 			$occurrence      = strpos( $rev_cohort_name, '_' );
402: 			if ( $occurrence > 3 || 0 === $occurrence ) {
403: 				$substr = '';
404: 			} else {
405: 				$substr = substr( $rev_cohort_name, 0, $occurrence );
406: 				$substr = strrev( $substr );
407: 			}
408: 			$products = $this->un_uerialize( $this->get_cohort_products( $cohort_name ) );
409: 			$products = array_keys( $products );
410: 			$products = implode( '_', $products );
411: 			$moodle_function = 'core_cohort_create_cohorts';
412: 			$args            = array(
413: 				'categorytype'      => array(
414: 					'type'  => 'system',
415: 					'value' => '',
416: 				),
417: 				'name'              => $cohort_name,
418: 				'idnumber'          => $idnumber,
419: 				'descriptionformat' => 1,
420: 				'description'       => ' ',
421: 				'visible'           => 1,
422: 			);
423: 			$eb_con_helper   = self::get_connection_helper();
424: 			$response        = $eb_con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'cohorts' => array( $args ) ) );
425: 			if ( isset( $response['success'] ) && $response['success'] ) {
426: 				$response_data = $response['response_data'];
427: 				$this->update_moodle_cohort_id( $idnumber, $response_data[0], $user_id );
428: 			} elseif ( isset( $response['response_message'] ) ) {
429: 				new Eb_Bp_Admin_Notices( $response['response_message'], 2 );
430: 			}
431: 			return $response;
432: 		}
433: 		private function update_moodle_cohort_id( $idnumber, $moodle_resp, $user_id ) {
434: 			global $wpdb;
435: 			$wpdb->update(
436: 				$wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info',
437: 				array(
438: 					'COHORT_NAME'   => $moodle_resp->name,
439: 					'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $moodle_resp->id,
440: 					'SYNC'          => 1,
441: 				),
442: 				array(
443: 					'idnumber'       => $idnumber,
444: 					'COHORT_MANAGER' => $user_id,
445: 				)
446: 			);
447: 		}
448: 		public function delete_cohort( $cohort_id_array ) {
449: 			global $wpdb;
450: 			$moodle_function = 'auth_edwiserbridge_delete_cohort';
451: 			$request_args    = array();
452: 			foreach ( $cohort_id_array as $cohort_id ) {
453: 				array_push( $request_args, array( 'cohortid' => $cohort_id ) );
454: 			}
455: 			$conn_helper = self::get_connection_helper();

463: 			$this->bulk_product_names = array();
464: 			return $content;
465: 		}

 53: 				$status = false;
 54: 				if ( $this->check_is_empty( $fname_arr, $cnt ) && $this->check_is_empty( $lname_arr, $cnt ) && $this->check_is_empty( $email_arr, $cnt ) ) {
 55: 					$proces_users ++;
 56: 					$first_name = $fname_arr[ $cnt ];
 57: 					$last_name  = $lname_arr[ $cnt ];
 58: 					$email      = $email_arr[ $cnt ];
 59: 					$user       = get_user_by( 'email', $email );
 60: 					$password   = wp_generate_password();
 61: 					$user_id    = 0;
 62: 					if ( email_exists( $email ) ) {
 63: 						$user      = get_user_by( 'email', $email );
 64: 						$user_id   = $user->ID;
 65: 						$user_name = $user->user_login;
 66: 						if ( $this->is_user_already_enrolled( $details['courses'], $user->ID ) ) {
 67: 							$enrolled_user[] = $user->user_email;
 68: 							continue;
 69: 						}
 70: 					} else {
 71: 						$user_name = sanitize_user( current( explode( '@', $email ) ), true );
 72: 						$append     = 1;
 73: 						$o_username = $user_name;
 74: 						while ( username_exists( $user_name ) ) {
 75: 							$user_name = $o_username . $append;
 76: 							++$append;
 77: 						}
 78: 						$wp_user_data = apply_filters(
 79: 							'eb_bp_cohort_new_user_data',
 80: 							array(
 81: 								'user_login' => $user_name,
 82: 								'first_name' => $first_name,
 83: 								'last_name'  => $last_name,
 84: 								'user_pass'  => $password,
 85: 								'user_email' => $email,
 86: 								'role'       => $wp_user_role,
 87: 							)
 88: 						);
 89: 						$user_id = wp_insert_user( $wp_user_data );
 90: 						$args = array(
 91: 							'user_email' => $email,
 92: 							'username'   => $user_name,
 93: 							'first_name' => $first_name,
 94: 							'last_name'  => $last_name,
 95: 							'password'   => $password,
 96: 						);
 97: 						do_action( 'eb_created_user_bulk_enroll', $args );
 98: 						if ( is_wp_error( $user_id ) ) {
 99: 							continue;
100: 						}
101: 					}
102: 					array_push(
103: 						$users,
104: 						array(
105: 							'firstname' => $first_name,
106: 							'lastname'  => $last_name,
107: 							'password'  => $password,
108: 							'username'  => strtolower( $user_name ),
109: 							'email'     => $email,
110: 						)
111: 					);
112: 				}
113: 				$this->eb_update_pending_course_enrollment( $user_id, $details['products'] );
114: 			}
115: 			if ( $users && ! empty( $users ) ) {
116: 				$conn_helper     = Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort::get_connection_helper();
117: 				$moodle_function = 'auth_edwiserbridge_manage_user_cohort_enrollment';
118: 				$response        = $conn_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper(
119: 					$moodle_function,
120: 					array(
121: 						'cohort_id' => $mdl_cohort_id,
122: 						'users'     => $users,
123: 					)
124: 				);
125: 				if ( isset( $response['response_data']->users ) ) {
126: 					foreach ( $response['response_data']->users as $moodle_user ) {
127: 						if ( ( isset( $moodle_user->creation_error ) && $moodle_user->creation_error ) || ( isset( $moodle_user->enrolled ) && ! $moodle_user->enrolled ) ) {
128: 							$enroll_error[] = $moodle_user->email;
129: 						} else {
130: 							$user = get_user_by( 'email', $moodle_user->email );
131: 							if ( ! get_user_meta( $user->ID, 'moodle_user_id', 1 ) ) {
132: 								update_user_meta( $user->ID, 'moodle_user_id', $moodle_user->user_id );
133: 								$args = array(
134: 									'user_email' => $moodle_user->email,
135: 									'username'   => $moodle_user->username,
136: 									'first_name' => $user->first_name,
137: 									'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
138: 									'password'   => $moodle_user->password,
139: 								);
140: 								do_action( 'eb_linked_to_existing_wordpress_user', $args );
141: 							}
142: 							$status = $this->enroll_user( $mdl_cohort_id, $user->ID, $curr_user_id, $user_role, $details['products'] );
143: 							$this->update_wordpres_user_role( $user->ID, $user->user_email );
144: 							$email_args = array(
145: 								'user_email'        => $user->user_email,
146: 								'username'          => $user->user_login,
147: 								'last_name'         => $user->last_name,
148: 								'first_name'        => $user->first_name,
149: 								'mdl_cohort_id'     => $mdl_cohort_id,
150: 								'cohort_manager_id' => $curr_user_id,
151: 							);
152: 							do_action( 'eb_bp_new_user_to_cohort', $email_args );
153: 							$rem_prd_cnt--;
154: 							$this->update_bp_cohort_info_table_on_enrollment(
155: 								$mdl_cohort_id,
156: 								$rem_prd_cnt
157: 							);
158: 							$enroll_suc[] = $moodle_user->email;
159: 						}
160: 					}
161: 				}
162: 			}
163: 			$current_user     = wp_get_current_user();
164: 			$details['name']  = str_replace( $current_user->use_login . '_', '', $details['name'] );
165: 			$details['name'] .= ' (' . $rem_prd_cnt . ') ';
166: 			if ( $is_csv_users && isset( $post_data['total'] ) && isset( $post_data['processed_users'] ) ) {
167: 				if ( ( sanitize_text_field( $post_data['processed_users'] ) + $proces_users ) == sanitize_text_field( $post_data['total'] ) ) {
168: 					$this->set_csv_users_response_data( $current_user->ID, $mdl_cohort_id, $enroll_error, $enrolled_user, $enroll_suc );
169: 					$csv_response = $this->get_csv_users_response_data( $current_user->ID, $mdl_cohort_id, $enroll_error, $enrolled_user, $enroll_suc );
170: 					$enroll_error  = $csv_response['enrollment_err'];
171: 					$enrolled_user = $csv_response['already_enrolled_user'];
172: 					$enroll_suc    = $csv_response['enrollment_suc'];
173: 				} else {
174: 					$this->set_csv_users_response_data( $current_user->ID, $mdl_cohort_id, $enroll_error, $enrolled_user, $enroll_suc );
175: 				}
176: 			}
177: 			wp_send_json_success(
178: 				array(
179: 					'cohort'          => html_entity_decode( $details['name'] ),
180: 					'msg'             => $this->prepare_res_msg( $enroll_error, $enrolled_user, $enroll_suc, $is_csv_users ),
181: 					'processed_users' => $proces_users,
182: 				)
183: 			);
184: 		}
