252: 	public function mdl_triggered_action() {
253: 		$setting = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
254: 		$wp_key  = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
255: 		if ( isset( $_GET['wdmaction'] ) && isset( $_GET['mdl_uid'] ) && isset( $_GET['verify_code'] ) ) {
256: 			$setting     = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
257: 			$redirect_to = eb_get_mdl_url();
258: 			$wp_user_id = eb_get_wp_user_id_from_moodle_id( $_GET['mdl_uid'] );
259: 			if ( $wp_user_id ) {
260: 				$eb_session_data = get_user_meta( $wp_user_id, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session', 1 );
261: 				delete_user_meta( $wp_user_id, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session' );
262: 				if ( $eb_session_data ) {
263: 					$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $eb_session_data, $wp_key );
264: 				}
265: 				if ( isset( $decrypted_args ) && getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_one_time_code' ) === $_GET['verify_code'] ) {
266: 					$mdl_key   = (string) getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' );
267: 					$mdl_uid   = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_uid' );
268: 					$mdl_email = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_email' );
269: 					$redirect_to = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'redirect_to' );
270: 					if ( ! filter_var( $redirect_to, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
271: 						if ( filter_var( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
272: 							$redirect_to = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
273: 						} else {
274: 							$redirect_to = site_url();
275: 						}
276: 					}
277: 					if ( ! empty( $wp_key ) && $mdl_key === $wp_key ) {
278: 						if ( 'logout' === $_GET['wdmaction'] ) {
279: 							add_action(
280: 								'wp_logout',
281: 								function() use ( $redirect_to ) {
282: 									wp_redirect( $redirect_to );
283: 									exit();
284: 								}
285: 							);
286: 							triggerLogout( $mdl_uid );
287: 						} elseif ( 'login' === $_GET['wdmaction'] ) {
288: 							triggerLogin( $mdl_uid, $mdl_email );
289: 						}
290: 					}
291: 				}
292: 			}
293: 			wp_redirect( $redirect_to );
294: 			exit();
295: 		} elseif ( isset( $_GET['wdmaction'] ) && isset( $_GET['data'] ) ) {
296: 			$conn_options = get_option( 'eb_connection' );
297: 			$mdl_url      = $this->get_mdl_connection_url( $conn_options );
298: 			if ( is_user_logged_in() ) {
299: 				$wp_key = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
300: 				// Check if Moodle user is already logged in.
301: 				$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $_GET['data'], $wp_key );
302: 				if ( getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' ) === $wp_key ) {
303: 					$user = wp_get_current_user();
304: 					if ( $user->ID ) {
305: 						$mdl_logout = new Sso_Manage_Moodle_Login( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
306: 						$mdl_logout->mdl_logged_in( $user->user_login, $user, '', $mdl_url );
307: 					}
308: 				}
309: 			} else {
310: 				// If not logged in then redirect to the WordPress login page.
311: 				$settings   = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_redirection' );
312: 				$login_page = isset( $settings['ebsso_login_page'] ) ? $settings['ebsso_login_page'] : '';
313: 				if ( $login_page ) {
314: 					$login_page = get_permalink( $login_page );
315: 				} else {
316: 					// get user-account page.
317: 					$login_page = site_url( '/user-account' );
318: 				}
319: 				wp_redirect( add_query_arg( array( 'redirect_to' => $mdl_url, 'login_action' => 'moodle' ), $login_page ) );
320: 			}
321: 		}
322: 	}
323: 	public function eb_sso_login_api_registration() {
324: 		register_rest_route(
325: 			'edwiser-bridge',
326: 			'/sso/',
327: 			array(
328: 				'methods'             => 'POST, GET',
329: 				'callback'            => array( $this, 'external_api_endpoint_def' ),
330: 				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
331: 			)
332: 		);
333: 	}
334: 	public function external_api_endpoint_def( $request_data ) {
335: 		if ( isset( $_POST['wdmargs'] ) ) {
336: 			$setting = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
337: 			$wp_key  = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
338: 			$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $_POST['wdmargs'], $wp_key );
339: 			$mdl_key        = (string) getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' );
340: 			$mdl_uid        = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_uid' );
341: 			$mdl_email      = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_email' );
342: 			if ( $mdl_key === $wp_key ) {
343: 				$user = get_user_by( 'email', $mdl_email );
344: 				if ( isset( $user->ID ) && ! empty( $user->ID ) ) {
345: 					update_user_meta( $user->ID, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session', $_POST['wdmargs'] );
346: 				}
347: 			}
348: 		}
349: 	}
350: }

 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\sso;

 6: class Sso_Redirection {
 7: 	private $version;

10: 		$this->version     = $version;
11: 		$this->plugin_name = $plugin_name;
12: 	}
13: 	public function get_login_redirect_url( $user, $default_redirect_url = '', $ignore_setting_redirect_url = 0 ) {
14: 		$post_content             = null;
15: 		$user_redirect_url_status = $this->get_user_redirect_url( $user );
16: 		$redirect_url             = $user_redirect_url_status;
17: 		$user_redirect_url_status = ( $user_redirect_url_status ) ? $user_redirect_url_status : $ignore_setting_redirect_url;
18: 		if ( $ignore_setting_redirect_url && ! empty( $default_redirect_url ) ) {
19: 			$redirect_url = $default_redirect_url;
20: 		} elseif ( empty( $redirect_url ) ) {
21: 			if ( ! empty( $default_redirect_url ) ) {
22: 				$redirect_url = $default_redirect_url;
23: 			} else {
24: 				$redirect_url = get_site_url();
25: 			}
26: 		}
27: 		$get = array();
28: 		if ( isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] ) && filter_var( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
29: 			$postid       = url_to_postid( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] );
30: 			$post_content = $postid ? get_post( $postid )->post_content : null;
31: 			$parsed_url   = parse_url( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], PHP_URL_QUERY );
32: 			if ( ! empty( $parsed_url ) ) {
33: 				parse_str( $parsed_url, $get );
34: 			}
35: 		}
36: 		if ( ! $user_redirect_url_status ) {
37: 			$redirect_url = getRedirectUrl( $get, $post_content, $redirect_url );
38: 		} else {
39: 			$redirect_url = $redirect_url;
40: 		}
41: 		if ( isset( $post_content ) && has_shortcode( $post_content, 'bridge_woo_single_cart_checkout' ) && ! $ignore_setting_redirect_url ) {
42: 			$redirect_url = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
43: 		} elseif ( isset( $post_content ) && has_shortcode( $post_content, 'woocommerce_checkout' ) && ! $ignore_setting_redirect_url ) {
44: 			$redirect_url = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
45: 		} elseif ( isset( $get['login_action'] ) && 'moodle' === $get['login_action'] ) {
46: 			$redirect_url = $get['redirect_to'];
47: 		}
48: 		if ( isset( $get['redirect_to'] ) && filter_var( $get['redirect_to'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) && isset( $get['is_enroll'] ) ) {
49: 			$redirect_url = $get['redirect_to'];
50: 			$redirect_url = add_query_arg( 'auto_enroll', 'true', $redirect_url );
51: 		}
52: 		return apply_filters( 'eb_sso_login_url', $redirect_url );
53: 	}
54: 	private function get_user_redirect_url( $user ) {
55: 		$redirect_urls = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_redirection' );
56: 		if ( isset( $redirect_urls['ebsso_role_base_redirect'] ) && 'no' === $redirect_urls['ebsso_role_base_redirect'] ) {
57: 			return $this->get_redirect_url( $redirect_urls, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url' );
58: 		} else {
59: 			return $this->get_redirect_url( $redirect_urls, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_' . $user->roles[0] );
60: 		}
61: 	}
62: 	private function get_redirect_url( $data, $role ) {
63: 		$redirect = false;
64: 		if ( isset( $_GET['mdl_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $_GET['mdl_course_id'] ) ) {
65: 			$redirect = eb_get_mdl_url() . '/course/view.php?id=' . $_GET['mdl_course_id'];
66: 		} elseif ( isset( $data[ $role ] ) && ! empty( $data[ $role ] ) ) {
67: 			$redirect = $data[ $role ];
68: 		} elseif ( isset( $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'] ) && ! empty( $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'] ) ) {
69: 			$redirect = $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'];
70: 		}
71: 		return $redirect;
72: 	}
73: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/class-sso-social-login-user-manager.php

 8: 	private $version;

11: 	public function __construct( $plugin_name, $version ) {

15: 	}
16: 	public function check_user_details( $social_prof_data = array(), $redirect = '' ) {
17: 		global $wpdb;
18: 		$user_data  = false;
19: 		$check_keys = array( 'oauth_uid', 'first_name', 'last_name', 'email' );
20: 		foreach ( $check_keys as $key ) {
21: 			if ( empty( $social_prof_data[ $key ] ) ) {
22: 				auth_redirect();
23: 				exit();
24: 			}
25: 		}
26: 		if ( ! empty( $social_prof_data ) ) {
27: 			$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO', 'SSO Log: Checking user is already exist or not for the emial address: ' . $social_prof_data['email'] . 'using provider: ' . $social_prof_data['oauth_provider'] );
28: 			$this->user_tbl  = $wpdb->prefix . 'gp_oauth_users';
29: 			$stmt_check_user = "SELECT * FROM " . $this->user_tbl . " WHERE oauth_provider = '" . $social_prof_data['oauth_provider'] . "' AND oauth_uid = '" . $social_prof_data['oauth_uid'] . "'";
30: 			$prev_result      = $wpdb->get_row( $stmt_check_user, ARRAY_A );
31: 			if ( null === $prev_result ) {
32: 				$this->add_user( $social_prof_data );
33: 			} else {
34: 				$where = array(
35: 					'oauth_provider' => $prev_result['oauth_provider'],
36: 					'oauth_uid'      => $prev_result['oauth_uid'],
37: 				);
38: 				$this->update_user_data( $social_prof_data, $where );
39: 			}
40: 			$user_data = $wpdb->get_row( $stmt_check_user, ARRAY_A );
41: 		}
42: 		$this->redirect_user( $social_prof_data['email'], $user_data, $redirect );
43: 	}
44: 	private function redirect_user( $social_login_emial, $user_data, $redirect ) {
45: 		if ( $user_data ) {
46: 			$wp_user = get_user_by( 'email', $social_login_emial );
47: 			$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO', 'SSO Log: User registrerd with email address: ' . $social_login_emial );
48: 			setLoginData( $wp_user );
49: 			$mdl_login = new Sso_Manage_Moodle_Login( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
50: 			$mdl_login->mdl_logged_in( '', $wp_user, '', $redirect );
51: 		} else {
52: 			$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO', 'SSO Log: User registration failed' );
53: 			auth_redirect();
54: 			exit();
55: 		}
56: 	}
57: 	private function add_user( $user_data ) {
58: 		global $wpdb;
59: 		$wpdb->insert( $this->user_tbl, $user_data );
60: 		$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO', 'SSO Log: Creating new WordPress user with email: ' . $user_data['email'] . 'using provider: ' . $user_data['oauth_provider'] );
61: 		createEbUser( $user_data );
62: 		$wp_user = get_user_by( 'email', $user_data['email'] );
63: 		$this->update_user_data( array( 'wp_user_id' => $wp_user->ID ), array( 'email' => $user_data['email'] ) );
64: 	}
65: 	private function update_user_data( $user_data, $where ) {
66: 		if ( isset( $user_data['email'] ) ) {

74: 		}

 85: 	public function update_membership_id_on_moodle_enrollment_tbl( $course_id, $user_id, $new_memberships ) {

 88: 		$old_memberships = $this->get_membership_id( $course_id, $user_id );
 89: 		if ( ! empty( $old_memberships ) ) {
 90: 			$new_memberships = array_unique( array_merge( $old_memberships, $new_memberships ) );
 91: 		}
 92: 		$new_memberships = maybe_serialize( $new_memberships );
 93: 		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE $tbl_name SET membership_id = %s WHERE course_id = %d AND user_id = %d", array( $new_memberships, $course_id, $user_id ) ) );
 94: 	}
 95: 	public function get_membership_plans() {

 98: 		$args['post_type'] = 'wc_membership_plan';
 99: 		$membership_plans  = get_posts( $args );
100: 		if ( ! empty( $membership_plans ) ) {
101: 			foreach ( $membership_plans as $membership ) {
102: 				$associated_products = $this->get_products_from_membership_id( $membership->ID );
103: 				if ( ! empty( $associated_products ) ) {
104: 					array_push(
105: 						$membership_plans_array,
106: 						array(
107: 							'membership_id'       => $membership->ID,
108: 							'associated_products' => $associated_products,
109: 						)
110: 					);

112: 			}
113: 		}
114: 		return $membership_plans_array;

116: 	public function handle_membsership_status_change( $user_membership, $old_status, $new_status ) {
117: 		$user_id       = $user_membership->get_user_id();
118: 		$membership_id = $user_membership->get_plan_id();
119: 		$order_manager = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
120: 		switch ( $new_status ) {
121: 			case 'active':
122: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
123: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
124: 					$this->add_enrollment_entry_with_membership_id( $total_courses, $user_id, $membership_id );
125: 				}
126: 				break;
127: 			case 'paused':
128: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
129: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
130: 					$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 1 );
131: 				}
132: 				break;
133: 			case 'expired':
134: 			case 'cancelled':
135: 				$option_name = 'wi_on_membership_' . $new_status;
136: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
137: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
138: 					$woo_int_settings = maybe_unserialize( get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', false ) );
139: 					if ( isset( $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) && 'suspend' === $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) {
140: 						$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 1 );
141: 					} elseif ( isset( $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) && 'unenroll' === $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) {
142: 						$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 0, 1 );
143: 					}
144: 				}
145: 				break;
146: 			default:
147: 				break;
148: 		}
149: 	}
150: 	public function add_enrollment_entry_with_membership_id( $total_courses, $user_id, $membership_id ) {
151: 		global $wpdb;
152: 		$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
153: 		foreach ( $total_courses as $course_id ) {
154: 			$old_memberships = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT membership_id, act_cnt FROM $tbl_name WHERE course_id = %d AND user_id = %d", array( $course_id, $user_id ) ) );
155: 			$old_memberships = maybe_unserialize( $old_memberships );
156: 			$order_manager = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
157: 			if ( empty( $old_memberships ) ) {
158: 				$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, array( $course_id ) );
159: 			}
160: 			$membsership_array = array( $membership_id );
161: 			$this->update_membership_id_on_moodle_enrollment_tbl( $course_id, $user_id, $membsership_array );
162: 		}
163: 	}
164: }

16: 	public function wi_get_edwiser_products() {
17: 		global $wpdb;
18: 		$products = array();
19: 		$query  = 'SELECT DISTINCT `product_id` FROM `' . $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products`';
20: 		$result = $wpdb->get_results( $query, ARRAY_A );
21: 		foreach ( $result as $products_id_arr ) {
22: 			$product_id = $products_id_arr['product_id'];
23: 			$product    = wc_get_product( $product_id );
24: 			$post = get_post( $product_id, ARRAY_A );
25: 			$terms      = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
26: 			$categories = array();
27: 			foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
28: 				$categories[] = array(
29: 					'id'   => $term->id,
30: 					'name' => $term->name,
31: 					'slug' => $term->slug,
32: 				);
33: 			}
34: 			$products[] = array(
35: 				'id'            => $product_id,
36: 				'name'          => $post['post_title'],
37: 				'permalink'     => get_post_permalink( $product_id ),
38: 				'slug'          => $post['post_name'],
39: 				'date_created'  => $post['post_date'],
40: 				'date_modified' => $post['post_modified'],
41: 				'type'          => $product->get_type( $product_id ),
42: 				'status'        => $post['post_status'],
43: 				'description'   => $post['post_content'],
44: 				'price'         => $product->get_price(),
45: 				'regular_price' => $product->get_regular_price(),
46: 				'sale_price'    => $product->get_sale_price(),
47: 				'categories'    => $categories,
48: 				'image-link'    => wp_get_attachment_image_src( get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id ), 'single-post-thumbnail' ),
49: 			);
50: 		}

52: 	}

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/woo-int/class-bridge-woocommerce-ajax.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\wooInt;
 3: use \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\EdwiserBridge;
 4: use app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes as includes;
 5: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
 6: 	exit;
 7: }
 8: class Bridge_Woocommerce_Ajax {
 9: 	private $edwiser_bridge;
10: 	public function __construct() {
11: 		add_action( 'wp_ajax_nopriv_handle_product_synchronization', array( $this, 'handle_product_synchronization_callback' ) );
12: 		add_action( 'wp_ajax_handle_product_synchronization', array( $this, 'handle_product_synchronization_callback' ) );
13: 		require_once WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/edwiser-bridge/includes/class-eb.php';
14: 		$this->edwiser_bridge = new EdwiserBridge();
15: 	}
16: 	public function handle_product_synchronization_callback() {
17: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Initiating Product sync process....' );
18: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ) {
19: 			die( 'Busted!' );
20: 		}
21: 		$nonce = isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ? esc_attr( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) : ''; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
22: 		// verifying generated nonce we created earlier.
23: 		if ( ! wp_verify_nonce( $nonce, 'check_product_sync_action' ) ) {
24: 			die( 'Busted !' );
25: 		}
26: 		$sync_options = isset( $_POST['sync_options'] ) ? esc_attr( $_POST['sync_options'] ) : ''; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
27: 		// get sync options.
28: 		$sync_options      = json_decode( str_replace( '\\', '', html_entity_decode( $sync_options ) ), 1);
29: 		$course_woo_plugin = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Course( includes\edwiser_bridge_pro()->get_plugin_name(), includes\edwiser_bridge_pro()->get_version() );
30: 		$response          = $course_woo_plugin->bridge_woo_product_sync_handler( $sync_options );
31: 		echo json_encode( $response );
32: 		die();
33: 	}
34: }
35: new Bridge_Woocommerce_Ajax();

166: 	public function bridge_woo_sync_product_categories() {

179: 			$term_id_list = function_exists( 'array_column' ) ? array_column( $terms, 'term_id' ) : $this->wdm_array_column( $terms, 'term_id' );
180: 			$product_cat_relation = array();

197: 							$product_cat_relation[ $single_term['term_id'] ] = $term_updated['term_id'];
198: 						}
199: 					}
200: 				} else {
201: 					$term_exist_result = term_exists( $single_term['name'], 'product_cat' );
202: 					if ( 0 == $term_exist_result || null == $term_exist_result ) {
203: 						$term_created = wp_insert_term( $single_term['name'], 'product_cat', array( 'description' => $single_term['description'], 'slug' => $single_term['slug'] ) );
204: 						if ( ! is_wp_error( $term_created ) ) {
205: 							$product_cat_relation[ $single_term['term_id'] ] = $term_created['term_id'];

209: 						if ( ! is_wp_error( $term_updated ) ) {

211: 						}
212: 					}
213: 				}
214: 			}

216: 			$response['respone_message'] = '<div class="alert alert-success">' . __( 'Categories synchronized.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</div>';

All products may have already been created or could be in the trash. If they are in the trash and you wish to re-sync them, please empty the WooCommerce Product trash folder.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</div>';

222: 	private function object2array( $obj ) {

233: 			$category_respone = $this->bridge_woo_sync_product_categories();
234: 		}

236: 			$response = $this->bridge_woo_sync_update_product( $sync_options );
237: 		}

239: 			if ( empty( $response ) ) {
240: 				$response = $this->bridge_woo_sync_create_product( $sync_options );
241: 			} else {
242: 				$response = array_merge_recursive( $response, $this->bridge_woo_sync_create_product( $sync_options ) );

244: 		}
245: 		if ( ! empty( $category_respone ) ) {
246: 			$response = array_merge_recursive( $response, $category_respone );
247: 		}
248: 		return $response;

250: 	public function wdm_array_column( $input = null, $column_key = null, $index_key = null ) {

252: 			$input = null;

277: 		$result_array = array();
278: 		foreach ( $params_input as $row ) {
279: 			$key       = null;

281: 			$key_set   = false;
282: 			$value_set = false;
283: 			if ( null !== $params_index_key && array_key_exists( $params_index_key, $row ) ) {
284: 				$key_set = true;
285: 				$key     = (string) $row[ $params_index_key ];
286: 			}
287: 			if ( null === $params_column_key ) {
288: 				$value_set = true;
289: 				$value     = $row;
290: 			} elseif ( is_array( $row ) && array_key_exists( $params_column_key, $row ) ) {
291: 				$value_set = true;
292: 				$value     = $row[ $params_column_key ];
293: 			}
294: 			if ( $value_set ) {
295: 				if ( $key_set ) {
296: 					$result_array[ $key ] = $value;
297: 				} else {
298: 					$result_array[] = $value;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 		return $result_array;
303: 	}
304: }

232: 	public function get_moodle_course_ids_for_order( $order, $skip_subscription = 0 ) {
233: 		$order_id                     = $order->get_id();
234: 		$list_of_course_ids           = array();
235: 		$total_associated_memberships = array();
236: 		$order_id = $order->get_id();
237: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'user', 'Check Line Items for Order ID - ' . $order_id );
238: 		$membership_handler = new Bridge_Woo_Membership_Handler( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
239: 		$items = $order->get_items();
240: 		foreach ( $items as $single_item ) {
241: 			$product_id = '';
242: 			if ( isset( $single_item['product_id'] ) ) {
243: 				$_product = wc_get_product( $single_item['product_id'] );
244: 				if ( 1 === $skip_subscription && defined( 'WOOINT_WCS_VER' ) && \WC_Subscriptions_Product::is_subscription( $_product ) ) {
245: 						continue;
246: 				}

250: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
251: 				$group_purchase  = 'no';
252: 				if ( 'no' === apply_filters( 'is_order_group_purchase', $group_purchase, $single_item->get_id() ) ) {
253: 					if ( check_value_set( $product_options, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) ) {
254: 						$line_item_course_ids = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
255: 						if ( ! empty( $list_of_course_ids ) ) {
256: 							$list_of_course_ids = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_course_ids, $line_item_course_ids ), SORT_REGULAR );
257: 						} else {
258: 							$list_of_course_ids = $line_item_course_ids;
259: 						}
260: 					}
261: 				}
262: 			}
263: 			$membership_processed_data    = $this->merge_membership_courses( $membership_handler, $list_of_course_ids, $single_item, $total_associated_memberships );
264: 			$list_of_course_ids           = $membership_processed_data['course_list'];
265: 			$total_associated_memberships = $membership_processed_data['total_memberships'];
266: 		}
267: 		if ( ! empty( $total_associated_memberships ) ) {
268: 			$order->update_meta_data( 'eb_order_associated_memberships', maybe_serialize( $total_associated_memberships ) );
269: 			$order->save();
270: 		}
271: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'user', 'Courses IDs from Line Items  ' . serialize( $list_of_course_ids ) );
272: 		return $list_of_course_ids;
273: 	}
274: 	public function merge_membership_courses( $membership_handler, $list_of_course_ids, $single_product_item, $total_associated_memberships ) {
275: 		if ( check_woocommerce_membership_is_active() ) {
276: 			$associated_memberships = $membership_handler->get_products_associated_with_membership( $single_product_item );
277: 			if ( ! empty( $associated_memberships ) ) {
278: 				foreach ( $associated_memberships as $membership ) {

280: 					foreach ( $membership_products as $product_id ) {
281: 						$list_of_course_ids = is_array( $list_of_course_ids ) ? $list_of_course_ids : array();
282: 						$new_courses        = get_wp_courses_from_product_id( $product_id );
283: 						$new_courses        = is_array( $new_courses ) ? $new_courses : array();

288: 			}

294: 	}
295: 	public function wcs_status_updated( $subscription, $new_status, $old_status ) {
296: 		if ( get_class( $subscription ) !== 'WC_Subscription' ) {
297: 			return;
298: 		}
299: 		if ( 'pending-cancel' === $new_status ) {
300: 			return;
301: 		}
302: 		if ( 'active' === $new_status ) {
303: 			update_post_meta( $subscription->get_id(), '_eb_subscription_processed', 1 );
304: 		}
305: 		$is_processed = get_post_meta( $subscription->get_id(), '_eb_subscription_processed', true );
306: 		if ( ( 'on-hold' === $new_status || 'cancelled' === $new_status ) && ! $is_processed ) {
307: 			return;
308: 		}
309: 		$statuses = array(
310: 			'completed' => true,
311: 			'active'    => false,
312: 			'failed'    => true,
313: 			'on-hold'   => true,
314: 			'cancelled' => true,
315: 			'switched'  => true,
316: 			'expired'   => true,
317: 		);
318: 		$statuses = apply_filters( 'eb_subscription_suspend_status', $statuses );
319: 		$do_not_proceed_arr = array(
320: 			'pending-cancel',
321: 		);
322: 		$process_rquest_array = array();
323: 		if ( array_key_exists( $new_status, $statuses ) ) {
324: 			$suspend = isset( $statuses[ $new_status ] ) && ! $statuses[ $new_status ] ? 0 : 1;
325: 			$user    = get_user_by( 'id', $subscription->get_user_id() );
326: 			$order_id = $subscription->get_parent_id();
327: 			$unenroll           = 0;
328: 			$sub_expire_setting = $this->check_subscription_expiration_settings( $new_status );
329: 			if ( -1 === $sub_expire_setting ) {
330: 				return;
331: 			}
332: 			extract( $sub_expire_setting, EXTR_OVERWRITE );
333: 			$items = $subscription->get_items();
334: 			if ( version_compare( WOOCOMMERCE_VERSION, '3.0.0', '>=' ) ) {
335: 				foreach ( $items as $item ) {
336: 					$product_id = $item->get_product_id();
337: 					$product    = $item->get_product( $product_id );
338: 					if ( $product->is_type( 'subscription_variation' ) ) {
339: 						$product_id = $item->get_variation_id();
340: 					} else {
341: 						$product_id = $item->get_product_id();
342: 					}
343: 					$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
344: 					if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
345: 						if ( isset( $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) && 'yes' === $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) {
346: 							$end_date = $subscription->get_date( 'end' );
347: 						} else {
348: 							$end_date = false;
349: 						}
350: 						$course_enrolled = self::enroll_user_in_courses(
351: 							$subscription->get_user_id(),
352: 							$product_options['moodle_post_course_id'],
353: 							$suspend,
354: 							$unenroll,
355: 							$subscription->get_date( 'start' ),
356: 							$end_date
357: 						);
358: 						$email_args = array(
359: 							'user_email' => $user->user_email,
360: 							'order_id'   => $order_id,
361: 							'username'   => $user->user_login,
362: 							'first_name' => $user->first_name,
363: 							'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
364: 						);
365: 						if ( 1 === $course_enrolled && ! $suspend ) {

371: 				}
372: 			} else {

375: 						$product_variation_id = $item['variation_id'];

391: 							$suspend,

413: 	private function check_subscription_expiration_settings( $new_status ) {
414: 		$sub_expire_setting = array();
415: 		if ( 'expired' === $new_status || 'cancelled' === $new_status ) {
416: 			$woo_int_settings           = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
417: 			$on_subscription_expiration = $woo_int_settings['wi_on_subscription_expiration'];
418: 			if ( 'do-nothing' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
419: 				return -1;
420: 			} elseif ( 'suspend' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
421: 				$sub_expire_setting['suspend'] = 1;
422: 			} elseif ( 'unenroll' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
423: 				$sub_expire_setting['unenroll'] = 1;

426: 		return $sub_expire_setting;

433: 			'cancelled'  => false,

435: 			'refunded'   => false,

 68: 	public function moodle_course_in_dropdown( $output ) {
 69: 		$output = array();

 71: 		$terms   = get_terms( 'product_type' );
 72: 		$output  = '<select name="product_type" id="dropdown_product_type">';
 73: 		$output .= '<option value="">' . __( 'Filter by product type', '' ) . '</option>';
 74: 		foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
 75: 			$output .= '<option value="' . sanitize_title( $term->name ) . '" ';
 76: 			if ( isset( $wp_query->query['product_type'] ) ) {
 77: 				$output .= selected( $term->slug, $wp_query->query['product_type'], false );
 78: 			}
 79: 			$output .= '>';
 80: 			switch ( $term->name ) {
 81: 				case 'grouped':
 82: 					$output .= __( 'Grouped product', '' );
 83: 					break;
 84: 				case 'external':
 85: 					$output .= __( 'External/Affiliate product', '' );
 86: 					break;
 87: 				case 'variable':
 88: 					$output .= __( 'Variable product', '' );
 89: 					break;
 90: 				case 'simple':
 91: 					$output .= __( 'Simple product', 'woocommerce' );
 92: 					break;
 93: 				default:
 94: 					$output .= ucfirst( $term->name );
 95: 					break;
 96: 			}
 97: 			$output .= '</option>';
 98: 			if ( 'simple' === $term->name ) {
 99: 				$output .= '<option value="downloadable" ';
100: 				if ( isset( $wp_query->query['product_type'] ) ) {
101: 					$output .= selected( 'downloadable', $wp_query->query['product_type'], false );
102: 				}
103: 				$output .= '> ' . ( is_rtl() ? '&larr;' : '&rarr;' ) . ' ' . __( 'Downloadable', 'woocommerce' ) . '</option>';
104: 				$output .= '<option value="virtual" ';
105: 				if ( isset( $wp_query->query['product_type'] ) ) {
106: 					$output .= selected( 'virtual', $wp_query->query['product_type'], false );
107: 				}
108: 				$output .= '> ' . ( is_rtl() ? '&larr;' : '&rarr;' ) . ' ' . __( 'Virtual', 'woocommerce' ) . '</option>';
109: 			}
110: 		}
111: 		$output .= '<option value="moodle_course">Moodle Course</option>';
112: 		$output .= '</select>';
113: 		echo $output;
114: 	}
115: 	public function product_filters_query( $query ) {

124: 				}

128: }

126: 		$plugin_post_types = new EB_Post_Types( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
127: 		echo esc_html( "<div id='{$args['args']['post_type']}_options' class='post-options'>" );

138: 	private function populate_metabox_fields( $post_type ) {
139: 		global $wpdb;
140: 		$course_list = array();
141: 		$query = "SELECT `ID`,`post_title`, `post_status` FROM  `" . $wpdb->prefix . "posts` WHERE  `post_type` LIKE  'eb_course' AND (`post_status` LIKE 'publish' OR `post_status` LIKE 'draft' )";
142: 		$result = $wpdb->get_results( $query, OBJECT_K );
143: 		if ( ! empty( $result ) ) {
144: 			foreach ( $result as $post_id => $single_result ) {
145: 				$draft = '';
146: 				if ( 'draft' === $single_result->post_status ) {
147: 					$draft = '( draft  )';
148: 				}
149: 				$course_list[ $post_id ] = $single_result->post_title . $draft;
150: 			}
151: 		}
152: 		$args_array = array(
153: 			'product' => array(
154: 				'moodle_post_course_id' => array(
155: 					'label'       => __( 'Courses', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
156: 					'description' => __( 'Associate product with courses', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
157: 					'type'        => 'select_multi',
158: 					'options'     => $course_list,
159: 				),
160: 			),
161: 		);
162: 		$args_array = apply_filters( 'ed_woo_post_options', $args_array );
163: 		if ( ! empty( $post_type ) ) {
164: 			if ( isset( $args_array[ $post_type ] ) ) {
165: 				return $args_array[ $post_type ];
166: 			} else {
167: 				return $args_array;
168: 			}
169: 		}
170: 	}
171: 	public function handle_post_options_save( $post_id ) {
172: 		global $pagenow;
173: 		$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
174: 		if ( self::is_valid_to_save_meta() && in_array( $post_type, array( 'product' ) ) && 'admin-ajax.php' !== $pagenow ) {
175: 			$update_post_options = array();
176: 			$fields = $this->populate_metabox_fields( $post_type );
177: 			$post_options = check_value_set( $_POST, $post_type . '_options' );
178: 			if ( ! empty( $post_options ) ) {
179: 				foreach ( $fields as $key => $values ) {
180: 					$option_name  = $key;
181: 					$option_value = $this->wdm_isset_null( $post_options[ $key ] );
182: 					switch ( sanitize_title( $values['type'] ) ) {
183: 						case 'checkbox':
184: 							$option_value = is_null( $option_value ) ? 'no' : 'yes';
185: 							break;
186: 						case 'textarea':
187: 							$option_value = wp_kses_post( trim( $option_value ) );
188: 							break;
189: 						case 'text':
190: 						case 'text_secret':
191: 						case 'number':
192: 						case 'select':
193: 						case 'password':
194: 						case 'radio':
195: 							$option_value = wpClean( $option_value );
196: 							break;
197: 						case 'select_multi':
198: 						case 'checkbox_multi':
199: 							$option_value = array_filter( array_map( 'wpClean', (array) $option_value ) );
200: 							break;
201: 						default:
202: 							break;
203: 					}
204: 					if ( ! is_null( $option_value ) ) {
205: 						$update_post_options[ $option_name ] = $option_value;
206: 					}
207: 				}
208: 			}
209: 			$product = wc_get_product( $post_id );
210: 			if ( class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions_Product' ) && \WC_Subscriptions_Product::is_subscription( $product ) ) {
211: 				if ( isset( $_POST['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) && 'yes' === $_POST['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) {
212: 					$update_post_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] = 'yes';
213: 				} else {
214: 					$update_post_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] = 'no';
215: 				}
216: 			}
217: 			self::bridge_woo_save_meta( $update_post_options, $post_id, 'product' );
218: 			return true;
219: 		}
220: 	}
221: 	public static function is_valid_to_save_meta() {
222: 		if ( empty( $_POST ) ) {
223: 			return false;
224: 		}
225: 		if ( isset( $_POST['action'] ) && 'handle_product_synchronization' === $_POST['action'] ) {
226: 			return false;
227: 		}
228: 		if ( defined( 'DOING_AUTOSAVE' ) && DOING_AUTOSAVE ) {
229: 			return false;
230: 		}
231: 		return true;
232: 	}
233: 	public function wdm_isset_null( $var ) {

235: 			return $var;
236: 		} else {

238: 		}

240: 	public function bridge_woo_save_meta( $update_post_options, $product_id, $post_type ) {
241: 		global $wpdb;
242: 		$course_id_list = array();
243: 		if ( is_array( $update_post_options ) ) {
244: 			if ( isset( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && is_array( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
245: 				foreach ( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] as $key => $moo_post_course_id ) {
246: 					if ( -1 === intval( $moo_post_course_id ) ) {
247: 						array_splice( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'], $key, 1 );
248: 						continue;
249: 					}
250: 					$moodle_course_id = get_post_meta( $moo_post_course_id, 'moodle_course_id', true );
251: 					array_push( $course_id_list, $moodle_course_id );
252: 					$insert_query = 'INSERT INTO `' . $wpdb->prefix . "eb_moodle_course_products`(`product_id`, `moodle_post_id`, `moodle_course_id` ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT '{$product_id}' as `product_id`, '{$moo_post_course_id}' as `moodle_post_id`, '{$moodle_course_id}' as `moodle_course_id` ) AS tmp
253: 					WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT `product_id`,`moodle_post_id` FROM `" . $wpdb->prefix . "eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `product_id` = '{$product_id}' AND `moodle_post_id` = '{$moo_post_course_id}'
254: 					) LIMIT 1;";
255: 					$wpdb->get_results($insert_query );
256: 				}
257: 				$moo_course_id_list = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
258: 				if ( check_value_set( $moo_course_id_list, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) && is_array( $moo_course_id_list['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
259: 					$course_list_diff = array_diff( $moo_course_id_list['moodle_post_course_id'], $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] );
260: 					if ( is_array( $course_list_diff ) ) {
261: 						if ( 'product_variation' === $post_type ) {
262: 							$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
263: 							$where           = array(
264: 								'product_id'     => $product_id,
265: 								'moodle_post_id' => implode( ',', $course_list_diff ),
266: 							);
267: 							$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
268: 						} else {
269: 							$product_permalink = get_permalink( $product_id );
270: 							foreach ( $course_list_diff as $single_course_diff ) {
271: 								$course_options = get_post_meta( $single_course_diff, 'eb_course_options', true );
272: 								if ( ! empty( $course_options ) && isset( $course_options['course_closed_url'] ) ) {
273: 									if ( 0 === strcmp( $course_options['course_closed_url'], $product_permalink ) ) {
274: 										$course_options['course_closed_url'] = '';
275: 										update_post_meta( $single_course_diff, 'eb_course_options', $course_options );
276: 									}
277: 								}
278: 								$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
279: 								$where           = array(
280: 									'product_id'     => $product_id,
281: 									'moodle_post_id' => $single_course_diff,
282: 								);
283: 								$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
284: 							}
285: 						}
286: 					}
287: 				}
288: 				if ( '-1' != $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) {
289: 					$update_post_options['moodle_course_id'] = implode( ',', $course_id_list );
290: 				} else {
291: 					$update_post_options = '';
292: 				}
293: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $update_post_options );
294: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'is_product_a_moodle_course', 'yes' );
295: 			} else {
296: 				$product_options = array(
297: 					'moodle_post_course_id' => array(),
298: 					'moodle_course_id'      => '',
299: 				);
300: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $product_options );
301: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'is_product_a_moodle_course', 'no' );
302: 			}
303: 		} else {
304: 		}
305: 	}
306: 	public function handle_post_options_delete( $post_id ) {
307: 		global $wpdb;
308: 		$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
309: 		$post_permalink = get_permalink( $post_id );
310: 		if ( 'product' === $post_type ) {
311: 			$query                = "SELECT * FROM `{$wpdb->prefix}eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `product_id` = " . $post_id;
312: 			$linked_course_result = $wpdb->get_results( $query );
313: 			if ( ! empty( $linked_course_result ) ) {
314: 				$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Perform operation on Product delete  ' . $post_id );
315: 				foreach ( $linked_course_result as $single_course_result ) {
316: 					$moodle_post_id = $single_course_result->moodle_post_id;
317: 					$course_options = get_post_meta( $moodle_post_id, 'eb_course_options', true );
318: 					if ( ! empty( $course_options ) ) {
319: 						if ( 0 === strcmp( rtrim( $course_options['course_closed_url'], '/' ), rtrim( $post_permalink, '/' ) ) ) {
320: 							$course_options['course_closed_url'] = '';
321: 							update_post_meta( $moodle_post_id, 'eb_course_options', $course_options );
322: 							$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Course ID ' . $moodle_post_id . ' closed url is reset.' );
323: 						}
324: 					}
325: 				}
326: 				$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
327: 				$where           = array( 'product_id' => $post_id );
328: 				$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
329: 			}
330: 		} elseif ( 'eb_course' === $post_type ) {
331: 			$query          = "SELECT * FROM `{$wpdb->prefix}eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `moodle_post_id` = " . $post_id;
332: 			$product_result = $wpdb->get_results( $query );
333: 			$cur_moodle_course_id = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'moodle_course_id', true );
334: 			if ( ! empty( $product_result ) ) {
335: 				$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Perform operation on Course delete  ' . $post_id );
336: 				foreach ( $product_result as $single_product ) {
337: 					$find_key   = false;
338: 					$product_id = $this->wdm_isset_null( $single_product->product_id );
339: 					if ( ! empty( $product_id ) ) {
340: 						$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
341: 						if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && is_array( $product_options ) ) {
342: 							$moodle_post_id_list = $this->wdm_isset_null( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] );
343: 							if ( ! empty( $moodle_post_id_list ) && is_array( $moodle_post_id_list ) ) {
344: 								$find_key = array_search( $post_id, $moodle_post_id_list );
345: 								if ( is_numeric( $find_key ) ) {
346: 									unset( $moodle_post_id_list[ $find_key ] );
347: 								}
348: 								$product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] = $moodle_post_id_list;
349: 							}
350: 							$course_id_list = isset( $product_options['moodle_course_id'] ) ? $product_options['moodle_course_id'] : '';
351: 							$find_key       = false;
352: 							if ( ! empty( $course_id_list ) ) {
353: 								$course_id_list = explode( ',', $course_id_list );
354: 								$find_key = array_search( $cur_moodle_course_id, $course_id_list ); // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
355: 								if ( is_numeric( $find_key ) ) {
356: 									unset( $course_id_list[ $find_key ] );
357: 								}
358: 								$product_options['moodle_course_id'] = implode( ',', $course_id_list );
359: 							}
360: 						}
361: 						update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $product_options );
362: 						$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Product association is removed for Product ID ' . $product_id );
363: 						if ( empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
364: 							wp_delete_post( $product_id );
365: 							$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Product deleted, Product ID ' . $product_id );
366: 						}
367: 					}
368: 				}
369: 				$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
370: 				$where           = array( 'moodle_post_id' => $post_id );
371: 				$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
372: 			}
373: 		}
374: 	}
375: }

 13: 			global $eb_pro_plugin_data;

 15: 			$this->version     = $eb_pro_plugin_data['plugin_version'];

 18: 			if ( null !== self::$license_data && true === $cache ) {
 19: 				return self::$license_data;
 20: 			}
 21: 			$plugin_name = $plugin_data['plugin_name'];
 22: 			$plugin_slug = $plugin_data['plugin_slug'];
 23: 			$store_url   = $plugin_data['store_url'];
 24: 			$license_transient = get_transient( 'wdm_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_trans' );
 25: 			if ( ! $license_transient ) {
 26: 				$license_key = trim( get_option( 'edd_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_key' ) );
 27: 				if ( $license_key ) {
 28: 					$api_params = array(
 29: 						'edd_action'      => 'check_license',
 30: 						'license'         => $license_key,
 31: 						'item_name'       => rawurlencode( $plugin_name ),
 32: 						'current_version' => $plugin_data['plugin_version'],
 33: 					);
 34: 					$response = wp_remote_get(
 35: 						add_query_arg( $api_params, $store_url ),
 36: 						array(
 37: 							'timeout'   => 15,
 38: 							'sslverify' => true,
 39: 							'blocking'  => true,
 40: 						)
 41: 					);
 42: 					if ( is_wp_error( $response ) ) {
 43: 						return false;
 44: 					}
 45: 					$license_data = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ) );
 46: 					$valid_resp_code = array( '200', '301' );
 47: 					$curr_resp_code = wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response );
 48: 					if ( null === $license_data || ! in_array( $curr_resp_code, $valid_resp_code, true ) ) {
 49: 						$license_status = get_option( 'edd_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_status', '' );
 50: 						if ( empty( $license_data ) ) {
 51: 							set_transient( 'wdm_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_trans', 'server_did_not_respond', 60 * 60 * 24 );
 52: 						}
 53: 					} else {
 54: 						include_once plugin_dir_path( __FILE__ ) . 'class-edwiser-custom-field-add-plugin-data-in-db.php';
 55: 						$license_status = Edwiser_Custom_Field_Add_Plugin_Data_In_Db::update_status( $license_data, $plugin_slug );
 56: 					}
 57: 					$active_site = self::get_site_list( $plugin_slug );
 58: 					self::set_response_data( $license_status, $active_site, $plugin_slug, true );
 59: 					return self::$license_data;
 60: 				}
 61: 			} else {
 62: 				$license_status = get_option( 'edd_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_status' );
 63: 				$active_site    = self::get_site_list( $plugin_slug );
 64: 				self::set_response_data( $license_status, $active_site, $plugin_slug );
 65: 				return self::$license_data;
 66: 			}
 67: 		}
 68: 		public static function get_site_list( $plugin_slug ) {
 69: 			$sites    = get_option( 'eb_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_key_sites' );
 70: 			$max      = get_option( 'eb_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_max_site' );
 71: 			$cur_site = get_site_url();
 72: 			$cur_site = preg_replace( '#^https?://#', '', $cur_site );
 73: 			$site_count  = 0;
 74: 			$active_site = '';
 75: 			if ( ! empty( $sites ) || '' !== $sites ) {
 76: 				foreach ( $sites as $key ) {
 77: 					foreach ( $key as $value ) {
 78: 						$value = rtrim( $value, '/' );
 79: 						if ( 0 !== strcasecmp( $value, $cur_site ) ) {
 80: 							$active_site .= '<li>' . $value . '</li>';
 81: 							++$site_count;
 82: 						}
 83: 					}
 84: 				}
 85: 			}
 86: 			if ( $site_count >= $max ) {
 87: 				return $active_site;
 88: 			} else {
 89: 				return '';
 90: 			}
 91: 		}
 92: 		/**
 93: 		 * Function to add the responce data into the DB.
 94: 		 *
 95: 		 * @param string $license_status License status.
 96: 		 * @param array  $active_site List of the active site.
 97: 		 * @param string $plugin_slug  Plugin slug.
 98: 		 * @param bool   $set_trans Should set transient or not.
 99: 		 */
100: 		public static function set_response_data( $license_status, $active_site, $plugin_slug, $set_trans = false ) {
101: 			if ( 'valid' === $license_status ) {
102: 				self::$license_data = 'available';
103: 			} elseif ( 'expired' === $license_status && ( ! empty( $active_site ) || '' !== $active_site ) ) {
104: 				self::$license_data = 'unavailable';
105: 			} elseif ( 'expired' === $license_status ) {
106: 				self::$license_data = 'available';
107: 			} else {
108: 				self::$license_data = 'unavailable';
109: 			}
110: 			if ( $set_trans ) {
111: 				switch ( $license_status ) {
112: 					case 'invalid':
113: 					case 'no_activations_left':
114: 						$time = 0;
115: 						break;
116: 					case 'failed':
117: 						$time = 86400;
118: 						break;
119: 					case 'expired':
120: 						$time = 86400 * 2;
121: 						break;
122: 					case 'disabled':
123: 						$time = 86400 * 4;
124: 						break;
125: 					case 'valid':
126: 						$time = 86400 * 7;
127: 						break;
128: 					default:
129: 						$time = 86400 * 7;
130: 						break;
131: 				}
132: 				set_transient( 'wdm_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_trans', $license_status, $time );
133: 			}
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: }

```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes;
 3: class Eb_Pro_Loader {
 4: 	protected $actions;
 5: 	protected $filters;
 6: 	public function __construct() {
 7: 		$this->actions = array();
 8: 		$this->filters = array();
 9: 	}
10: 	public function add_action( $hook, $component, $callback, $priority = 10, $accepted_args = 1 ) {
11: 		$this->actions = $this->add( $this->actions, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args );
12: 	}
13: 	public function add_filter( $hook, $component, $callback, $priority = 10, $accepted_args = 1 ) {
14: 		$this->filters = $this->add( $this->filters, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args );
15: 	}
16: 	private function add( $hooks, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args ) {
17: 		$hooks[] = array(
18: 			'hook'          => $hook,
19: 			'component'     => $component,
20: 			'callback'      => $callback,
21: 			'priority'      => $priority,
22: 			'accepted_args' => $accepted_args,
23: 		);
24: 		return $hooks;
25: 	}
26: 	public function run() {
27: 		foreach ( $this->filters as $hook ) {
28: 			add_filter( $hook['hook'], array( $hook['component'], $hook['callback'] ), $hook['priority'], $hook['accepted_args'] );
29: 		}
30: 		foreach ( $this->actions as $hook ) {
31: 			add_action( $hook['hook'], array( $hook['component'], $hook['callback'] ), $hook['priority'], $hook['accepted_args'] );
32: 		}
33: 	}
34: }

 51: 			$this->slug     = basename( $_plugin_file, '.php' );
 52: 			$this->version  = $_api_data['version'];

113: 			);
114: 			$request    = wp_remote_post(
115: 				$this->api_url,
116: 				array(
117: 					'timeout'    => 15,
118: 					'sslverify'  => false,
119: 					'body'       => $api_params,
120: 					'user-agent' => 'WordPress/' . get_bloginfo( 'version' ) . '; ' . get_bloginfo( 'url' ) . ' Edwiser Bridge Pro Update Check',
121: 				)
122: 			);
123: 			if ( ! is_wp_error( $request ) ) {
124: 				$request = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $request ) );
125: 				if ( $request && isset( $request->sections ) ) {
126: 					$request->sections = maybe_unserialize( $request->sections );
127: 				}
128: 				self::$response_data = $request;
129: 				return $request;
130: 			} else {
131: 				self::$response_data = false;
132: 				return false;
133: 			}
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: }
```

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/public/assets/js/bridge-woocommerce-public.js
```javascript
 1: jQuery(document).ready(function($){
 2: 	if (jQuery('#wi-thanq-wrapper').length) {
 3: 		wiThankYouRedirection();
 4: 	}
 5: 	if (jQuery('.wi-scc-wrapper').length) {
 6: 		if (jQuery('#wi-scc-url').length) {
 7: 			$('input[name="redirect"]').val(jQuery('#wi-scc-url').val());
 8: 			$('input[name="_wp_http_referer"]').val(jQuery('#wi-scc-url').val());
 9: 		}
10: 	}
11: 	$('#purchase-for-someone-else-checkbox').on('change', function(){
12: 		if ($(this).is(':checked')) {
13: 			$('.eb-purchase-for-someone-else').show();
14: 		} else {
15: 			$('.eb-purchase-for-someone-else').hide();
16: 		}
17: 	});
18: });
19: function wiThankYouRedirection()
20: {
21: 	var countDownElement = document.getElementById("wi-countdown");
22: 	var counter = 10;
23: 	var id = wiCountDown(countDownElement, counter);
24: 	jQuery(document).on('click', '#wi-cancel-redirect', function(){
25: 		if (jQuery(this).attr('data-wi-auto-redirect') === 'on') {
26:         	jQuery(this).attr('data-wi-auto-redirect', 'off');
27:         	jQuery(this).text(wiPublic.resume);
28:         	clearInterval(id);
29:         } else {
30:         	jQuery(this).attr('data-wi-auto-redirect', 'on');
31:         	jQuery(this).text(wiPublic.cancel);
32:         	id = wiCountDown(countDownElement, jQuery(countDownElement).text());
33:         }
34: 	});
35: }
36: function wiCountDown(countDownElement, counter)
37: {
38: 	var id = setInterval(function() {
39: 	    counter--;
40: 	    if(counter < 0) {
41: 	        clearInterval(id);
42: 	        if (jQuery('#wi-cancel-redirect').attr('data-wi-auto-redirect') === 'on') {
43: 	        	window.location.href = wiPublic.myCoursesUrl;
44: 	        }
45: 	    } else {
46: 	    	jQuery(countDownElement).text(counter.toString());
47: 	    }
48: 	}, 1000);
49: 	return id;
50: }

```javascript
 1: const { registerBlockType } = wp.blocks;
 2: const { Button } = wp.components;
 3: const { createElement: el } = wp.element;
 4: const { doAction } = wp.hooks;
 5: registerBlockType('edwiser-bridge-pro/eb-pro-checkout-page-block', {
 6:     title: 'Edwiser Bridge Pro Checkout Page Block',
 7:     icon: 'smiley',
 8:     category: 'common',
 9:     edit: () => {
10:         const onClickHandler = () => {
11:             doAction('eb_pro_checkout_page_block_hook');
12:         };
13:         return el(
14:             'div',
15:             null,
16:             'Edwiser Bridge Pro Checkout Page Block',
17:             el(
18:                 Button,
19:                 { onClick: onClickHandler },
20:                 ' '
21:             )
22:         );
23:     },
24:     save: () => {
25:         return el(
26:             'div',
27:             { className: 'eb-pro-checkout-page-block' },
28:             'Edwiser Bridge Pro Checkout Page Block'
29:         );
30:     },
31: });

 792: 			function return_set_of_array(obj, from, offset) {
 793: 				var arr = [];

 795: 					arr.push( obj[i] );
 796: 				}

 799: 			function enroll_csv_users_recursively(cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users) {
 800: 				offset = 5;
 801: 				if (processed_users + offset >= total) {
 802: 					offset = total - processed_users;
 803: 				}
 804: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_processed_users_count' ).html( processed_users );
 805: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_total_users_count' ).html( total );
 806: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_users_progress_percent' ).html( Math.round( processed_users * 100 / total ) + '%' );
 807: 				$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).show();
 808: 				$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
 809: 				jQuery.ajax(
 810: 					{
 811: 						type: 'POST',
 812: 						url: ebbpPublic.ajax_url,
 813: 						dataType: 'json',
 814: 						data: {
 815: 							action: 'create_wordpress_user',
 816: 							mdl_cohort_id: cohortId,
 817: 							cohortName: cohortName,
 818: 							firstname: return_set_of_array( firstname, processed_users, offset ),
 819: 							lastname: return_set_of_array( lastname, processed_users, offset ),
 820: 							email: return_set_of_array( email, processed_users, offset ),
 821: 							processed_users: processed_users,
 822: 							total: total,
 823: 							nonce_bp_enroll: ebbpPublic.nonce_bp_enroll,
 824: 						},
 825: 						success: function (response) {
 826: 							var data = response.data;
 827: 							if (response.success == true) {
 828: 								processed_users = processed_users + data.processed_users;
 829: 								if (processed_users < total) {
 830: 									enroll_csv_users_recursively( cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users );
 831: 								} else {
 832: 									jQuery( "#wdm_user_delete_msg" ).html( data.msg );
 833: 									$( "#wdm-eb-enroll-msg" ).css( "display", "none" );
 834: 									$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
 835: 									jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
 836: 									$( ".wdm_success_message" ).css( "display", "block" );
 837: 									$( '#edb_course_product_name' ).find( ":selected" ).text( data.cohort );
 838: 									getEnrolledUsers( 1 );
 839: 								}
 840: 							} else {
 841: 								errorMsgDialog( data );
 842: 							}
 843: 						},
 844: 						error: function (error) {
 845: 							errorMsgDialog( error );
 846: 							$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
 847: 							jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
 848: 							$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
 849: 						}
 850: 					}
 851: 				);
 852: 			}

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/public/shortcodes/class-bridge-woocommerce-shortcode-associated-courses.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\pb;
 3: use \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\Eb_Template_Loader;
 4: use \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\EdwiserBridge;
 5: class Bridge_Woocommerce_Shortcode_Associated_Courses {
 6: 	public static function get( $atts ) {
 7: 		return Bridge_Woocommerce_Shortcodes::shortcode_wrapper( array( __CLASS__, 'output' ), $atts );
 8: 	}
 9: 	public static function output( $atts ) {
10: 		include_once EB_PRO_PLUGIN_PATH . 'includes/woo-int/class-bridge-woo-functions.php';
11: 		require_once WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/edwiser-bridge/public/class-eb-template-loader.php';
12: 		extract( shortcode_atts( array( 'product_id' => '' ), $atts ) ); // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
13: 		$edwiser_bridge = new EdwiserBridge();
14: 		$plugin_tpl_loader = new Eb_Template_Loader( $edwiser_bridge->getPluginName(), $edwiser_bridge->getVersion() );
15: 		if ( empty( $product_id ) ) {
16: 			$product_id = '';
17: 		}
18: 		$plugin_tpl_loader->wpGetTemplate(
19: 			'associated-courses-product-page.php',
20: 			array(
21: 				'product_id' => $product_id,
22: 			),
23: 			'',
24: 			EB_PRO_PLUGIN_PATH . 'public/templates/'
25: 		);
26: 	}
27: }
```

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/public/shortcodes/class-sso-social-login.php
```php
  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\sso;
  3: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
  4: 	exit( 'This is not the way to call me!' );
  5: }
  6: class Sso_Social_Login {
  7: 	private $version;
  8: 	private $plugin_name;
  9: 	public function __construct( $plugin_name, $version ) {
 10: 		$this->plugin_name = $plugin_name;
 11: 		$this->version     = $version;
 12: 	}
 13: 	public function ebsso_check_if_google_plus_enabled() {
 14: 		$keys   = array(
 15: 			'eb_sso_gp_client_id',
 16: 			'eb_sso_gp_secret_key',
 17: 			'eb_sso_gp_enable',
 18: 		);
 19: 		$option = $this->get_setting_data( $keys );
 20: 		if ( false === $option || ! $this->check_is_social_login_enabled( $option, 'eb_sso_gp_enable' ) ) {
 21: 			return false;
 22: 		}
 23: 		return true;
 24: 	}
 25: 	public function ebsso_check_if_fb_enabled() {
 26: 		$keys   = array(
 27: 			'eb_sso_fb_app_id',
 28: 			'eb_sso_fb_app_secret_key',
 29: 			'eb_sso_fb_enable',
 30: 		);
 31: 		$option = $this->get_setting_data( $keys );
 32: 		if ( false === $option || ! $this->check_is_social_login_enabled( $option, 'eb_sso_fb_enable' ) ) {
 33: 			return false;
 34: 		}
 35: 		return true;
 36: 	}
 37: 	private function get_setting_data( $keys = array() ) {
 38: 		$option = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 39: 		if ( false !== $option ) {
 40: 			foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
 41: 				if ( ! $this->check_is_set( $option, $key ) ) {
 42: 					$option = false;
 43: 				}
 44: 			}
 45: 		}
 46: 		return $option;
 47: 	}
 48: 	private function check_is_set( $data, $key ) {
 49: 		$value = false;
 50: 		if ( isset( $data[ $key ] ) ) {
 51: 			$value = trim( $data[ $key ] );
 52: 		}
 53: 		if ( empty( $value ) ) {
 54: 			$value = false;
 55: 		}
 56: 		return $value;
 57: 	}
 58: 	private function check_is_social_login_enabled( $data, $key ) {
 59: 		if ( isset( $data[ $key ] ) && 'no' === $data[ $key ] ) {
 60: 			return false;
 61: 		}
 62: 		return true;
 63: 	}
 64: 	public function output( $attr ) {
 65: 		$google_login = new Sso_Google_Plus_Init( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
 66: 		$fb_login     = new Sso_Facebook_Init( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
 67: 		$sso_settings = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 68: 		if ( ! isset( $attr['page'] ) ) {
 69: 			$attr = array(
 70: 				'page' => 'shortcode',
 71: 			);
 72: 		}
 73: 		if ( is_user_logged_in() ) {
 74: 			return;

357:                                         }
358:                                     } elseif( count( $courses ) > 1 ){
359:                                         $has_access = true;

363:                                             if ( ! $user_has_access ) {

365:                                                 break;

367:                                         }
368:                                         if ( $has_access ) {

 74: 					}

 76: 					wp_localize_script( 'bridge_woo_variation_courses', 'bridge_woo_courses', $variation_settings );

140: 	public function configure_woocommerce_checkout( $checkout ) {
141: 		// Unnecessary var.

143: 		if ( ! \WC_Checkout::instance()->enable_signup || \WC_Checkout::instance()->enable_guest_checkout ) {
144: 			foreach ( WC()->cart->get_cart() as $cart_item_key => $values ) {
145: 				unset( $cart_item_key );
146: 				$_product = $values['data'];
147: 				$product_id = ( isset( $_product->variation_id ) ? $_product->variation_id : $_product->id );
148: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
149: 				if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {

157: 	public function add_woocomerce_orders_to_user_account_page( $user_orders ) {
158: 		if ( ! is_user_logged_in() || is_admin() ) {
159: 			return;
160: 		}
161: 		global $post;
162: 		$content = $post->post_content;
163: 		if ( ! has_shortcode( $content, 'eb_user_account' ) ) {
164: 			return;
165: 		}
166: 		$wc_order_statuses = wc_get_order_statuses();
167: 		$customer_orders = get_posts(
168: 			array(
169: 				'numberposts' => -1,
170: 				'meta_key'    => '_customer_user',
171: 				'meta_value'  => get_current_user_id(),
172: 				'post_type'   => wc_get_order_types(),
173: 				'post_status' => is_array( $wc_order_statuses ) ? array_keys( $wc_order_statuses ) : array(),
174: 			)
175: 		);
176: 		$woo_orders  = $this->get_users_woocommerce_orders( $customer_orders );
177: 		$user_orders = array_merge( $user_orders, $woo_orders );
178: 		return $user_orders;
179: 	}
180: 	public function get_users_woocommerce_orders( $customer_orders ) {
181: 		$course_associated_orders = array();
182: 		foreach ( $customer_orders as $key => $order_object ) {
183: 			$formatted_order_data = array();
184: 			if ( 'shop_subscription' === $order_object->post_type ) {
185: 				$formatted_order_data = array();
186: 				continue;
187: 			}
188: 			$formatted_order_data['order_id']    = $order_object->ID;
189: 			$formatted_order_data['eb_order_id'] = $order_object->ID;
190: 			$order                               = wc_get_order( $order_object->ID );
191: 			$formatted_order_data['status']      = $order->get_status();
192: 			$formatted_order_data['amount_paid'] = $order->get_formatted_order_total();
193: 			$order_data                            = $order->get_data();
194: 			$formatted_order_data['billing_email'] = $order_data['billing']['email'];
195: 			$formatted_order_data['currency']      = $order_data['currency'];
196: 			$formatted_order_data['date']          = $order_data['date_created']->date( 'Y-m-d' );
197: 			$ordered_items                        = $order->get_items();
198: 			$formatted_order_data['ordered_item'] = array();
199: 			foreach ( $ordered_items as $key => $product_item ) {
200: 				$product_id = $product_item->get_product_id();
201: 				$variation_id = $product_item->get_variation_id();
202: 				if ( 0 !== $variation_id ) {
203: 					$product_id = $variation_id;
204: 				}
205: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
206: 				if ( false === $product_options || empty( $product_options ) ) {
207: 					continue;
208: 				} elseif ( ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
209: 					$formatted_order_data['ordered_item'] = array_merge( $formatted_order_data['ordered_item'], $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] );
210: 				}
211: 			}
212: 			$course_associated_orders[] = $formatted_order_data;
213: 			$formatted_order_data       = array();
214: 		}
215: 		return $course_associated_orders;
216: 	}

269: 	public static function get_buy_now_button( $args ) {
270: 		$eb_general = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
271: 		$buy_now_enabled = isset( $eb_general['wi_enable_buynow'] ) && 'yes' === $eb_general['wi_enable_buynow'] ? true : false;
272: 		if ( ! $buy_now_enabled ) {
273: 			return '';
274: 		}
275: 		$args = wp_parse_args(
276: 			$args,
277: 			array(
278: 				'product' => null,
279: 				'class'   => 'button',
280: 			)
281: 		);
282: 		extract( $args );
283: 		$eb_general = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
284: 		if ( isset( $eb_general['wi_buy_now_text'] ) && ! empty( $eb_general['wi_buy_now_text'] ) ) {
285: 			$buy_now_text = $eb_general['wi_buy_now_text'];
286: 		} else {
287: 			$buy_now_text = __( 'Buy Now', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
288: 		}
289: 		$html = '';
290: 		if ( null === $product || ! $product->is_purchasable() ) {
291: 			return '';
292: 		}
293: 		$link   = self::get_product_add_to_cart_link( $product, 1 );
294: 		$_id    = 'wi_buy_now_' . $product->get_id();
295: 		$_class = 'wi_btn_buy_now button wi_buy_now_' . $product->get_type() . ' ' . $class;
296: 		if ( is_product() ) {
297: 			$_class .= ' wi_product';
298: 		}
299: 		$_attrs = 'data-product_type="' . $product->get_type() . '" data-product_id="' . $product->get_id() . '"';
300: 		$html  .= '<a href="' . $link . '" id="' . $_id . '" ' . $_attrs . '  class="' . $_class . '">';
301: 		$html  .= $buy_now_text;
302: 		$html  .= '</a>';
303: 		return $html;
304: 	}
305: 	public static function get_product_add_to_cart_link( $product, $qty = 1 ) {
306: 		if ( 'simple' === $product->get_type() ) {
307: 			$link = $product->add_to_cart_url();
308: 			$link = add_query_arg( 'quantity', $qty, $link );
309: 			$link = add_query_arg( 'wi_buy_now', true, $link );
310: 			return $link;
311: 		}
312: 	}

350: 	public function wi_add_purchase_for_someone_else_input_fields( $checkout ) {

352: 		$products = array();
353: 		foreach ( $cart_items as $cart_item ) {
354: 			if ( isset( $cart_item['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll'] ) && 'on' == $cart_item['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll'] ) {
355: 				return;
356: 			}
357: 			$products[] = $cart_item['data'];
358: 		}
359: 		foreach ( $products as $product ) {
360: 			$product_id      = $product->get_id();
361: 			$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
362: 			$group_purchase  = 'off';
363: 			$list_of_courses = array();
364: 			if ( includes\wooInt\check_value_set( $product_options, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) ) {
365: 				$line_item_course_ids = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
366: 				if ( ! empty( $list_of_courses ) ) {
367: 					$list_of_courses = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_courses, $line_item_course_ids ), SORT_REGULAR );
368: 				} else {
369: 					$list_of_courses = $line_item_course_ids;
370: 				}
371: 			} else {
372: 				return;
373: 			}
374: 		}
375: 		if ( empty( $list_of_courses ) ) {
376: 			return;
377: 		}
378: 		?>
379: 		<h3 id="purchase-for-someone-else">
380: 			<label class="woocommerce-form__label woocommerce-form__label-for-checkbox checkbox">
381: 				<input id="purchase-for-someone-else-checkbox" class="woocommerce-form__input woocommerce-form__input-checkbox input-checkbox" type="checkbox" name="purchase_for_someone_else" value="1" style="border: 1px solid rgb(0, 0, 0);">

387: 			<input type="text" class="input-text" name="recipient_first_name" id="recipient_first_name" placeholder="" value="" />
388: 		</p>
389: 		<p class="form-row form-row-wide eb-purchase-for-someone-else" id="order_comments_field">
390: 			<label for="order_comments" class=""><?php esc_html_e( 'Last Name', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?><abbr class="required" title="required">*</abbr></label>
391: 			<input type="text" class="input-text" name="recipient_last_name" id="recipient_last_name" placeholder="" value="" />
392: 		</p>
393: 		<p class="form-row form-row-wide eb-purchase-for-someone-else" id="order_comments_field">
394: 			<label for="order_comments" class=""><?php esc_html_e( 'Email', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?><abbr class="required" title="required">*</abbr></label>
395: 			<input type="text" class="input-text" name="recipient_email" id="recipient_email" placeholder="" value="" />

404: 	public function wi_validate_purchase_for_someone_else_input_fields() {

406: 		$purchase_for_someone_else_enabled = isset( $eb_general['wi_enable_purchase_for_someone_else'] ) && 'yes' === $eb_general['wi_enable_purchase_for_someone_else'] ? true : false;
407: 		$is_for_someone_else = isset( $_POST['purchase_for_someone_else'] ) && '1' === $_POST['purchase_for_someone_else'] ? true : false; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
408: 		if ( $purchase_for_someone_else_enabled && $is_for_someone_else ) {
409: 			if ( ( isset( $_POST['recipient_first_name'] ) && empty( $_POST['recipient_first_name'] ) ) || ! isset( $_POST['recipient_first_name'] ) ) { // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
410: 				wc_add_notice( '<b>' . esc_html__( 'First Name', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</b>' . esc_html__( ' is a required field.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), 'error' );

413: 				wc_add_notice( '<b>' . esc_html__( 'Last Name', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</b>' . esc_html__( ' is a required field.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), 'error' );
414: 			}
415: 			if ( ( isset( $_POST['recipient_email'] ) && empty( $_POST['recipient_email'] ) ) || ! isset( $_POST['recipient_email'] ) ) { // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
416: 				wc_add_notice( '<b>' . esc_html__( 'Email', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</b>' . esc_html__( ' is a required field.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), 'error' );
417: 			}
418: 		}
419: 	}

 291: 	private function get_user_roles( $user ) {
 292: 		$user_role = $user->roles;
 293: 		$str       = '';
 294: 		$count     = count( $user_role );
 295: 		for ( $i = 0; $i < $count; $i++ ) {
 296: 			$str .= 0 !== $i ? ', ' : '';
 297: 			$str .= 'non_editing_teacher' === $user_role[ $i ] ? 'Non Editing Teacher' : $user_role[ $i ];
 298: 		}
 299: 		return $str;
 300: 	}
 301: 	public function wdm_get_enroll_user_details() {
 302: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'wdm_eb_gp_mng_nonce' ) ) {
 303: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Security check failed try reloading page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
 304: 		}
 305: 		$uid       = isset( $_POST['uid'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['uid'] ) ) : '';
 306: 		$uid       = trim( $uid );
 307: 		$user_data = get_userdata( $uid );
 308: 		$roles     = $user_data->roles;
 309: 		$user_role = 'Manager';
 310: 		foreach ( $roles as $role ) {
 311: 			if ( 'subscriber' === $role ) {
 312: 				$user_role = 'student';
 313: 				break;
 314: 			}
 315: 		}
 316: 		echo wp_json_encode(
 317: 			array(
 318: 				'FirstName' => $user_data->first_name,
 319: 				'lastname'  => $user_data->last_name,
 320: 				'email'     => $user_data->user_email,
 321: 				'role'      => $user_role,
 322: 			)
 323: 		);
 324: 		die();
 325: 	}

 369: 	public function wdm_bp_edit_user() {
 370: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'wdm_eb_gp_mng_nonce' ) ) {
 371: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Security check failed try reloading page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
 372: 		}
 373: 		$post_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
 374: 		$uid       = $this->check_data( $post_data, 'uid' );
 375: 		$fnane     = $this->check_data( $post_data, 'firstname' );
 376: 		$lname     = $this->check_data( $post_data, 'lastname' );
 377: 		$email     = $this->check_data( $post_data, 'email' );
 378: 		if ( $uid && $fnane && $lname && $email ) {
 379: 			$user_data = array(
 380: 				'ID'         => $uid,
 381: 				'first_name' => $fnane,
 382: 				'last_name'  => $lname,
 383: 				'user_email' => $email,
 384: 			);
 385: 			$update_user = wp_update_user( $user_data );
 386: 			if ( is_wp_error( $update_user ) ) {
 387: 				wp_send_json_error( $this->prepare_res_msg( $update_user->get_error_message(), true ) );
 388: 			} else {
 389: 				$mdl_user_id = get_user_meta( trim( $post_data['uid'] ), 'moodle_user_id', true );
 390: 				$user_data   = array(
 391: 					'id'        => $mdl_user_id,
 392: 					'firstname' => $fnane,
 393: 					'lastname'  => $lname,
 394: 					'email'     => $email,
 395: 				);
 396: 				$mdl_user_updated = edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->userManager()->createMoodleUser( $user_data, 1 );
 397: 				if ( 1 === $mdl_user_updated['user_updated'] ) {
 398: 					wp_send_json_success( $this->prepare_res_msg( __( 'User data has been updated successfully.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), false ) );
 399: 				} else {
 400: 					wp_send_json_error( $this->prepare_res_msg( __( 'Failed to update user on moodle.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), true ) );
 401: 				}
 402: 			}
 403: 		} else {
 404: 			wp_send_json_error( $this->prepare_res_msg( __( 'User data is inappropriate.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), true ) );
 405: 		}
 406: 	}
 407: 	private function prepare_res_msg( $msg, $is_error = false ) {
 408: 		ob_start();
 409: 		if ( ! $is_error ) {
 410: 			?>
 411: 			<div class="wdm_success_message wdm_user_list">
 412: 				<i class="dashicons dashicons-dismiss wdm_success_msg_dismiss"></i>
 413: 				<span class="wdm_enroll_warning_message_lable">
 414: 					<?php echo esc_html( $msg ); ?>
 415: 				</span>
 416: 			</div>
 417: 			<?php
 418: 		} else {
 419: 			?>
 420: 			<div class="wdm_error_message wdm_user_list">
 421: 				<i class="dashicons dashicons-dismiss wdm_error_msg_dismiss"></i>
 422: 				<span class="wdm_enroll_warning_message_lable">
 423: 					<?php echo esc_html( $msg ); ?>
 424: 				</span>
 425: 			</div>
 426: 			<?php
 427: 		}
 428: 		return ob_get_clean();
 429: 	}
 430: 	private function check_data( $array, $key ) {
 431: 		if ( isset( $array[ $key ] ) && ! empty( $array[ $key ] ) ) {
 432: 			return $array[ $key ];
 433: 		}
 434: 		return false;
 435: 	}
 436: 	public function wdm_add_to_cart() {
 437: 		$session_data = array();
 438: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) ), 'wdm_eb_gp_mng_nonce' ) ) {
 439: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Security check failed try reloading page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
 440: 		}
 441: 		if ( WC()->session->get( 'add_product_from_enroll_page' ) ) {
 442: 			$session_data = WC()->session->get( 'add_product_from_enroll_page' );
 443: 		}
 444: 		$req_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
 445: 		if ( isset( $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] ) && ! empty( $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] ) && isset( $req_data['productQuantity'] ) && ! empty( $req_data['productQuantity'] ) ) {
 446: 			global $woocommerce;
 447: 			$checkout_url   = '#';
 448: 			$cohort_id      = $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'];
 449: 			$cohort_details = array( 'cohort_id' => $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] );
 450: 			$flag           = 0;
 451: 			foreach ( $req_data['productQuantity'] as $value ) {
 452: 				if ( $value <= 0 ) {
 453: 					$flag = 1;
 454: 				}
 455: 			}
 456: 			if ( ! $flag ) {
 457: 				foreach ( $req_data['productQuantity'] as $prod_id => $qty ) {
 458: 					$cohort_details['product_id'] = $prod_id;
 459: 					$cohort_details['quantity']   = $qty;
 460: 					$woocommerce->cart->add_to_cart(
 461: 						$prod_id,
 462: 						$qty,
 463: 						'',
 464: 						array(),
 465: 						array(
 466: 							'cohort_id'               => $cohort_id,
 467: 							'wdm_edwiser_self_enroll' => 'on',
 468: 							'Group Enrollment'        => 'yes',
 469: 							'enroll-students'         => 'yes',
 470: 							'wdm_edwiser_self_enroll_checkbox' => 'on',
 471: 						)
 472: 					);
 473: 					array_push( $session_data, $cohort_details );
 474: 				}
 475: 				$checkout_url = wc_get_checkout_url();
 476: 			}
 477: 		}
 478: 		if ( empty( $checkout_url ) ) {
 479: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Checkout page not found, Please contact admin', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
 480: 		}
 481: 		wp_send_json_success( $checkout_url );
 482: 	}

1093: 	public function wdm_create_new_group() {
1094: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) ), 'wdm_eb_gp_mng_nonce' ) ) {
1095: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Security check failed try reloading page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
1096: 		}
1097: 		$post_data      = wp_unslash( $_POST );
1098: 		$cohort_name    = isset( $post_data['group_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $post_data['group_name'] ) : '';
1099: 		$user           = wp_get_current_user();
1100: 		$cohort_manager = isset( $post_data['cohort_manager'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $post_data['cohort_manager'] ) : $user->ID;
1101: 		$products_data  = isset( $post_data['products'] ) ? $post_data['products'] : array();
1102: 		$products       = array();
1103: 		$courses        = array();
1104: 		foreach ( $products_data as $product_id => $quantity ) {
1105: 			$products[ $product_id ] = $quantity;
1106: 			$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
1107: 			if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
1108: 				$moodle_courses = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
1109: 				if ( ! empty( $courses ) ) {
1110: 					$courses = array_unique( array_merge( $courses, $moodle_courses ), SORT_REGULAR );
1111: 				} else {
1112: 					$courses = $moodle_courses;
1113: 				}
1114: 			}
1115: 		}
1116: 		$cohort_manage = new includes\bulkPurchase\Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
1117: 		$cohort_manage->update_cohort_info(
1118: 			$courses,
1119: 			'',
1120: 			$cohort_manager,
1121: 			$products,
1122: 			$cohort_name,
1123: 			false,
1124: 			$cohort_name
1125: 		);
1126: 		global $wpdb;
1127: 		$tbl_name    = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
1128: 		$result      = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE NAME = %s AND COHORT_MANAGER = %d", $cohort_name, $cohort_manager ), ARRAY_A );
1129: 		$idnumber    = isset( $result['idnumber'] ) ? $result['idnumber'] : '';
1130: 		$cohort_name = isset( $result['COHORT_NAME'] ) && ! empty( $result['COHORT_NAME'] ) ? $result['COHORT_NAME'] : str_replace( $user->user_login . '_', '', $cohort_name );
1131: 		$response = $cohort_manage->mdl_create_cohort( $cohort_manager, $cohort_name, $idnumber );
1132: 		if ( isset( $response['success'] ) && $response['success'] ) {
1133: 			$cohort_id = $response['response_data'][0]->id;
1134: 			$this->enroll_courses_in_cohort( $cohort_id, $courses );
1135: 			$nonce    = wp_create_nonce( 'eb-bp-edit-group' );
1136: 			$url      = admin_url( 'edit.php?post_type=eb_course&page=eb-manage-groups&mdl_cohort_id=' . $cohort_id . '&eb-bp-edit-group=' . $nonce );
1137: 			$response = array(
1138: 				'msg'          => __( 'Group created successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
1139: 				'redirect_url' => $url,
1140: 			);
1141: 			$cohort_manager = get_user_by( 'id', $cohort_manager );
1142: 			$email_args     = array(
1143: 				'user_email' => $cohort_manager->user_email,
1144: 				'username'   => $cohort_manager->user_login,
1145: 				'first_name' => $cohort_manager->first_name,
1146: 				'last_name'  => $cohort_manager->last_name,
1147: 				'products'   => $products,
1148: 				'courses'    => $courses,
1149: 				'group_name' => isset( $post_data['group_name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $post_data['group_name'] ) : '',
1150: 			);
1151: 			do_action( 'eb_bp_new_group_creation', $email_args );
1152: 			wp_send_json_success( $response );
1153: 		} else {
1154: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Group creation failed', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
1155: 		}
1156: 	}

1163: 	}
