1176: 	public function wdm_add_product_in_group() {
1177: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce_gp_mng'] ) ), 'wdm_eb_gp_mng_nonce' ) ) {
1178: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Security check failed try reloading page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
1179: 		}
1180: 		$req_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
1181: 		if ( isset( $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] ) && ! empty( $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] ) && isset( $req_data['productQuantity'] ) && ! empty( $req_data['productQuantity'] ) && isset( $req_data['type'] ) ) {
1182: 			$cohort_id = intval( $req_data['mdl_cohort_id'] );
1183: 			global $wpdb;
1184: 			$tbl_name        = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
1185: 			$result          = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT PRODUCTS, COURSES FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d;", $cohort_id ) );
1186: 			$products        = maybe_unserialize( $result[0]->PRODUCTS );
1187: 			$courses         = maybe_unserialize( $result[0]->COURSES );
1188: 			$removed_courses = array();
1189: 			$flag = 0;
1190: 			foreach ( $req_data['productQuantity'] as $product_id => $quantity ) {
1191: 				if ( $quantity <= 0 ) {
1192: 					$flag = 1;
1193: 				} else {
1194: 					$type            = $req_data['type'];
1195: 					$product_removed = false;
1196: 					if ( 'remove-quantity' === $type ) {
1197: 						$products[ $product_id ] = $products[ $product_id ] - $quantity;
1198: 						if ( $products[ $product_id ] <= 0 ) {
1199: 							unset( $products[ $product_id ] );
1200: 							$product_removed = true;
1201: 						}
1202: 					} elseif ( 'quantity' === $type || 'product' === $type ) {
1203: 						if ( isset( $products[ $product_id ] ) ) {
1204: 							$products[ $product_id ] = $products[ $product_id ] + $quantity;
1205: 						} else {
1206: 							$products[ $product_id ] = $quantity;
1207: 						}
1208: 					} elseif ( 'remove-product' === $type ) {
1209: 						unset( $products[ $product_id ] );
1210: 						$product_removed = true;
1211: 					} else {
1212: 						$products[ $product_id ] = $quantity;
1213: 					}
1214: 					$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
1215: 					if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
1216: 						$moodle_courses = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
1217: 						if ( ! empty( $courses ) ) {
1218: 							if ( $product_removed ) {
1219: 								$courses = array_diff( $courses, $moodle_courses );
1220: 							} else {
1221: 								$courses = array_unique( array_merge( $courses, $moodle_courses ), SORT_REGULAR );
1222: 							}
1223: 						} else {
1224: 							if ( ! $product_removed ) {
1225: 								$courses = $moodle_courses;
1226: 							}
1227: 						}
1228: 						if ( $product_removed ) {
1229: 							$removed_courses = array_merge( $removed_courses, $moodle_courses );
1230: 						}
1231: 					}
1232: 				}
1233: 			}
1234: 			if ( ! $flag && ! empty( $products ) ) {
1235: 				$wpdb->update(
1236: 					$tbl_name,
1237: 					array(
1238: 						'PRODUCTS' => maybe_serialize( $products ),
1239: 						'COURSES'  => maybe_serialize( $courses ),
1240: 					),
1241: 					array( 'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id )
1242: 				);
1243: 				if ( 'products' === $req_data['type'] ) {
1244: 					$this->enroll_courses_in_cohort( $cohort_id, $courses );
1245: 				}
1246: 				if ( $product_removed ) {
1247: 					$this->unenroll_cohort_from_course( $cohort_id, $removed_courses );
1248: 				}
1249: 				wp_send_json_success( __( 'Products updated successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
1250: 			} else {
1251: 				wp_send_json_error( __( 'All Products can not be removed from Group', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
1252: 			}
1253: 		}
1254: 	}

182: 	private function cart_item_qty_eql() {
183: 		global $woocommerce;
184: 		$items    = $woocommerce->cart->get_cart();
185: 		$quantity = array();
186: 		foreach ( $items as $item => $values ) {
187: 			$product_id = $values['product_id'];
188: 			$_product = wc_get_product( $values['product_id'] );
189: 			if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $values['variation_id'] ) ) {
190: 				$product_id = $values['variation_id'];
191: 			}
192: 			$item = $item;
193: 			if ( 'on' === $values['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll'] ) {
194: 				$quantity[ $product_id ] = $values['quantity'];
195: 			}
196: 		}
197: 		if ( 1 !== count( array_unique( $quantity ) ) ) {
198: 			return false;
199: 		}
200: 		return true;
201: 	}

207: 		$msg   .= '<ui>';

220: 	private function check_ebbp_prod_opt_reuse_qty() {
221: 		global $woocommerce;
222: 		$items                  = $woocommerce->cart->get_cart();
223: 		$prod_without_reuse_qty = array();
224: 		foreach ( $items as $item => $values ) {
225: 			$item         = $item;
226: 			$prod_options = get_post_meta( $values['product_id'], 'product_options', 1 );
227: 			if ( ! isset( $prod_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) || 'on' !== $prod_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) {
228: 				array_push( $prod_without_reuse_qty, $values['product_id'] );
229: 			}
230: 		}
231: 		if ( count( $prod_without_reuse_qty ) >= 1 && count( $prod_without_reuse_qty ) !== count( $items ) ) {
232: 			$msg  = __( "Created group will not allow you to reuse the quantity if the users are unenrolled from group as there are some products which don't allow you to reuse quantity which are listed below:", 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
233: 			$msg .= '<ul>';
234: 			foreach ( $prod_without_reuse_qty as $prod_id ) {
235: 				$msg .= '<li>' . get_the_title( $prod_id );
236: 			}
237: 			$msg .= '</ul>';
238: 			return array(
239: 				'status' => '0',
240: 				'msg'    => $msg,
241: 			);
242: 		}
243: 		return array( 'status' => '1' );
244: 	}

296: 	public function check_group_purchase( $cart_updated ) {
297: 		global $woocommerce;
298: 		$items    = $woocommerce->cart->get_cart();
299: 		$quantity = array();
300: 		foreach ( $items as $item => $values ) {
301: 			$product_id = $values['product_id'];
302: 			$_product = wc_get_product( $values['product_id'] );
303: 			$pmeta    = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
304: 			if ( isset( $pmeta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) && 'on' === $pmeta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
305: 				if ( isset( $woocommerce->cart->cart_contents[ $item ]['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll_checkbox'] ) ) {
306: 					$checkbox = $woocommerce->cart->cart_contents[ $item ]['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll_checkbox'];
307: 				} else {
308: 					$checkbox = 'no';
309: 				}
310: 				if ( isset( $values['quantity'] ) && $values['quantity'] > 1 ) {
311: 					$woocommerce->cart->cart_contents[ $item ]['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll'] = ( isset( $values['quantity'] ) && $values['quantity'] > 1 ) ? 'on' : 'no';
312: 				} else {
313: 					$woocommerce->cart->cart_contents[ $item ]['wdm_edwiser_self_enroll'] = ( isset( $checkbox ) && 'on' === $checkbox ) ? 'on' : 'no';
314: 				}
315: 			}
316: 			if ( $cart_updated ) {
317: 				WC()->cart->set_session();
318: 			}
319: 		}
320: 	}

338: 	public function prevent_product_edit( $post ) {
339: 		$post_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
340: 		if ( isset( $post_data['action'] ) && 'editpost' === $post_data['action'] ) {
341: 			if ( isset( $post_data['post_ID'] ) ) {
342: 				$post_id = $post_data['post_ID'];
343: 				if ( 'product' === $post_data['post_type'] ) {
344: 					if ( $this->is_product_purchased( $post_id ) ) {
345: 						$old_prod_course = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'product_options', true );
346: 						$old_prod_course = isset( $old_prod_course['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ? $old_prod_course['moodle_post_course_id'] : false;
347: 						$new_prod_course = isset( $post_data['product_options']['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ? $post_data['product_options']['moodle_post_course_id'] : false;
348: 						if ( $old_prod_course !== $new_prod_course ) {
349: 							$nonce         = wp_create_nonce( 'eb-product-edit-nonce' );
350: 							$edit_post_url = admin_url( "post.php?post=$post_id&action=edit&eb_edit_warning=edit&nonce=$nonce" );
351: 							wp_safe_redirect( $edit_post_url );
352: 							die();
353: 						}
354: 					}
355: 				}
356: 			}
357: 		}
358: 		unset( $post );
359: 	}
360: 	private function is_product_purchased( $prod_id ) {
361: 		global $wpdb;
362: 		$query    = "SELECT meta_value FROM  $wpdb->usermeta WHERE  `meta_key`='group_products' ";
363: 		$result   = $wpdb->get_results( $query );
364: 		$products = array();
365: 		foreach ( $result as $value ) {
366: 			$courses  = @unserialize( $value->meta_value );
367: 			$products = $this->product_quantity( $products, $courses );
368: 		}
369: 		if ( array_key_exists( $prod_id, $products ) && $products[ $prod_id ] > 0 ) {
370: 			return true;
371: 		} else {
372: 			return false;
373: 		}
374: 	}
375: 	private function product_quantity( $old_product, $new_product ) {
376: 		foreach ( $new_product as $key => $value ) {
377: 			if ( array_key_exists( $key, $old_product ) ) {
378: 				$old_product[ $key ] += $new_product[ $key ];
379: 			} else {
380: 				$old_product[ $key ] = $new_product[ $key ];
381: 			}
382: 			$value = $value;
383: 		}
384: 		return $old_product;

476: 	public function wdm_woocommerce_quantity_input_max( $qty, $product ) {
477: 		$post_meta = get_post_meta( $product->id, 'product_options', true );
478: 		if ( isset( $post_meta['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
479: 			if ( 'no' === $post_meta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
480: 				return 1;
481: 			}
482: 		}
483: 		return $qty;
484: 	}
485: 	private function check_cart_product( $product_id ) {
486: 		global $woocommerce;
487: 		foreach ( $woocommerce->cart->get_cart() as $val ) {
488: 			$product = $val['data'];
489: 			if ( $product_id === $product->id ) {
490: 				update_post_meta( $product->id, '_sold_individually', 'yes' );
491: 				return false;
492: 			}
493: 		}
494: 		return true;
495: 	}
496: 	public function wdm_order_received_thank_you_message( $msg, $order ) {
497: 		if ( strpos( $msg, 'wi-thanq-wrapper' ) !== false ) {
498: 			return $msg;
499: 		}
500: 		if ( ! empty( $order ) ) {
501: 			$items                     = $order->get_items();
502: 			$order_id                  = $order->get_id();
503: 			$non_bulk_purchase_producd = 0;
504: 			foreach ( $items as $item_id => $item ) {
505: 				$bulk_order   = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, 'Group Enrollment' );
506: 				$item_prod_id = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, '_product_id' );
507: 				if ( 'no' === $bulk_order && 'on' === apply_filters( 'check_group_purchase', 'off', $item_prod_id ) ) {
508: 					$non_bulk_purchase_producd ++;
509: 				}
510: 			}
511: 			$setting = get_option( 'eb_general', array() );
512: 			$url     = isset( $setting['eb_my_courses_page_id'] ) ? get_permalink( $setting['eb_my_courses_page_id'] ) : null;
513: 			$setting_woo_integration = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
514: 			if ( $non_bulk_purchase_producd && $url && isset( $setting_woo_integration['wi_enable_redirect'] ) && 'yes' === $setting_woo_integration['wi_enable_redirect'] ) {
515: 				ob_start();
516: 				?>
517: 				<br />
518: 				<span id="wi-thanq-wrapper">
519: 					<span class="msg">
520: 					<?php
521: 					printf(
522: 						__( 'You will be redirected to %s within next %s seconds.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
523: 						'<a href="' . esc_url( $url ) . '">' . __( 'My Courses Page', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</a>',
524: 						'<span id="wi-countdown">10</span>'
525: 					);
526: 					?>
527: 					</span>
528: 					<button id="wi-cancel-redirect" data-wi-auto-redirect="on"><?php esc_html_e( 'Cancel', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?></button>
529: 				</span>
530: 				<?php
531: 				$msg .= ob_get_clean();
532: 			}
533: 			return $msg;
534: 		}
535: 	}
536: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/readme.txt
```
  1: === Edwiser Bridge PRO ===
  2: Contributors: WisdmLabs
  3: Tags: Moodle, Moodle ecommerce, WordPress Moodle, Sell Moodle Courses, LMS Integration, Moodle Integration, Moodle WordPress, WP Moodle, eLearning, WooCommerce
  4: Requires at least: 6.0
  5: Tested up to: 6.7.2
  6: 
  7: Edwiser Bridge integrates WordPress with Moodle LMS & provides an easy option to import and sell Moodle courses using WordPress.
  8: 
  9: 
 10: 
 11: ==  Description ==
 12: 
 13: Edwiser Bridge - The #1 WordPress and Moodle Integration plugin that provides a robust platform to sell Moodle courses online.
 14: 
 15: Are you a Moodle user, who creates courses and wants a robust integration with WordPress/WooCommerce to sell them.
 16: Then you are in the right place. Edwiser Bridge is the only WordPress plugin that provides stable and robust integration between the two platforms.
 17: 
 18: Edwiser Bridge provides the necessary platform for you to sell your Moodle courses through the default payment gateway, PayPal, WooCommerce.
 19: 
 20: So to enhance its functionality and achieve a fully automated WooCommerce Solution for the purpose of selling your Moodle courses, you may consider choosing Edwiser Bridge Pro to be installed on both your Moodle and WordPress sites.
 21: 
 22: * <a href="https://wordpress.org/plugins/edwiser-bridge/"> Edwiser Bridge - WordPress Add On </a>
 23: * <a href="https://edwiser.org/plugins/edwiserbridge.zip"> Edwiser Bridge - Moodle Add On </a>
 24: 
 25: * <a href="https://edwiser.org/bridge/?utm_source=moodle&utm_medium=landingpage&utm_campaign=EBFreePlugin"> Edwiser Bridge Pro </a>
 26: 
 27: 
 28: = Top Features if you want to sell your Moodle courses better - =
 29: 
 30: = CourseFront - =
 31: * Integration between your WordPress and Moodle sites,
 32: * Connect Moodle with multiple WordPress sites,
 33: * Courses from single Moodle site could be sold through multiple WordPress sites.
 34: * Import your Moodle courses to WordPress,
 35: * Synchronize Moodle course categories to WordPress,
 36: * Set the Moodle courses as drafts,
 37: * Sell courses through WordPress and take payments through PayPal,
 38: * Synchronize enrolled course data for users.
 39: * Synchronize Moodle course images with WordPress.
 40: * Automated 2-way synchronization between each WordPress site and your Moodle site,
 41: * The course progress of student is synced from Moodle to WordPress in real time.
 42: 
 43: = Course Access Control - =
 44: * Automation user registration in Moodle,
 45: * Enable/Disable registration for courses,
 46: * Identical login credentials to access courses in Moodle,
 47: * Set course access time from WordPress,
 48: * Update previously synchronized courses,
 49: * Enroll / Unenrol users from WordPress,
 50: * Provide refunds to your students from WordPress.
 51: 
 52: = Connect your Moodle with Multiple WordPress Sites - =
 53: * Now connect single Moodle site with multiple WordPress sites,
 54: * Courses from single Moodle site could be sold through multiple WordPress sites,
 55: * Automated 2-way synchronization between each WordPress site and your Moodle site,
 56: * Secured and efficient transfer of information across sites,
 57: * The course progress of student is synced from Moodle to WordPress in real time.
 58: 
 59: 
 60: == Edwiser Bridge PRO - Features ==
 61: = WooCommerce Integration =
 62: * Sell Moodle courses through WooCommerce.
 63: * Create / Update Courses as Products.
 64: * Sell Courses as Bundled Products.
 65: * Sell Courses as Subscription Products.
 66: * Link Courses from Product Page.
 67: * Unenrollment on Cancellation.
 68: 
 69: = Bulk Purchase =
 70: * Purchase Courses in bulk quantity and enroll users to courses in bulk.
 71: * bulk user enrollment using csv file or by manually filling the forms.
 72: 
 73: = Single Sign On =
 74: * Simultaneous login/logout to WordPress and Moodle.
 75: * Login to WordPress and Moodle using the same credentials.
 76: * Social login for wordpress via Facebook and Google.
 77: 
 78: = Selective Synchronization =
 79: * Selectively synchronize courses from Moodle to WordPress.
 80: * Selectively synchronize users from Moodle to WordPress.
 81: 
 82: = Custom Fields =
 83: * Create custom fields for user registration form and profile page.
 84: * Create custom fields for WooCommerce checkout.
 85: * Sync custom fields from WordPress to Moodle.
 86: 
 87: 
 88: 
 89: ==  Installation  ==
 90: 
 91: = Minimum Requirements =
 92: * PHP version 7.0 or greater
 93: * WordPress 6.0 or higher
 94: * Moodle 4.3 or higher
 95: 
 96: = Automatic Installation =
 97: * Upon purchasing the Edwiser Bridge PRO, an email  containing the purchase receipt, download link and license key will be sent to your registered email id. Copy the license key from this email.
 98: * Login to your WordPress site as an administrator.
 99: * Go to Edwiser Bridge settings page from the dashboard.
100: * Click on the ‘Licenses’ tab on this page.
101: * Enter the license key and click on the ‘Install Plugin’ button.
102: * Plugin will be installed automatically and activated.
103: 
104: =  Manual Installation  =
105: * Upon purchasing the Edwiser Bridge PRO, an email  containing the purchase receipt, download link and license key will be sent to your registered email id. You can download the ‘edwiser-bridge-pro.zip’ extension file using the download link provided.
106: * To install this plugin, go to the ‘Plugins’ menu from the dashboard.
107: * Click on the ‘Add New’ button on this page.
108: * Now click on the ‘Upload Plugin‘ button and upload the ‘edwiser-bridge-pro.zip’ file.
109: * Click on ‘Install Now’ button once you have located and uploaded the plugin.
110: * On successful installation click the ‘Activate Plugin’ link to activate the plugin.
111: * Alternatively, you can unzip and upload the Edwiser Bridge PRO plugin folder using the FTP application of your choice.
112: 
113: 
114: ==  Changelog  ==

117:

125: * Fix - Fixed Bulk Purchase Add Quantity Modal Total was Not getting Updated Issue.
126: * Fix - Fixed Security issue with SSO login key encryption.
127: * Fix - Fixed SSO social Login Double Slash Issue in JS files.
128:

131: * Fix   - Fixed several PHP notices and warnings. 
132: 
133: = 3.0.4 =

135: * Tweak - Manage Group search box.
136: 
137: = 3.0.3 =

139: * Fix - Course expiry unenrollment start date issue.

208:                             display_offset = display_offset + response.data.display_offset;

227:                                 $('.load-response').hide();
228:                             }

234:                     }

1362: 			function enroll_csv_users_recursively(cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users) {
1363: 				offset = 5;
1364: 				if (processed_users + offset >= total) {
1365: 					offset = total - processed_users;
1366: 				}
1367: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_processed_users_count' ).html( processed_users );
1368: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_total_users_count' ).html( total );
1369: 				$( '#ebbp_csv_users_progress_percent' ).html( Math.round( processed_users * 100 / total ) + '%' );
1370: 				$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).show();
1371: 				$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
1372: 				jQuery.ajax(
1373: 					{
1374: 						type: 'POST',
1375: 						url: ebbpManageGroup.ajax_url,
1376: 						dataType: 'json',
1377: 						data: {
1378: 							action: 'create_wordpress_user',
1379: 							mdl_cohort_id: cohortId,
1380: 							cohortName: cohortName,
1381: 							firstname: return_set_of_array( firstname, processed_users, offset ),
1382: 							lastname: return_set_of_array( lastname, processed_users, offset ),
1383: 							email: return_set_of_array( email, processed_users, offset ),
1384: 							processed_users: processed_users,
1385: 							total: total,
1386: 							nonce_bp_enroll: ebbpManageGroup.nonce_bp_enroll,
1387: 						},
1388: 						success: function (response) {
1389: 							var data = response.data;
1390: 							if (response.success == true) {
1391: 								processed_users = processed_users + data.processed_users;
1392: 								if (processed_users < total) {
1393: 									enroll_csv_users_recursively( cohortId, cohortName, firstname, lastname, email, total, processed_users );
1394: 								} else {
1395: 									jQuery( "#wdm_user_delete_msg" ).html( data.msg );
1396: 									$( "#wdm-eb-enroll-msg" ).css( "display", "none" );
1397: 									$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
1398: 									jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
1399: 									$( ".wdm_success_message" ).css( "display", "block" );
1400: 									$( '#edb_course_product_name' ).find( ":selected" ).text( data.cohort );
1401: 									getEnrolledUsers( 1 );
1402: 								}
1403: 							} else {
1404: 								errorMsgDialog( data );
1405: 							}
1406: 						},
1407: 						error: function (error) {
1408: 							errorMsgDialog( error );
1409: 							$( "#ebbp_csv_users_progress_wrap" ).hide();
1410: 							jQuery( "#loding-icon" ).removeClass( "loader" );
1411: 							$( "#enroll-user-form-csv" ).dialog( 'close' );
1412: 						}
1413: 					}
1414: 				);
1415: 			}

1419: 			function validateEnrollUserForm() {
1420: 				var numItems      = jQuery( '#wdm_enroll_fname' ).length;
1421: 				var empty_flag    = 0;
1422: 				var username_flag = 0;
1423: 				var email_flag    = 0;
1424: 				jQuery( '#wdm_enroll_fname' ).each(
1425: 					function () {
1426: 						var firstName = jQuery( this ).val();
1427: 						firstName     = firstName.trim();
1428: 						if (firstName == '' || firstName.length == 0) {
1429: 							empty_flag = 1;
1430: 							return false;
1431: 						}
1432: 					}
1433: 				);
1434: 				jQuery( '#wdm_enroll_lname' ).each(
1435: 					function () {
1436: 						var lastName = jQuery( this ).val();
1437: 						lastName     = lastName.trim();
1438: 						if (lastName == '' || lastName.length == 0) {
1439: 							empty_flag = 1;
1440: 							return false;
1441: 						}
1442: 					}
1443: 				);
1444: 				jQuery( '.txt_uname' ).each(
1445: 					function () {
1446: 						if (jQuery( this ).val() == '') {
1447: 							empty_flag = 1;
1448: 							return false;
1449: 						}
1450: 					}
1451: 				);
1452: 				var emailReg = /^(([^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@\"]+(\.[^<>()[\]\\.,;:\s@\"]+)*)|(\".+\"))@((\[[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\.[0-9]{1,3}\])|(([a-zA-Z\-0-9]+\.)+[a-zA-Z]{2,}))$/;
1453: 				jQuery( '#wdm_enroll_email' ).each(
1454: 					function () {
1455: 						if (jQuery( this ).val() == '') {
1456: 							empty_flag = 1;
1457: 							return false;
1458: 						} else {
1459: 							if ( ! emailReg.test( jQuery( this ).val() )) {
1460: 								jQuery( '#enroll_user_form-msg' ).html( '<div class="wdm_select_course_msg" style = "display:block"><i class="dashicons dashicons-dismiss wdm_select_course_msg_dismiss"></i><label class="wdm_enroll_warning_message_label">' + ebbpManageGroup.invalidEmailId + '</div>' );
1461: 								email_flag = 1;
1462: 							}
1463: 						}
1464: 					}
1465: 				);
1466: 				if (empty_flag == 1 || email_flag == 1 || username_flag == 1) {
1467: 					if (empty_flag == 1) {
1468: 						jQuery( '#enroll_user_form-msg' ).html( '<div class="wdm_select_course_msg" style = "display:block"><i class="dashicons dashicons-dismiss wdm_select_course_msg_dismiss"></i><label class="wdm_enroll_warning_message_label">' + ebbpManageGroup.mandatoryMsg + '</div>' );
1469: 					}
1470: 					jQuery( '#enroll_user_form-msg p' ).addClass( 'wdm_error_message' );
1471: 					jQuery( '#enroll_user_form-msg' ).show();
1472: 					return false;
1473: 				} else {
1474: 					return true;
1475: 				}
1476: 			}

1482: 			function proceedToCheckOut() {
1483: 				// v1.1.1
1484: 				// Check if the Add Quantity or Add Product Pop up is open
1485: 				var popup = "";
1486: 				if (jQuery( ".ebbp-remove-product" ).length != 0) {
1487: 					var Quantity = jQuery( ".wdm_new_qty_per_new_prod" );
1488: 					var selectedProducts = jQuery( ".wdm_selected_products" );
1489: 					popup        = "remove-product";
1490: 				} else if (jQuery( ".new-group-add-product" ).length != 0) {
1491: 					var Quantity         = jQuery( ".wdm_new_qty_per_new_prod" );
1492: 					var selectedProducts = jQuery( ".wdm_selected_products" );
1493: 					popup                = "new_group";

1496: 					var selectedProducts = jQuery( ".wdm_selected_products" );
1497: 					popup                = "products";
1498: 				}
1499: 				var productArray = {};
1500: 				// For Add Products.
1501: 				if (popup == "products" || popup == "remove-product") {
1502: 					Quantity.each(
1503: 						function (index, value) {
1504: 							if (jQuery( selectedProducts[index] ).is( ':checked' )) {
1505: 								productArray[$( value ).attr( 'id' )] = $( value ).html();
1506: 							}
1507: 						}
1508: 					);
1509: 				} else if (popup == "new_group") {

1513: 						function (index, value) {
1514: 							if (jQuery( selectedProducts[index] ).is( ':checked' )) {
1515: 								var product = $(selectedProducts[index]).parent().parent().find('.product_title');
1516: 								var id = $(product).data('id');
1517: 								var title = $(product).html();
1518: 								var quantity = $(value).html();
1519: 								// add product in li and add id and quantity in data
1520: 								var li = '<li class="wdm_product" data-id="' + id + '" data-quantity="' + quantity + '">' + title + ' (' + quantity + ')</li>';
1521: 								productDiv.append(li);
1522: 							}
1523: 						}
1524: 					);
1525: 					$( this ).dialog( "close" );
1526: 				}
1527: 				if (jQuery.isEmptyObject( productArray )) {
1528: 					jQuery( "#add-quantity-msg" ).html( "<p>" + ebbpManageGroup.enterQuantity + "</p>" );
1529: 				} else if (popup == "new_group"){
1530: 					productArray.each( function (index, value) {
1531: 					});

1534: 					jQuery.ajax(
1535: 						{

'<a href="javascript:history.go(0)" style="cursor:pointer;">' . esc_html_e( ' reloading', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</a>' . esc_html_e( ' the page.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );

33: 					$ids = explode( '/', $category->path );
34: 					echo '<td class="eb-last-td">';
35: 					foreach ( $ids as $category_id ) {
36: 						foreach ( $moodle_category_data as $category ) {
37: 							if ( $category->id === (int) $category_id ) {
38: 								echo esc_html( $category->name );
39: 								if ( end( $ids ) !== $category_id ) {
40: 									echo ' / ';
41: 								}
42: 								if ( ! in_array( $category->name, $category_list, true ) ) {
43: 									array_push( $category_list, $category->name );
44: 								}
45: 								break;
46: 							}
47: 						}
48: 					}
49: 					echo '</td>';
50: 				} else {
51: 					echo '<td class="eb-last-td">' . esc_html( $category->name ) . '</td>';
52: 					if ( ! in_array( $category->name, $category_list, true ) ) {
53: 						array_push( $category_list, $category->name );
54: 					}
55: 				}

 90: 			$exisiting_rules    = $this->get_existing_redir_rules( $settings );
 91: 			$roles              = $this->get_user_roles( $exisiting_rules );
 92: 			$roles_to_add_rules = $roles;
 93: 			?>
 94: 			<h3 class="ebsso-role-redirect-settings">
 95: 				<?php esc_html_e( 'User Role Based Redirection Settings', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?>
 96: 			</h3>
 97: 			<?php
 98: 			$this->create_role_redi_rule( $roles_to_add_rules, 'top' );
 99: 			$this->show_set_role_redirections( $exisiting_rules );
100: 			$this->create_role_redi_rule( $roles_to_add_rules, 'bottom' );
101: 		}
102: 		private function get_existing_redir_rules( $settings ) {
103: 			$redirect_data = array();
104: 			if ( is_array( $settings ) ) {
105: 				foreach ( $settings as $key_id => $value ) {
106: 					if ( strpos( $key_id, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_' ) !== false ) {
107: 						$key                   = str_replace( 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_', '', $key_id );
108: 						$redirect_data[ $key ] = $value;
109: 					}
110: 				}
111: 			}
112: 			return $redirect_data;
113: 		}
114: 		/**
115: 		 * Function provides the functionality to get the all the roles
116: 		 * available on the system and remove the previously added roles from the output array.
117: 		 *
118: 		 * @global Object $wp_roles This is the global variable defined for the user roles by WP.
119: 		 * @param array $exisiting_rules The array of the roles previously added in setting.
120: 		 * @return array array of the role names where roles are not associated with the url in the sso settings.
121: 		 */
122: 		private function get_user_roles( $exisiting_rules ) {
123: 			global $wp_roles;
124: 			$roles = $wp_roles->get_names();
125: 			if ( ! is_array( $exisiting_rules ) ) {
126: 				return $roles;
127: 			}
128: 			foreach ( $exisiting_rules as $key => $value ) {
129: 				if ( isset( $roles[ $key ] ) ) {
130: 					unset( $roles[ $key ] );
131: 				}
132: 				unset( $value );
133: 			}
134: 			return $roles;
135: 		}
136: 		/**
137: 		 * Function provides the functionality to generate the view to add the new user role
138: 		 *  and redirection rule for it.
139: 		 *
140: 		 * @param array  $add_rules_for_role This is the set of the user roles to add new rules.
141: 		 * @param String $pos This is the position of the view where it will be displayed like top/bottum.
142: 		 * This will be used for the identifying the element of the view.
143: 		 */
144: 		private function create_role_redi_rule( $add_rules_for_role, $pos ) {

151: 				<input name="<?php echo esc_attr( $url_in_id ); ?>" id="<?php echo esc_attr( $url_in_id ); ?>" type="url" class="ebsso-role-redi-new-setting-url" placeholder="e.g. http://mymoodle.com/my/">
152: 				<input type="button" id="<?php echo esc_attr( $btn_id ); ?>" name="<?php echo esc_attr( $btn_id ); ?>" class="ebsso-add-new-redirect-rule" value="<?php echo esc_html_e( 'Add', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?>">
153: 				<span class="ebsso-error" style="color:red"></span>
154: 			</div>
155: 			<?php
156: 		}
157: 		private function role_selector( $add_rules_for_role, $pos ) {
158: 			?>
159: 			<label class="ebsso-setting-filed-lbl"><?php esc_html_e( 'Select user role', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?></label>
160: 			<select name="ebsso-role-<?php echo esc_attr( $pos ); ?>" class="ebsso-role-redi-new-setting-role" id="ebsso-role-<?php echo esc_attr( $pos ); ?>">
161: 				<option value=""><?php esc_html_e( 'Select Role', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?></option>
162: 				<?php
163: 				foreach ( $add_rules_for_role as $key => $value ) {
164: 					?>
165: 					<option value="<?php echo esc_attr( $key ); ?>">
166: 						<?php echo esc_html( $value ); ?>
167: 					</option>
168: 					<?php
169: 				}
170: 				?>
171: 			</select>
172: 			<?php
173: 		}
174: 		/**
175: 		 * Provides the functionality to display the user roles table.
176: 		 *
177: 		 * @param array $rules_to_display array of the roles where URL are set.
178: 		 */
179: 		private function show_set_role_redirections( $rules_to_display ) {

191: 				</tfoot>
192: 			</table>

244: 			</td>
245: 			<td>
246: 				<input type="button" data-name='<?php echo esc_attr( $role_disp_name ); ?>' data-text="<?php echo esc_attr( $role_id ); ?>" class="ebsso-edit-manage-redirect-rule" name="<?php echo esc_attr( $field_id ) . '-btn'; ?>" id="<?php echo esc_attr( $field_id ) . '-btn'; ?>" value="<?php esc_html_e( 'Delete', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ); ?>" class="eb-sso-btn-dele-redire-setting"/>
247: 				<?php do_action( 'ebsso_settings_tbl_redir_more_row_action', $role_id ); ?>

251: 		}
252: 	}
253: }

 12: 				$settings['ebsso_role_base_redirect'] = 'on';
 13: 			} else {

 15: 			}

 18: 		public function save_social_login_settings( $data ) {
 19: 			global $current_tab;
 20: 			$old_settings = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 21: 			$settings         = new Sso_Settings_Social_Login();
 22: 			$options          = $settings->get_social_login_settings();
 23: 			$form_data        = $this->get_form_data( $options, $data );
 24: 			$upd_opt_filtered = array_filter( $form_data );
 25: 			if ( isset( $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) && ! empty( $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ) {
 26: 				$upd_opt_filtered['eb_sso_secret_key'] = $old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'];
 27: 			}
 28: 			update_option( 'eb_' . $current_tab, $upd_opt_filtered );
 29: 		}
 30: 		private function remove_data() {
 31: 			$data = array(
 32: 				'ebsso-role-top',
 33: 				'ebsso-role-bottom',
 34: 				'ebsso_selected_login_redirect_url_top',
 35: 				'ebsso_selected_login_redirect_url_bottom',
 36: 				'save',
 37: 				'subtab',
 38: 				'_wpnonce',
 39: 				'_wp_http_referer',
 40: 			);
 41: 			foreach ( $data as $key ) {
 42: 				if ( isset( $_POST[ $key ] ) ) {
 43: 					unset( $_POST[ $key ] );
 44: 				}
 45: 			}
 46: 			return $_POST;
 47: 		}
 48: 		public function save_general_settigns( $data ) {
 49: 			global $current_tab;
 50: 			$old_settings                      = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 51: 			$settings                          = new Sso_Settings_General();
 52: 			$options                           = $settings->get_general_settings();
 53: 			$form_data                         = $this->get_form_data( $options, $data );
 54: 			$upd_opt_filtered                  = array_filter( $form_data );
 55: 			$old_settings['eb_sso_secret_key'] = $upd_opt_filtered['eb_sso_secret_key'];
 56: 			update_option( 'eb_' . $current_tab, $old_settings );
 57: 		}
 58: 		private function get_form_data( $options, $data ) {
 59: 			$update_options = array();
 60: 			foreach ( $options as $value ) {
 61: 				if ( ! isset( $value['id'] ) || ! isset( $value['type'] ) ) {
 62: 					continue;
 63: 				}
 64: 				if ( strstr( $value['id'], '[' ) ) {
 65: 					parse_str( $value['id'], $option_name_array );
 66: 					$option_name  = current( array_keys( $option_name_array ) );
 67: 					$setting_name = key( $option_name_array[ $option_name ] );
 68: 					$option_value = null;
 69: 					if ( isset( $data[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] ) ) {
 70: 						$option_value = wp_unslash( $data[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] );
 71: 					}
 72: 				} else {
 73: 					$option_name  = $value['id'];
 74: 					$setting_name = '';
 75: 					$option_value = null;
 76: 					if ( isset( $_POST[ $value['id'] ] ) ) {
 77: 						$option_value = wp_unslash( $data[ $value['id'] ] );
 78: 					}
 79: 				}
 80: 				$option_value = $this->get_field_type_value( $value, $option_value );
 81: 				if ( ! is_null( $option_value ) ) {
 82: 					if ( $option_name && $setting_name ) {
 83: 						if ( ! isset( $update_options[ $option_name ] ) ) {
 84: 							$update_options[ $option_name ] = get_option( $option_name, array() );
 85: 						}
 86: 						if ( ! is_array( $update_options[ $option_name ] ) ) {
 87: 							$update_options[ $option_name ] = array();
 88: 						}
 89: 						$update_options[ $option_name ][ $setting_name ] = $option_value;
 90: 					} else {
 91: 						$update_options[ $option_name ] = $option_value;
 92: 					}
 93: 				}
 94: 			}
 95: 			return $update_options;
 96: 		}
 97: 		private function get_field_type_value( $value, $option_value ) {
 98: 			switch ( sanitize_title( $value['type'] ) ) {
 99: 				case 'checkbox':
100: 					if ( is_null( $option_value ) ) {
101: 						$option_value = 'no';
102: 					} else {
103: 						$option_value = 'yes';
104: 					}
105: 					break;
106: 				case 'textarea':
107: 					$option_value = wp_kses_post( trim( $option_value ) );
108: 					break;
109: 				case 'text':
110: 				case 'email':
111: 				case 'url':
112: 				case 'number':
113: 				case 'select':
114: 				case 'color':
115: 				case 'password':
116: 				case 'single_select_page':
117: 				case 'radio':
118: 					$option_value = wpClean( $option_value );
119: 					break;
120: 				case 'multiselect':
121: 					$option_value = array_filter( array_map( 'wpClean', (array) $option_value ) );
122: 					break;
123: 				default:
124: 					do_action( 'eb_update_option_' . sanitize_title( $value['type'] ), $value );
125: 					break;
126: 			}
127: 			return $option_value;
128: 		}
129: 	}
130: }

18: 			$this->social_login_settings = new Sso_Settings_Social_Login();

23: 			add_action( 'eb_settings_save_' . $this->_id, array( $this, 'save' ) );

39: 		public function getSettings( $current_section = '' ) {

43: 			} elseif ( isset( $_GET['section'] ) && 'social_login' === $_GET['section'] ) {
44: 				$settings = $this->social_login_settings->get_social_login_settings( $_POST );
45: 			} else {
46: 				$settings = $this->general_settings->get_general_settings();
47: 			}
48: 			return apply_filters( 'eb_get_settings_' . $this->_id, $settings );
49: 		}
50: 		public function save() {
51: 			if ( empty( $_POST ) ) {
52: 				return false;
53: 			}
54: 			$save_settings = new Sso_Settings_Save();
55: 			if ( isset( $_GET['section'] ) && 'redirection' === $_GET['section'] ) {
56: 				$save_settings->save_redirection_settigns( $_POST );
57: 			} elseif ( isset( $_GET['section'] ) && 'social_login' === $_GET['section'] ) {
58: 				$save_settings->save_social_login_settings( $_POST );
59: 			} else {
60: 				$save_settings->save_general_settigns( $_POST );
61: 			}
62: 		}
63: 	}
64: }
65: return new Sso_Settings();

109: 		public function refund_handler( $order_id, $refund_id ) {
110: 			global $wpdb;
111: 			$order = wc_get_order( $order_id );
112: 			$refund_data = $order->get_meta( 'bp-refund-data', 1 );
113: 			$refund_id   = $refund_id;
114: 			if ( isset( $refund_data['refund-type'] ) && ! empty( $refund_data['refund-type'] ) ) {
115: 				$cohorts   = $order->get_meta( 'eb_bp_mdl_cohort_id', 1 );
116: 				if ( 'bp-partial-refund' === $refund_data['refund-type'] ) {
117: 					foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
118: 						$quantity = $quantity;
119: 						if ( isset( $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] ) && ! empty( $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] ) ) {
120: 							$this->decreasebulk_quantity( $cohort_id, $refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ], $order_id );
121: 						}
122: 					}
123: 				}
124: 				if ( 'bp-full-refund' === $refund_data['refund-type'] ) {
125: 					if ( isset( $refund_data['full-refund'] ) && ! empty( $refund_data['full-refund'] ) && 'on' === $refund_data['full-refund'] ) {
126: 						$email_args      = array();
127: 						$table_name      = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
128: 						$cohort_id_array = array_keys( $cohorts );
129: 						foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
130: 							$row            = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT NAME, COHORT_NAME, COHORT_MANAGER, PRODUCTS FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d;", $cohort_id ) );
131: 							$cohort_manager = get_user_by( 'ID', $row->COHORT_MANAGER );
132: 							$products       = maybe_unserialize( $row->PRODUCTS );
133: 							$quantity       = 0;
134: 							foreach ( array_values( $products ) as $qty ) {
135: 								$quantity = $qty;
136: 								break;
137: 							}
138: 							array_push(
139: 								$email_args,

142: 									'user_email'       => $cohort_manager->user_email,

144: 									'last_name'        => $cohort_manager->last_name,
145: 									'order_id'         => $order_id,
146: 									'bulk_refund_type' => 'fully',
147: 									'refunded_bulk_quantity' => $quantity,
148: 									'group_name'       => $row->NAME ? $row->NAME : $row->COHORT_NAME,
149: 								)
150: 							);
151: 						}
152: 						$cohort_manger = new includes\bulkPurchase\Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
153: 						$result        = $cohort_manger->delete_cohort( $cohort_id_array );
154: 						if ( $result ) {

156: 							foreach ( $email_args as $args ) {

158: 							}

166: 		public function decreasebulk_quantity( $cohort_id, $quantity, $order_id ) {
167: 			global $wpdb;
168: 			if ( $quantity ) {
169: 				$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
170: 				$row        = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cohort_id ) );
171: 				$products   = array();
172: 				foreach ( maybe_unserialize( $row->PRODUCTS ) as $product_id => $qty ) {
173: 					if ( $qty >= $quantity ) {
174: 						$qty = $qty - $quantity;
175: 						if ( $qty >= 0 ) {
176: 							$products[ $product_id ] = $qty;
177: 						}
178: 					}
179: 				}
180: 				$wpdb->update(
181: 					$table_name,
182: 					array(
183: 						'PRODUCTS' => maybe_serialize( $products ),
184: 					),
185: 					array(
186: 						'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id,
187: 					)
188: 				);
189: 				$cohort_manager = get_user_by( 'ID', $row->COHORT_MANAGER );
190: 				$args = array(
191: 					'username'               => $cohort_manager->user_login,
192: 					'user_email'             => $cohort_manager->user_email,
193: 					'first_name'             => $cohort_manager->first_name,
194: 					'last_name'              => $cohort_manager->last_name,
195: 					'order_id'               => $order_id,
196: 					'bulk_refund_type'       => 'partially',
197: 					'refunded_bulk_quantity' => $quantity,
198: 					'group_name'             => $row->NAME ? $row->NAME : $row->COHORT_NAME,
199: 				);
200: 				do_action( 'eb_bp_bulk_purchase_refund', $args );
201: 			}
202: 		}
203: 		public function save_refund_data() {
204: 			if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'ebbp_refund_nonce' ) ) {
205: 				print 'Sorry, your nonce did not verify.';
206: 				exit;
207: 			}
208: 			$post_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
209: 			if ( isset( $post_data['refund-type'] ) && ! empty( $post_data['refund-type'] ) && isset( $post_data['order-id'] ) ) {
210: 				$order_id    = $post_data['order-id'];
211: 				$refund_data = array(
212: 					'refund-type' => $post_data['refund-type'],
213: 					'full-refund' => $post_data['full-refund'],
214: 				);
215: 				$order   = wc_get_order( $order_id );
216: 				$cohorts = $order->get_meta( 'eb_bp_mdl_cohort_id', true );
217: 				foreach ( $cohorts as $cohort_id => $quantity ) {
218: 					$quantity = $quantity;
219: 					$refund_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ] = $post_data[ 'bp-partial-refund-quantity_' . $cohort_id ];
220: 				}
221: 				$order->update_meta_data( 'bp-refund-data', $refund_data );
222: 				$order->save();
223: 			}
224: 		}
225: 	}
226: }

618: 	public function add_contains_enrolment( $actions, $post ) {

621: 			$enrols = $wpdb->get_row( "SELECT user_id FROM {$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment WHERE course_id={$post->ID}", ARRAY_A );

56: 	public function wdm_save_group_purchase_field( $variation_id = 0, $key = 0 ) {
57: 		$post_data = array();
58: 		if ( isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) && wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ), 'check_sync_action' ) ) {
59: 			$post_data = wp_unslash( $_POST );
60: 		}
61: 		if ( ! isset( $post_data['action'] ) || 'handle_product_synchronization' !== $post_data['action'] ) {
62: 			$post_id   = isset( $post_data['ID'] ) ? $post_data['ID'] : 0;
63: 			$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
64: 			if ( $variation_id ) {
65: 				$post_id = $variation_id;
66: 			}
67: 			$the_post = wp_is_post_revision( $post_id );
68: 			if ( $the_post ) {
69: 				$post_id = $the_post;
70: 			}
71: 			if ( $post_id ) {
72: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'product_options', true );
73: 				if ( ! isset( $product_options ) || ! is_array( $product_options ) ) {
74: 					$product_options = array();
75: 				}
76: 				if ( isset( $_POST['moodle_course_group_purchase_hidden'][ $key ] ) && 'on' === $_POST['moodle_course_group_purchase_hidden'][ $key ] ) {
77: 					$product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] = sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['moodle_course_group_purchase_hidden'][ $key ] ) );
78: 					if ( isset( $_POST['bp_reuse_quantity_hidden'][ $key ] ) && ! empty( $_POST['bp_reuse_quantity_hidden'][ $key ] ) ) {
79: 						$product_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] = sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['bp_reuse_quantity_hidden'][ $key ] ) );
80: 					}
81: 				}
82: 				update_post_meta( $post_id, 'product_options', $product_options );
83: 			}
84: 		}
85: 	}
86: }

 7: 	class Eb_Bp_Admin_Notices {
 8: 		private $message;
 9: 		private $css_class = 'notice is-dismissible';
10: 		private $type = 4;
11: 		public function __construct( $message, $type ) {
12: 			$this->message = $message;
13: 			$this->type    = $type;
14: 			$this->trigger_message();
15: 		}
16: 		private function trigger_message() {
17: 			switch ( $this->type ) {
18: 				case 0:
19: 					$this->css_class .= 'notice-success';
20: 					break;
21: 				case 1:
22: 					$this->css_class .= 'notice-warning';
23: 					break;
24: 				case 2:
25: 					$this->css_class .= 'notice-error';
26: 					break;
27: 				case 3:
28: 					$this->css_class .= 'notice-info';
29: 					break;
30: 				default:
31: 					break;
32: 			}
33: 			if ( $this->type < 4 ) {
34: 				add_action( 'admin_notices', array( $this, 'display_admin_notice' ) );
35: 			}
36: 		}

38: 			?>
39: 			<div class="<?php echo esc_attr( $this->css_class ); ?>">

 65: 				$moodle_user_id = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id', true );
 66: 				$args           = array(
 67: 					'cohortid' => $mdl_cohort_id,
 68: 					'userid'   => $moodle_user_id,
 69: 				);
 70: 				$details = get_cohort_details( $mdl_cohort_id );
 71: 				update_user_meta( $user_id, 'eb_pending_enrollment', $details['courses'] );
 72: 				$responce = $this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'members' => array( $args ) ) );
 73: 				if ( 1 === $responce['success'] ) {
 74: 					$this->delete_cohort_user_from_wordpress( $mdl_cohort_id, $user_id );
 75: 					$response = array(
 76: 						'status'  => true,
 77: 						'message' => __( 'Unenrolled successfully!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 78: 					);
 79: 				} else {
 80: 					$response = array(
 81: 						'status'  => false,
 82: 						'message' => __( 'Unable to remove user from the cohort', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 83: 					);
 84: 				}
 85: 				if ( $response['status'] ) {
 86: 					$qty             = $this->reuse_qty_after_user_removed_from_group( $mdl_cohort_id );
 87: 					$response['qty'] = $qty;
 88: 					$args            = $this->prepare_email_args( $cohort_manager_id, $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id );
 89: 					do_action( 'eb_bp_remove_user_from_cohort', $args );
 90: 				}
 91: 				return $response;
 92: 			}
 93: 		}
 94: 		private function reuse_qty_after_user_removed_from_group( $cohort_id ) {
 95: 			global $wpdb;
 96: 			$table_name         = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
 97: 			$result             = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cohort_id ) );
 98: 			$new_products_array = array();
 99: 			$update             = 0;
100: 			$prevent            = 0;
101: 			$products           = isset( $result->PRODUCTS ) ? $result->PRODUCTS : array();
102: 			foreach ( maybe_unserialize( $result->PRODUCTS ) as $product_id => $qty ) {
103: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', 1 );
104: 				if ( isset( $product_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) && 'on' === $product_options['bp_reuse_quantity'] ) {
105: 					$update                            = 1;
106: 					$new_products_array[ $product_id ] = ++$qty;
107: 				} else {
108: 					$prevent = 1;
109: 				}
110: 			}
111: 			if ( $update && ! $prevent ) {
112: 				$wpdb->update(
113: 					$table_name,
114: 					array( 'PRODUCTS' => maybe_serialize( $new_products_array ) ),
115: 					array( 'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id )
116: 				);
117: 				return 1;
118: 			}
119: 			return 0;
120: 		}
121: 		private function prepare_email_args( $cohort_manager_id, $user_id, $mdl_cohort_id ) {
122: 			$user = get_userdata( $user_id );
123: 			return array(
124: 				'user_email'        => $user->user_email,
125: 				'username'          => $user->user_login,
126: 				'last_name'         => $user->last_name,
127: 				'first_name'        => $user->first_name,
128: 				'mdl_cohort_id'     => $mdl_cohort_id,
129: 				'cohort_manager_id' => $cohort_manager_id,
130: 			);
131: 		}
132: 		private function delete_cohort_user_from_wordpress( $cohort_name, $user_id ) {
133: 			global $wpdb;
134: 			$wpdb->delete(
135: 				"{$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment",
136: 				array(
137: 					'mdl_cohort_id' => $cohort_name,
138: 					'user_id'       => $user_id,
139: 				)
140: 			);
141: 		}
142: 		public function delete_all_users_from_cohort( $cohort_id ) {
143: 			global $wpdb;
144: 			return $wpdb->delete( "{$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment", array( 'mdl_cohort_id' => $cohort_id ) );
145: 		}
146: 		public function update_moodle_user_profile( $role_id, $user_id ) {
147: 			$user_id = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id' );
148: 			$moodle_function = 'core_role_assign_roles';
149: 			$user_data       = array(
150: 				'roleid'    => $role_id,
151: 				'userid'    => $user_id[0],
152: 				'contextid' => 1,
153: 			);
154: 			$response        = $this->con_helper->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $moodle_function, array( 'assignments' => array( $user_data ) ) );
155: 			return( 1 === $response['success'] ? true : false );
156: 		}
157: 	}
158: }

283: 								'progress' => '<a> <span data-cohortid = ' . $this->mdl_cohort_id . ' data-userid = ' . $user->user_id . ' class="ebbp_course_progress">' . __( 'View Progress', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</span> </a>',
284: 								'actions'  => '<i title="' . __( 'Edit user.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-edit edit-enrolled-user"></i>
285:                                     <i title="' . __( 'Unenroll user from Group.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '" id="' . $user->user_id . '" class="dashicons dashicons-trash bp-delete-enrolled-user"></i>',
286: 							);
287: 							$tbl_data  = apply_filters( 'eb_bp_enroll_user_tbl_data', $tbl_data, $this->mdl_cohort_id, $user->user_id );
288: 							?>
289: 							<tr class ="<?php echo esc_html( $user->user_id ); ?>">
290: 							<?php
291: 							foreach ( array_keys( $tbl_col ) as $key ) {
292: 								echo '<td>' . wp_kses( $tbl_data[ $key ], eb_bp_get_allowed_html_tags() ) . '</td>';
293: 							}
294: 							?>
295: 							</tr>
296: 							<?php
297: 						}
298: 					}
299: 					?>
300: 				</tbody>
301: 			</table>
302: 			<?php
303: 			$form     = ob_get_clean();
304: 			$responce = array(
305: 				'seats'          => $avail_seats,
306: 				'enrolled_users' => count( $enrolled_users ),
307: 				'html'           => $form,
308: 			);
309: 			return $responce;
310: 		}
311: 		private function get_user_roles( $user ) {
312: 			$user_role = $user->roles;
313: 			$str       = '';
314: 			$count     = count( $user_role );
315: 			for ( $i = 0; $i < $count; $i++ ) {
316: 				$str .= 0 !== $i ? ', ' : '';
317: 				$str .= 'non_editing_teacher' === $user_role[ $i ] ? 'Non Editing Teacher' : $user_role[ $i ];
318: 			}
319: 			return $str;
320: 		}
321: 	}
322: }

134: 		public function email_template_parser( $data ) {
135: 			$args = $data['args'];
136: 			if ( empty( $args ) || count( $args ) <= 0 ) {
137: 				$args = array(
138: 					'product_id'        => '1',
139: 					'mdl_cohort_id'     => '1',
140: 					'order_id'          => 231,
141: 					'cohort_manager_id' => 1,
142: 				);
143: 			}
144: 			$tmpl_content = $data['content'];
145: 			$tmpl_const   = $this->get_tmpl_constant( $args );
146: 			foreach ( $tmpl_const as $const => $val ) {
147: 				if ( empty( $val ) ) {
148: 					$val = '';
149: 				}
150: 				$tmpl_content = str_replace( $const, $val, $tmpl_content );
151: 			}
152: 			return array(
153: 				'args'    => $args,
154: 				'content' => $tmpl_content,
155: 			);
156: 		}

368: 					$prod_id  = $product['product_id'];
369: 					$_product = wc_get_product( $prod_id );
370: 					if ( ! $this->check_was_group_purchase( $product, $item_id ) ) {
371: 						continue;
372: 					}
373: 					if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $product['variation_id'] ) ) {
374: 						$prod_id = $product['variation_id'];
375: 					}
376: 					$prod_name = $product['name'];
377: 					$courses   = get_post_meta( $prod_id, 'product_options', true );
378: 					$data     .= "<div><p><strong>$prod_name</strong></p><ol>";
379: 					foreach ( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] as $course_id ) {
380: 						$data .= '<li><a href=' . get_permalink( $course_id ) . '>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</a></li>';
381: 					}
382: 					$data .= '</ol></div>';
383: 				}
384: 				$data .= '</div>';
385: 				return $data;
386: 			}
387: 		}
388: 		private function get_new_products_courses( $args ) {
389: 			if ( isset( $args['courses'] ) ) {
390: 				$data  = '<div>';
391: 				$data .= '<div><ol>';
392: 				foreach ( $args['courses'] as $course_id ) {
393: 					$data .= '<li><a href=' . get_permalink( $course_id ) . '>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</a></li>';
394: 				}
395: 				$data .= '</ol></div>';
396: 				$data .= '</div>';
397: 				return $data;
398: 			}
399: 		}
400: 		private function check_was_group_purchase( $product, $item_id ) {
401: 			$is_gp     = true;
402: 			$prod_name = $product['name'];
403: 			$prod_id   = $product['product_id'];
404: 			$_product = wc_get_product( $prod_id );
405: 			if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $product['variation_id'] ) ) {
406: 				$prod_id = $product['variation_id'];
407: 			}
408: 			$courses = get_post_meta( $prod_id, 'product_options', true );
409: 			if ( ! isset( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] ) || count( $courses['moodle_post_course_id'] ) < 1 ) {
410: 				$is_gp = false;
411: 			}
412: 			if ( ! isset( $courses['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) || 'on' !== $courses['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
413: 				$is_gp = false;
414: 			}
415: 			$order_meta = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, 'Group Enrollment' );
416: 			if ( 'no' === $order_meta ) {
417: 				$is_gp = false;
418: 			}
419: 			return $is_gp;
420: 		}
421: 		private function get_cohort_courses( $args ) {
422: 			if ( ! isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
423: 				return '';
424: 			}
425: 			$cohort_id = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
426: 			global $wpdb;
427: 			$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
428: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "select COURSES from {$tbl_cohort_info} where MDL_COHORT_ID=%s", $cohort_id ) );
429: 			$results = maybe_unserialize( $results->COURSES );
430: 			$out_put = '<div><ul>';
431: 			foreach ( $results as $course_id ) {
432: 				$out_put .= '<li>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</li>';
433: 			}
434: 			$out_put .= '</ul></div>';
435: 			return $out_put;
436: 		}
437: 		private function get_manager_name( $args ) {
438: 			if ( ! isset( $args['cohort_manager_id'] ) ) {
439: 				return '';
440: 			}
441: 			$manager_id = $args['cohort_manager_id'];
442: 			$manager    = get_userdata( $manager_id );
443: 			return $manager->display_name;
444: 		}
445: 		private function get_cohort_name( $args ) {
446: 			if ( isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
447: 				global $wpdb;
448: 				$cohort_id       = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
449: 				$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
450: 				$cohort_name     = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT COHORT_NAME FROM {$tbl_cohort_info} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %s", $cohort_id ) );
451: 				$manager_name    = get_userdata( $args['cohort_manager_id'] );
452: 				return str_replace( $manager_name->user_login . '_', '', $cohort_name );
453: 			}
454: 			return 'cohort';
455: 		}
456: 		private function get_cohort_unenrolled_courses( $args ) {
457: 			if ( ! isset( $args['mdl_cohort_id'] ) ) {
458: 				return '';
459: 			}
460: 			$cohort_id = $args['mdl_cohort_id'];
461: 			global $wpdb;
462: 			$tbl_cohort_info = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
463: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "select COURSES AS courses from {$tbl_cohort_info} where MDL_COHORT_ID=%s", $cohort_id ) );
464: 			$results = maybe_unserialize( $results->courses );
465: 			$out_put = '<div><ol>';
466: 			foreach ( $results as $course_id ) {
467: 				$out_put .= '<li>' . get_the_title( $course_id ) . '</li>';
468: 			}
469: 			$out_put .= '</ol></div>';
470: 			return $out_put;
471: 		}

 10: 	class Eb_Bp_Group_Table extends \WP_List_Table {

 12: 		public function __construct() {
 13: 			parent::__construct(
 14: 				array(
 15: 					'singular' => 'group',

 18: 				)

 20: 			$this->bp_group_columns = apply_filters(

 27: 					'available_seats' => esc_html__( 'Available Seats', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 28: 					'courses'         => esc_html__( 'Courses', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 29: 				)
 30: 			);
 31: 		}
 32: 		private function eb_get_filter_query( $filter, $search_text, $from, $to, $order, $per_page, $offset, $stmt ) {
 33: 			global $wpdb;
 34: 			$column     = '';
 35: 			$where      = '';
 36: 			$post_table = '';
 37: 			$user_table = '';
 38: 			$date       = empty( $from ) ? '' : "time> '" . $from . "'" . ( empty( $to ) ? '' : " AND time< '" . $to . "'" );
 39: 			// There are 2 filters which need join query.
 40: 			// 1. Group name.
 41: 			// 2. User name.
 42: 			if ( 'group_name' === $filter ) {
 43: 				$order = $order;
 44: 				$where = '1';
 45: 				$stmt  = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.* FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b WHERE {$where} ORDER BY {$order} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", $per_page, $offset );
 46: 				if ( ! empty( $search_text ) ) {
 47: 					$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.* FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b, WHERE b.NAME like %s ORDER BY {$order} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", '%' . $search_text . '%', $per_page, $offset );
 48: 				}
 49: 			} elseif ( 'user' === $filter ) {
 50: 				$column     = ' u.user_login ';
 51: 				$order      = $column . $order;
 52: 				$where      = 'b.COHORT_MANAGER=u.ID';
 53: 				$user_table = ', ' . $wpdb->users . ' u';
 54: 				$stmt  = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.*, {$column} FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b  {$post_table} {$user_table}  WHERE {$where} ORDER BY {$order} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", $per_page, $offset );
 55: 				if ( ! empty( $search_text ) ) {
 56: 					$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.*, u.user_login FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b LEFT JOIN {$wpdb->users} u ON u.ID=b.COHORT_MANAGER WHERE b.NAME like %s AND u.ID=b.COHORT_MANAGER  ORDER BY u.user_login", '%' . $search_text . '%' );
 57: 				}
 58: 			}
 59: 			if ( ! empty( $from ) || ! empty( $to ) ) {
 60: 				$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.*, {$column} FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b {$post_table} {$user_table}  WHERE {$where} AND {$date} ORDER BY {$order} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", $per_page, $offset );
 61: 			}
 62: 			if ( ( ! empty( $from ) || ! empty( $to ) ) && ! empty( $search_text ) ) {
 63: 				$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.*, {$column} FROM wp_bp_cohort_info b LEFT JOIN wp_users u ON b.COHORT_MANAGER=u.ID WHERE b.NAME like %s AND time>= %s  AND time<= %s ORDER BY {$order} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", '%' . $search_text . '%', $from, $to, $per_page, $offset );
 64: 			}
 65: 			return $stmt;
 66: 		}
 67: 		public function bp_get_groups_table( $post_data, $search_text, $current_page ) {
 68: 			global $wpdb;
 69: 			$per_page    = 20;
 70: 			$search_text = isset( $_REQUEST['ebbp_grp_search'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['ebbp_grp_search'] ) ) : ''; // WPCS: CSRF ok, input var ok. // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
 71: 			$from        = isset( $_REQUEST['enrollment_from_date'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['enrollment_from_date'] ) ) : ''; // WPCS: CSRF ok, input var ok. // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
 72: 			$to          = isset( $_REQUEST['enrollment_to_date'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['enrollment_to_date'] ) ) : ''; // WPCS: CSRF ok, input var ok. // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
 73: 			// If no sort, default to title.
 74: 			$order_by = ! empty( $_REQUEST['orderby'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['orderby'] ) ) : 'id';
 75: 			$order = ! empty( $_REQUEST['order'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['order'] ) ) : 'asc';
 76: 			$date  = empty( $from ) ? '' : "time> '" . $from . "'" . ( empty( $to ) ? '' : " AND time< '" . $to . "'" );
 77: 			if ( 'group_name' === $order_by ) {
 78: 				$order_by = 'NAME';
 79: 			}
 80: 			$order_query = $order_by . ' ' . strtoupper( $order );
 81: 			$tbl_records = array();
 82: 			$offset      = ( $current_page - 1 ) * $per_page;
 83: 			$stmt        = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info ORDER BY {$order_query} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", $per_page, $offset );
 84: 			if ( ! empty( $search_text ) ) {
 85: 				$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.* FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b WHERE b.NAME like %s ORDER BY {$order_query} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", '%' . $search_text . '%', $per_page, $offset );
 86: 			}
 87: 			if ( ! empty( $from ) || ! empty( $to ) ) {
 88: 				$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info  WHERE {$date} ORDER BY {$order_query} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", $per_page, $offset );
 89: 			}
 90: 			if ( ( ! empty( $from ) || ! empty( $to ) ) && ! empty( $search_text ) ) {
 91: 				$stmt = $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT b.* FROM {$wpdb->prefix}bp_cohort_info b WHERE b.NAME like %s AND {$date} ORDER BY {$order_query} LIMIT %d OFFSET %d", '%' . $search_text . '%', $per_page, $offset );
 92: 			}
 93: 			if ( ! empty( $order_by ) && 'id' !== $order_by && 'time' !== $order_by ) {
 94: 				$stmt = $this->eb_get_filter_query( $order_by, $search_text, $from, $to, $order, $per_page, $offset, $stmt );
 95: 			}
 96: 			$results = $wpdb->get_results( $stmt );
 97: 			foreach ( $results as $result ) {
 98: 				$profile_url       = $this->get_user_profile_url( $result->COHORT_MANAGER );
 99: 				$row               = array();
100: 				$row['user_id']    = $result->COHORT_MANAGER;
101: 				$row['user']       = $profile_url;
102: 				$row['group_name'] = $result->NAME;
103: 				$row['manage']     = true;
104: 				$row['ID']         = $result->ID;
105: 				$row['rId']        = $result->ID;
106:                 $row['cohort_id']  = $result->MDL_COHORT_ID;
107: 				$row['products']   = $result->PRODUCTS;
108: 				$row['courses']    = $result->COURSES;
109: 				$tbl_records[] = apply_filters( 'eb_bp_manage_grpup_each_row', $row, $result, $search_text );
110: 			}
111: 			$table_data    = apply_filters( 'eb_bp_manage_group_table_data', $tbl_records );
112: 			$total_records = $this->eb_get_enrollment_total_record( $search_text, $from, $to );
113: 			return array(
114: 				'total_records' => $total_records,
115: 				'data'          => $table_data,
116: 			);
117: 		}

208: 		public function extra_tablenav( $which ) {

243: 			$group_ids = implode( ',', $group_ids );

247: 			$wpdb->query( "DELETE FROM `{$tbl_name}` WHERE `id` IN ({$group_ids})" );
248: 			echo '<div class="notice notice-success is-dismissible">';

259: 			$current_page = $this->get_pagenum();
260: 			if ( isset( $_REQUEST['eb-bp-manage-groups'] ) && ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['eb-bp-manage-groups'] ) ), 'eb-bp-manage-groups' ) ) {
261: 				return;
262: 			}
263: 			$this->process_bulk_action( $_POST );
264: 			$search_text = isset( $_REQUEST['ebbp_grp_search'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_REQUEST['ebbp_grp_search'] ) ) : '';
265: 			$options['ebbp_grp_search'] = $search_text;
266: 			$table_data = $this->bp_get_groups_table( $_REQUEST, $search_text, $current_page );
267: 			$data       = $table_data['data'];
268: 			$total_items = $table_data['total_records'];
269: 			$this->items = $data;
270: 			$this->set_pagination_args(
271: 				array(
272: 					'total_items' => $total_items,
273: 					'per_page'    => $per_page,
274: 					'total_pages' => ceil( $total_items / $per_page ),
275: 				)
276: 			);
277: 			$_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] = add_query_arg( $options, $_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'] );
278: 		}
279: 	}

285: 		private function get_order_courses_ids( $order ) {
286: 			$list_of_course_ids = array();
287: 			$items = $order->get_items();
288: 			foreach ( $items as $single_item => $item_meta ) {
289: 				$single_item = $single_item;
290: 				$product_id  = '';
291: 				if ( isset( $item_meta['product_id'] ) ) {
292: 					$_product = wc_get_product( $item_meta['product_id'] );

303: 						if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && isset( $item_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) && 'yes' === $item_meta['Group Enrollment'] ) {
304: 							$line_item_course_ids = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
305: 							if ( ! empty( $list_of_course_ids ) ) {
306: 								$list_of_course_ids = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_course_ids, $line_item_course_ids ), SORT_REGULAR );
307: 							} else {
308: 								$list_of_course_ids = $line_item_course_ids;
309: 							}
310: 						}
311: 					}
312: 				}
313: 			}

315: 		}
316: 		private function add_in_same_cohort( $cohort_name, $course_ids ) {
317: 			global $wpdb;
318: 			$table_name      = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
319: 			$results         = $wpdb->get_results( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT * FROM $table_name WHERE cohort_name like '%s'", $cohort_name . '%' ), ARRAY_A );
320: 			$new_cohort_name = null;
321: 			foreach ( $results as $res ) {
322: 				$existing_courses = maybe_unserialize( $res['COURSES'] );
323: 				sort( $existing_courses );
324: 				sort( $course_ids );
325: 				if ( $existing_courses === $course_ids && $cohort_name === $res['COHORT_NAME'] ) {
326: 					$new_cohort_name = $res['COHORT_NAME'];
327: 					break;
328: 				}
329: 			}
330: 			if ( null !== $new_cohort_name ) {
331: 				return array(
332: 					'add_in_same_cohort' => true,
333: 					'cohort_name'        => $new_cohort_name,
334: 				);
335: 			}
336: 			return array( 'add_in_same_cohort' => false );
337: 		}

342: 			$result = ++$result;
343: 			$user_info   = get_userdata( $user_id );
344: 			$cohort_name = $user_info->user_login . '_' . $cohort_name;
345: 			if ( $result > 0 ) {
346: 				$cohort_name = $cohort_name . '_' . $result;
347: 			}
348: 			return $cohort_name;
349: 		}

120: 		public function product_quantity_after_order_complete( $items, $old_prod_arr ) {
121: 			$new_prod_arr = array();
122: 			foreach ( $items as $item => $property ) {
123: 				$product_id = $property['product_id'];
124: 				$_product   = wc_get_product( $property['product_id'] );
125: 				if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $property['variation_id'] ) ) {
126: 					$product_id = $property['variation_id'];
127: 				}
128: 				foreach ( $old_prod_arr as $key => $value ) {
129: 					if ( $product_id === $key ) {
130: 						$new_prod_arr[ $key ] = $value + $property['qty'];
131: 					}
132: 				}
133: 				unset( $item );
134: 			}
135: 			return $new_prod_arr;
136: 		}

143: 		public function wdm_update_moodle_enrollment( $enrolled_users, $course_id, $enrolled_by, $product_id, $cohort_name ) {
144: 			global $wpdb;

146: 			$user_role  = 'Student';
147: 			foreach ( $enrolled_users as $user ) {
148: 				$wpdb->insert(
149: 					$table_name,
150: 					array(
151: 						'user_id'       => $user,
152: 						'course_id'     => $course_id,
153: 						'role_id'       => 5,
154: 						'time'          => date( 'Y-m-d h:i:s' ),
155: 						'enrolled_by'   => $enrolled_by,
156: 						'product_id'    => $product_id,
157: 						'mdl_cohort_id' => $cohort_name,
158: 						'role'          => $user_role,
159: 					),
160: 					array(
161: 						'%d',
162: 						'%d',
163: 						'%d',
164: 						'%s',
165: 						'%d',
166: 						'%d',
167: 						'%s',
168: 						'%s',
169: 					)

173: 		public function wdm_update_cohort_info( $order_data, $order_id ) {
174: 			global $wpdb;
175: 			foreach ( $order_data as $cohort_details ) {
176: 				$mdl_cohort_id = $cohort_details['cohort_id'];
177: 				$order         = new \WC_Order( $order_id );
178: 				$user          = $order->get_user();
179: 				$cuser_id      = $user->ID;
180: 				$table_name        = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
181: 				$results           = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT PRODUCTS, COURSES, COHORT_NAME, COHORT_MANAGER, INCOMP_ORD FROM {$table_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $mdl_cohort_id ) );
182: 				$products          = maybe_unserialize( $results->PRODUCTS );
183: 				$courses           = maybe_unserialize( $results->COURSES );
184: 				$cohort_name       = $results->COHORT_NAME;
185: 				$cohort_manager_id = $results->COHORT_MANAGER;
186: 				$products_list     = array_keys( $products );
187: 				$courses_list      = array_values( $courses );
188: 				$incomp_order      = maybe_unserialize( $results->INCOMP_ORD );
189: 				$table_name     = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
190: 				$enrolled_users = $wpdb->get_col( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM {$table_name} WHERE enrolled_by = %d AND MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cuser_id, $mdl_cohort_id ) );
191: 				$product        = $cohort_details['product_id'];
192: 				$quantity       = $cohort_details['quantity'];
193: 				if ( in_array( $product, $products_list, true ) ) {
194: 					$products[ $product ] += $quantity;
195: 				} else {
196: 					$products[ $product ] = intval( $quantity ) - count( $enrolled_users );
197: 				}
198: 				$courses_product  = $this->wdm_courses_associated_with_product( $product );
199: 				$unenroll_courses = array_diff( $courses_product, $courses_list );
200: 				$cohrt_manager    = new Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
201: 				$cohrt_manager->enroll_cohort_in_courses( $unenroll_courses, $cohort_name, $cohort_manager_id );
202: 				foreach ( $courses_product as $course ) {
203: 					if ( ! in_array( $course, $courses_list, true ) && ! in_array( $course, $courses, true ) ) {
204: 						array_push( $courses, $course );
205: 						if ( ! empty( $enrolled_users ) ) {
206: 							$this->wdm_update_moodle_enrollment( $enrolled_users, $course, $cuser_id, $product, $mdl_cohort_id );
207: 						}
208: 					}
209: 				}
210: 				$table_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
211: 				$key        = array_search( $order_id, $incomp_order, true );
212: 				if ( false !== $key ) {
213: 					unset( $incomp_order[ $key ] );
214: 				}
215: 				$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE {$table_name} SET PRODUCTS = %s, COURSES = %s, INCOMP_ORD = %s  WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", serialize( $products ), serialize( $courses ), serialize( $incomp_order ), $mdl_cohort_id ) );
216: 				$quantity = 0;
217: 				foreach ( $products as $key => $value ) {
218: 					$key      = $key;
219: 					$quantity = $value;
220: 				}
221: 				update_cohort_id_in_order_meta( $order_id, $mdl_cohort_id, $quantity );
222: 			}
223: 		}
224: 		public function wdm_save_product_qty( $order_id, $old_status, $new_status ) {
225: 			$order   = wc_get_order( $order_id );
226: 			$items   = $order->get_items();
227: 			$user    = $order->get_user();
228: 			$user_id = $user->ID;
229: 			if ( 'completed' === $new_status ) {
230: 				$flag_bp                      = false;
231: 				$email_args                   = array(
232: 					'user_email' => $user->user_email,
233: 					'order_id'   => $order_id,
234: 				);
235: 				$order_meta                   = wc_get_order_item_meta( $order_id, 'Group Enrollment' );
236: 				$non_bulk_purchase_prod_count = 0;
237: 				foreach ( $items as $item_id => $prop ) {
238: 					$order_meta   = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, 'Group Enrollment' );
239: 					$item_prod_id = wc_get_order_item_meta( $item_id, '_product_id' );
240: 					if ( 'no' === $order_meta ) {
241: 					} else {
242: 						$flag_bp = true;
243: 					}
244: 					$prop = $prop;
245: 				}
246: 				if ( $non_bulk_purchase_prod_count ) {
247: 					$email_args = array(
248: 						'user_email'    => $user->user_email,
249: 						'order_id'      => $order_id,
250: 						'username'      => $user->user_login,
251: 						'first_name'    => $user->first_name,
252: 						'last_name'     => $user->last_name,
253: 						'bulk_purchase' => 1,
254: 					);
255: 					do_action( 'eb_bp_send_normal_enrollemnt_mail', $email_args );
256: 				}
257: 				$order_data = $order->get_meta( 'add_product_from_enroll_page', true );
258: 				if ( ! empty( $order_data ) ) {
259: 					$this->wdm_update_cohort_info( $order_data, $order_id );
260: 				}
261: 				if ( 0 !== $user_id ) {
262: 					$this->bulk_product_names = array();
263: 					global $wpdb;
264: 					$table_name    = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
265: 					$query         = "SELECT ID, COHORT_NAME, NAME, PRODUCTS, COURSES, INCOMP_ORD, SYNC, idnumber  FROM  {$table_name} WHERE COHORT_MANAGER = $user_id";
266: 					$results       = $wpdb->get_results( $query, ARRAY_A );
267: 					$cohrt_manager = new Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
268: 					foreach ( $results as $tbl_row ) {
269: 						$incomp_order = $tbl_row['INCOMP_ORD'];
270: 						$incomp_order = maybe_unserialize( $incomp_order );
271: 						$present      = in_array( $order_id, $incomp_order, true );
272: 						$prod_array   = maybe_unserialize( $tbl_row['PRODUCTS'] );
273: 						$courses      = $tbl_row['COURSES'];
274: 						$courses      = maybe_unserialize( $courses );
275: 						if ( $present ) {
276: 							$prod_qty       = $this->product_quantity_after_order_complete( $items, $prod_array );
277: 							$cohort_details = array(
278: 								'success'     => $tbl_row['SYNC'] ? 1 : 0,
279: 								'cohort_name' => $tbl_row['COHORT_NAME'],
280: 							);
281: 							$cohrt_manager->update_cohort_on_user_enrollment( $order_id, $user_id, $cohort_details, $courses, $prod_qty, $incomp_order, $tbl_row['idnumber'] );
282: 						}
283: 					}
284: 				}
285: 				if ( $flag_bp && isset( $present ) && $present ) {
286: 					$email_args = array(
287: 						'user_email' => $user->user_email,
288: 						'order_id'   => $order_id,
289: 						'username'   => $user->user_login,
290: 						'first_name' => $user->first_name,
291: 						'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
292: 					);
293: 					do_action( 'eb_bp_bulk_purchase_email', $email_args );
294: 				}
295: 			} elseif ( ( 'failed' == $new_status || 'cancelled' == $new_status ) &&  0 !== $user_id ){
296: 				global $wpdb;
297: 				$table_name    = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
298: 				$query         = "SELECT ID, COHORT_NAME, NAME, PRODUCTS, COURSES, INCOMP_ORD, SYNC, idnumber  FROM  {$table_name} WHERE COHORT_MANAGER = $user_id";
299: 				$results       = $wpdb->get_results( $query, ARRAY_A );
300: 				$cohrt_manager = new Eb_Bp_Manage_Cohort();
301: 				foreach ( $results as $tbl_row ) {
302: 					$incomp_order = $tbl_row['INCOMP_ORD'];
303: 					$incomp_order = maybe_unserialize( $incomp_order );
304: 					$present      = in_array( $order_id, $incomp_order, true );
305: 					if( $present ) {
306: 						$wpdb->delete( $table_name, array( 'ID' => $tbl_row['ID'] ) );
307: 					}
308: 				}
309: 			}
310: 		}
311: 		private function enroll_user_to_course( $product_id, $order, $item ) {
312: 			global $wpdb;
313: 			$_product = wc_get_product( $product_id );
314: 			if ( $_product && $_product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $item['variation_id'] ) ) {
315: 				$product_id = $item['variation_id'];
316: 			}
317: 			$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
318: 			$tbl_name        = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
319: 			$user          = $order->get_user();
320: 			$order_user    = $user->ID;
321: 			$mdl_course_id = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
322: 			if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) && 'on' === $product_options['moodle_course_group_purchase'] && ! empty( $mdl_course_id ) ) {
323: 				$args             = array(
324: 					'user_id'  => $order_user,
325: 					'courses'  => $mdl_course_id,
326: 					'unenroll' => 0,
327: 					'suspend'  => 0,
328: 				);
329: 				$is_user_enrolled = $this->is_user_enrolled( $mdl_course_id, $order_user, $order );
330: 				$course_enrolled  = edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->enrollmentManager()->updateUserCourseEnrollment( $args );
331: 				if ( isset( $course_enrolled ) && ! empty( $course_enrolled ) && $is_user_enrolled ) {
332: 					$courses = '(' . implode( ',', $mdl_course_id ) . ')';
333: 					$query   = $wpdb->prepare( "update `{$tbl_name}` set enrolled_by = %d, product_id = %d  where user_id = %d and course_id in {$courses}", $order_user, $product_id, $order_user );
334: 					$wpdb->query( $query );
335: 				}
336: 				return 0;
337: 			} else {
338: 				return 1;
339: 			}
340: 		}

351: 		public function save_product_quantity( $group_products, $order, $order_id ) {
352: 			$group_products = $this->check_is_quantity_empty( $group_products );
353: 			$user           = $order->get_user();
354: 			$user_id        = $user->ID;
355: 			if ( ! empty( $group_products ) && $this->is_eb_bp_order_mark_completed( $user_id, $order_id ) ) {
356: 				update_user_meta( $user_id, 'group_products', $group_products );
357: 			}
358: 		}
359: 		private function check_is_quantity_empty( $group_products ) {
360: 			foreach ( $group_products as $key => $val ) {
361: 				if ( null === $val || $val <= 0 ) {
362: 					unset( $group_products[ $key ] );
363: 				}
364: 			}
365: 			return $group_products;
366: 		}
367: 		private function set_eb_bp_order_status( $user_id, $order_id ) {
368: 			$eb_bp_orders = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'eb_bp_compleated_orders', true );
369: 			if ( is_array( $eb_bp_orders ) ) {
370: 				$eb_bp_orders[ $order_id ] = 1;
371: 			} else {
372: 				$eb_bp_orders = array( $order_id => 1 );
373: 			}
374: 			update_user_meta( $user_id, 'eb_bp_compleated_orders', $eb_bp_orders );
375: 		}
376: 		private function is_eb_bp_order_mark_completed( $user_id, $order_id ) {
377: 			$eb_bp_orders = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'eb_bp_compleated_orders', true );
378: 			$flag         = true;
379: 			if ( is_array( $eb_bp_orders ) && array_key_exists( $order_id, $eb_bp_orders ) && 1 === $eb_bp_orders[ $order_id ] ) {
380: 				$flag = false;
381: 			} else {
382: 				$this->set_eb_bp_order_status( $user_id, $order_id );
383: 			}
384: 			return $flag;
385: 		}
386: 		public function update_product_quantity( $product, $group_products, $product_id ) {
387: 			$flag      = false;
388: 			$post_meta = get_post_meta( $product['product_id'], 'product_options', true );
389: 			if ( isset( $post_meta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) && ! empty( $post_meta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) ) {
390: 				if ( 'on' === $post_meta['moodle_course_group_purchase'] ) {
391: 					if ( ! isset( $group_products[ $product_id ] ) && empty( $group_products[ $product_id ] ) ) {
392: 						$group_products[ $product_id ] = 0;
393: 					}

300: 		public function set_csv_users_response_data( $user_id, $cohort_id, $enroll_error, $enrolled_user, $enroll_suc ) {

321: 		private function is_invalid_user_req_data( $data ) {
322: 			$key_arr = array( 'mdl_cohort_id', 'firstname', 'lastname', 'email' );

324: 				if ( ! $this->check_is_empty( $data, $key ) ) {

333: 			} else {
334: 				return false;

353: 					edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->userManager()->userCourseSynchronizationHandler( array( 'eb_synchronize_user_courses' => 1 ), $user->ID );
354: 				} else {
355: 					$password    = wp_generate_password();
356: 					$user_data   = array(

358: 						'password'  => $password,

363: 						'lang'      => $language,
364: 					);
365: 					$moodle_user = edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->userManager()->createMoodleUser( $user_data, 0 );
366: 					if ( isset( $moodle_user['user_created'] ) && 1 === $moodle_user['user_created'] && is_object( $moodle_user['user_data'] ) ) {
367: 						update_user_meta( $user->ID, 'moodle_user_id', $moodle_user['user_data']->id );
