398: 		public function get_product_array( $products, $course_id ) {
399: 			global $wpdb;
400: 			$products = maybe_unserialize( $products );
401: 			$prod_arr = array();
402: 			$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
403: 			foreach ( $products as $key => $value ) {
404: 				unset( $value );
405: 				$results = $wpdb->get_col( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT moodle_post_id FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE product_id = %d", $key ) );
406: 				if ( in_array( $course_id, $results, true ) ) {
407: 					array_push( $prod_arr, $key );
408: 				}
409: 			}
410: 			return $prod_arr;
411: 		}
412: 		public function update_bp_cohort_info_table_on_enrollment( $cohort_id, $rem_qty ) {
413: 			global $wpdb;
414: 			$tbl_name    = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
415: 			$results     = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT PRODUCTS FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE MDL_COHORT_ID = %d", $cohort_id ) );
416: 			$cohort_prod = maybe_unserialize( $results );
417: 			foreach ( $cohort_prod as $prod_id => $qty ) {
418: 				$qty                     = $qty;
419: 				$cohort_prod[ $prod_id ] = $rem_qty;
420: 			}
421: 			$wpdb->update(
422: 				$tbl_name,
423: 				array( 'PRODUCTS' => serialize( $cohort_prod ) ),
424: 				array( 'MDL_COHORT_ID' => $cohort_id )
425: 			);
426: 		}
427: 		public function get_cohort_details( $mdl_cohort_id ) {
428: 			global $wpdb;
429: 			$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
430: 			$results  = $wpdb->get_row( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT MDL_COHORT_ID AS mdl_cohort_id, PRODUCTS AS products, COURSES AS courses, COHORT_NAME AS cohort_name, NAME AS name FROM {$tbl_name} WHERE mdl_cohort_id = %d", $mdl_cohort_id ), ARRAY_A );
431: 			$prod_arr = $results['products'];
432: 			$products = maybe_unserialize( $results['products'] );
433: 			$courses  = maybe_unserialize( $results['courses'] );
434: 			$products = is_array( $products ) ? array_values( $products ) : array();
435: 			$min_qty  = min( $products );
436: 			return array(
437: 				'quantity'      => $min_qty,
438: 				'name'          => '' !== $results['name'] ? $results['name'] : $results['cohort_name'],
439: 				'courses'       => $courses,
440: 				'products'      => $prod_arr,
441: 				'mdl_cohort_id' => $results['mdl_cohort_id'],
442: 			);
443: 		}

460: 			$cuser_id  = get_current_user_id();

462: 			$user      = new \WP_User( $user_id );
463: 			if ( $user_info->user_email === $email ) {
464: 				$genral_settings = get_option( 'eb_general', array() );
465: 				if ( isset( $genral_settings['mucp_group_manager_role'] ) && 'yes' == $genral_settings['mucp_group_manager_role'] ) {
466: 					$user->add_role( 'non_editing_teacher' );
467: 				}

470: 		private function get_product_courses( $product ) {
471: 			global $wpdb;
472: 			$tbl_name      = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
473: 			$eb_course_ids = array();
474: 			$stmt          = "SELECT DISTINCT `product_id`,`moodle_post_id` FROM `{$tbl_name}` WHERE `product_id` in ('" . implode( "','", $product ) . "');";
475: 			$result        = $wpdb->get_results( $stmt, ARRAY_A );
476: 			foreach ( $result as $rec ) {
477: 				$eb_course_ids[ $rec['moodle_post_id'] ] = $rec['product_id'];
478: 			}
479: 			return $eb_course_ids;
480: 		}
481: 		protected function enroll_user( $mdl_cohort_id, $user_id, $curr_user_id, $user_role, $prod_ids ) {
482: 			global $wpdb;
483: 			$status          = false;
484: 			$prod_ids        = maybe_unserialize( $prod_ids );
485: 			$course_post_ids = $this->get_product_courses( array_keys( $prod_ids ) );
486: 			foreach ( $course_post_ids as $course_id => $prod_id ) {
487: 					$status = $wpdb->insert(
488: 						$wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment',
489: 						array(
490: 							'user_id'       => $user_id,
491: 							'course_id'     => $course_id,
492: 							'role_id'       => '5',
493: 							'time'          => date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ),
494: 							'enrolled_by'   => $curr_user_id,
495: 							'product_id'    => $prod_id,
496: 							'mdl_cohort_id' => $mdl_cohort_id,
497: 							'role'          => $user_role,
498: 						),
499: 						array(
500: 							'%d',
501: 							'%d',
502: 							'%d',
503: 							'%s',
504: 							'%s',
505: 							'%d',
506: 							'%d',
507: 							'%s',
508: 						)
509: 					);
510: 			}
511: 			return $status;
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

393: 	public function save_custom_fields() {
394: 		$response = array(
395: 			'status'  => 'error',
396: 			'message' => __( 'Error while saving custom fields', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
397: 		);
398: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'eb_cf_dialog_nonce' ) ) {
399: 			$response['message'] = __( 'Invalid nonce', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
400: 			wp_send_json( $response );
401: 		}
402: 		$data = isset( $_POST['data'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_POST['data'] ) : array();
403: 		if ( empty( $data ) ) {
404: 			$response['message'] = __( 'No data found', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
405: 			wp_send_json( $response );
406: 		}
407: 		$custom_fields = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
408: 		$field_name = isset( $data['name'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $data['name'] ) : '';
409: 		if ( empty( $field_name ) ) {
410: 			$response['message'] = __( 'Field name is required', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
411: 			wp_send_json( $response );
412: 		}
413: 		unset( $data['name'] );
414: 		if ( isset( $data['old_name'] ) ) {
415: 			$old_name = sanitize_text_field( $data['old_name'] );
416: 			unset( $data['old_name'] );
417: 			if ( $old_name !== $field_name ) {
418: 				unset( $custom_fields[ $old_name ] );
419: 			}
420: 		}
421: 		if ( 'select' === $data['type'] ) {
422: 			$options = isset( $data['options'] ) ? $data['options'] : '';
423: 			$options = stripslashes( $options );
424: 			$options = str_replace( "'", '"', $options );
425: 			$options = (array) json_decode( $options );
426: 			// unset options from data.
427: 			unset( $data['options'] );
428: 			foreach ( $options as $option_value => $option_text ) {
429: 				$data['options'][ $option_value ] = sanitize_text_field( $option_text );
430: 			}
431: 		}
432: 		$custom_fields[ $field_name ] = $data;
433: 		update_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', $custom_fields );
434: 		$response['status']  = 'success';
435: 		$response['message'] = __( 'Custom field saved successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
436: 		wp_send_json( $response );
437: 	}
438: 	public function delete_custom_fields() {
439: 		$response = array(
440: 			'status'  => 'error',
441: 			'message' => __( 'Error while deleting custom fields', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
442: 		);
443: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'eb_cf_dialog_nonce' ) ) {
444: 			$response['message'] = __( 'Invalid nonce', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
445: 			wp_send_json( $response );
446: 		}
447: 		$field = isset( $_POST['name'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_POST['name'] ) : ''; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
448: 		if ( '' === $field ) {
449: 			$response['message'] = __( 'No data found', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
450: 			wp_send_json( $response );
451: 		}
452: 		$custom_fields = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
453: 		unset( $custom_fields[ $field ] );
454: 		update_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', $custom_fields );
455: 		$response['status']  = 'success';
456: 		$response['message'] = __( 'Custom field deleted successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
457: 		wp_send_json( $response );
458: 	}
459: 	public function save_custom_field_order() {
460: 		$custom_fields_name = isset( $_POST['eb-cf-tbl-name'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_POST['eb-cf-tbl-name'] ) : array();
461: 		$custom_fields     = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
462: 		$custom_fields_new = array();
463: 		foreach ( $custom_fields_name as $field_name ) {
464: 			$custom_fields_new[ $field_name ] = $custom_fields[ $field_name ];
465: 		}
466: 		update_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', $custom_fields_new );
467: 	}
468: 	public function handle_bulk_actions() {
469: 		$response = array(
470: 			'status'  => 'error',
471: 			'message' => __( 'Error while performing bulk action', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
472: 		);
473: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['nonce'] ) || ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['nonce'] ) ), 'eb_cf_dialog_nonce' ) ) {
474: 			$response['message'] = __( 'Invalid nonce', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
475: 			wp_send_json( $response );
476: 		}
477: 		$action             = isset( $_POST['bulk_action'] ) ? sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['bulk_action'] ) ) : '';
478: 		$custom_field_names = isset( $_POST['custom_fields'] ) ? wp_unslash( $_POST['custom_fields'] ) : array();
479: 		if ( '' === $action || empty( $custom_field_names ) ) {
480: 			$response['message'] = __( 'No data found', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
481: 			wp_send_json( $response );
482: 		}
483: 		$custom_fields = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
484: 		if ( 'enable' === $action ) {
485: 			foreach ( $custom_fields as $field_name => $field ) {
486: 				if ( in_array( $field_name, $custom_field_names ) ) {
487: 					$custom_fields[ $field_name ]['enabled'] = 1;
488: 				}
489: 			}
490: 		} elseif ( 'disable' === $action ) {
491: 			foreach ( $custom_fields as $field_name => $field ) {
492: 				if ( in_array( $field_name, $custom_field_names ) ) {
493: 					$custom_fields[ $field_name ]['enabled'] = 0;
494: 				}
495: 			}
496: 		} elseif ( 'delete' === $action ) {
497: 			foreach ( $custom_fields as $field_name => $field ) {
498: 				if( in_array( $field_name, $custom_field_names ) ) {
499: 					unset( $custom_fields[ $field_name ] );
500: 				}
501: 			}
502: 		}
503: 		update_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', $custom_fields );
504: 		$response['status']  = 'success';
505: 		$response['message'] = __( 'Bulk action performed successfully', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
506: 		wp_send_json( $response );
507: 	}
508: }
```

 46: 			'id'           => $moodle_user_id,
 47: 			'customfields' => $user_data,

 56: 	public function eb_cf_save_custom_fields_data_from_moodle( $user_id, $user_data ) {
 57: 		$fields = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
 58: 		$field_data = isset( $user_data['custom_fields'] ) ? json_decode( $user_data['custom_fields'], true ) : array();
 59: 		if ( ! empty( $field_data ) && ! empty( $fields ) ) {
 60: 			foreach ( $fields as $field_name => $field ) {
 61: 				if ( isset( $field['enabled'] ) && 1 == $field['enabled'] ) {
 62: 					$field_value = isset( $field_data[ $field_name ] ) ? $field_data[ $field_name ] : '';
 63: 					if ( 'date' === $field['type'] && '' !== $field_value ) {
 64: 						$gmt_date    = get_date_from_gmt( date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $field_value ) );
 65: 						$field_value = date( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( $gmt_date ) );
 66: 					}
 67: 					if ( '' !== $field_value ) {
 68: 						update_user_meta( $user_id, $field_name, $field_value );
 69: 					}
 70: 				}
 71: 			}
 72: 		}
 73: 	}
 74: 	/**
 75: 	 * Create user data array to sync with moodle.
 76: 	 *
 77: 	 * @param int $user_id user id.
 78: 	 *
 79: 	 * @since 1.0.0
 80: 	 */
 81: 	public function eb_cf_create_user_data( $user_id ) {
 82: 		$user_data = array();
 83: 		$fields    = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
 84: 		if ( is_array( $fields ) && ! empty( $fields ) ) {
 85: 			foreach ( $fields as $field_name => $field_details ) {
 86: 				if ( isset( $field_details['enabled'] ) && 1 == $field_details['enabled'] ) {
 87: 					if ( 'checkbox' === $field_details['type'] ) {
 88: 						$field_value = isset( $_POST[$field_name] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $_POST[$field_name] ) : 0;
 89: 					} else {
 90: 						$field_value = isset( $_POST[$field_name] ) ? sanitize_text_field( $_POST[$field_name] ) : get_user_meta( $user_id, $field_name, true );
 91: 					}
 92: 					$field_value = apply_filters( 'eb_cf_before_update_field_value', $field_value, $field_name, $user_id, $field_details );
 93: 					update_user_meta( $user_id, $field_name, $field_value );
 94: 					if ( ! isset( $field_details['sync-on-moodle'] ) || ! $field_details['sync-on-moodle'] ) {
 95: 						continue;
 96: 					}
 97: 					if ( 'date' === $field_details['type'] ) {
 98: 						$field_value = strtotime( $field_value );
 99: 					}
100: 					array_push(
101: 						$user_data,
102: 						array(
103: 							'type'  => $field_name,
104: 							'value' => $field_value,
105: 						)
106: 					);
107: 				}
108: 			}
109: 		}
110: 		$user_data = apply_filters( 'eb_cf_user_data', $user_data, $user_id );
111: 		return $user_data;
112: 	}
113: 	public function eb_cf_get_custom_fields_data_from_db( $user_id ) {
114: 		$user_data = array();
115: 		$fields    = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
116: 		if ( is_array( $fields ) && ! empty( $fields ) ) {
117: 			foreach ( $fields as $field_name => $field_details ) {
118: 				if ( isset( $field_details['enabled'] ) && 1 == $field_details['enabled'] ) {
119: 					$field_value = get_user_meta( $user_id, $field_name, true );
120: 					if ( 'checkbox' === $field_details['type'] ) {
121: 						$field_value = ! empty( $field_value ) ? $field_value : 0;
122: 					}
123: 					if ( ! isset( $field_details['sync-on-moodle'] ) || ! $field_details['sync-on-moodle'] ) {
124: 						continue;
125: 					}
126: 					if ( 'date' === $field_details['type'] ) {
127: 						$field_value = strtotime( $field_value );
128: 					}
129: 					array_push(
130: 						$user_data,
131: 						array(
132: 							'type'  => $field_name,
133: 							'value' => $field_value,
134: 						)
135: 					);
136: 				}
137: 			}
138: 		}
139: 		return $user_data;
140: 	}
141: }

28: 		return $required;

30: 	public function eb_validate_custom_fields( $page, $errors = '' ) {
31: 		if ( '' === $errors ) {
32: 			$errors = new \WP_Error();
33: 		}
34: 		$fields = get_option( 'edwiser_custom_fields', array() );
35: 		if ( is_array( $fields ) && ! empty( $fields ) ) {
36: 			foreach ( $fields as $field_name => $field_details ) {
37: 				if ( $this->eb_is_field_enabled( $field_details['enabled'] ) && $this->eb_is_field_required( $field_details['required'] ) && $this->eb_is_field_empty( $field_name ) ) {
38: 					switch ( $page ) {
39: 						case 'checkout':
40: 						case 'my-accnt':
41: 							wc_add_notice( '<b>' . $field_details['label'] . '</b>' . esc_html__( ' is a required field.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ), 'error' );
42: 							break;
43: 						case 'woo-reg':
44: 						case 'eb-reg':
45: 							$errors->add( $field_name . '_error', $field_details['label'] . __( ' is required!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
46: 							break;
47: 						default:
48: 					}
49: 				}
50: 			}
51: 		}
52: 		return $errors;
53: 	}
54: 	public function eb_is_field_enabled( $enabled ) {
55: 		if ( isset( $enabled ) && 1 == $enabled ) {
56: 			return true;
57: 		} else {
58: 			return false;
59: 		}
60: 	}
61: 	public function eb_is_field_required( $required ) {
62: 		if ( isset( $required ) && 1 == $required ) {
63: 			return true;
64: 		} else {
65: 			return false;
66: 		}
67: 	}
68: 	public function eb_is_field_empty( $field_name ) {
69: 		if ( isset( $_POST[$field_name] ) && empty( $_POST[$field_name] ) ) {
70: 			return true;
71: 		} else {
72: 			return false;
73: 		}

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/selective-sync/class-eb-select-course-ajax-handler.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\selectiveSync;
 3: use app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge as edwiser;
 4: class Eb_Select_Course_Ajax_Handler {
 5: 	private $plugin_name;
 6: 	private $version;
 7: 	public function __construct( $plugin_name, $version ) {
 8: 		$this->plugin_name = $plugin_name;
 9: 		$this->version     = $version;
10: 	}
11: 	public function selected_course_synchronization_initiater() {
12: 		if ( isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'], $_POST['selected_courses'], $_POST['update_course'] ) && wp_verify_nonce( wp_unslash( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ), 'check_select_sync_action' ) ) {
13: 			$selected_course_ids = wp_unslash( $_POST['selected_courses'] );
14: 			$sync_options        = wp_unslash( $_POST['update_course'] );
15: 			$response = $this->selected_course_synchronization_handler( $selected_course_ids, $sync_options );
16: 			echo wp_json_encode( $response );
17: 			die();
18: 		}
19: 		if ( isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) && ! wp_verify_nonce( sanitize_text_field( wp_unslash( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ), 'check_select_sync_action' ) ) {
20: 			die( 'Busted!' );
21: 		}
22: 	}
23: 	public function selected_course_synchronization_handler( $course_ids, $sync_options ) {
24: 		edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'user', 'Initiating course & category sync process....' );
25: 		$moodle_course_response   = array();
26: 		$moodle_category_response = array();
27: 		$response_array           = array();
28: 		$courses_updated          = array();
29: 		$courses_created          = array();
30: 		$connection_options = get_option( 'eb_connection' );
31: 		$eb_moodle_url = '';
32: 		if ( isset( $connection_options['eb_url'] ) ) {
33: 			$eb_moodle_url = $connection_options['eb_url'];
34: 		}
35: 		$eb_moodle_token = '';
36: 		if ( isset( $connection_options['eb_access_token'] ) ) {
37: 			$eb_moodle_token = $connection_options['eb_access_token'];
38: 		}
39: 		$connected = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->connection_helper()->connection_test_helper( $eb_moodle_url, $eb_moodle_token );
40: 		$response_array['connection_response'] = $connected['success'];
41: 		if ( 1 === $connected['success'] ) {
42: 			$moodle_category_response = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->get_moodle_course_categories();
43: 			if ( 1 === $moodle_category_response['success'] ) {
44: 				edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Creating course categories....' );
45: 				edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->create_course_categories_on_wordpress( $moodle_category_response['response_data'] );
46: 				edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Categories created....' );
47: 			}
48: 			$response_array['category_success']          = $moodle_category_response['success'];
49: 			$response_array['category_response_message'] = $moodle_category_response['response_message'];
50: 			$moodle_course_response = $this->get_selected_moodle_courses( $course_ids );
51: 			if ( 1 === $moodle_course_response['success'] ) {
52: 				foreach ( $moodle_course_response['response_data'] as $course_data ) {
53: 					if ( 1 === $course_data->id ) {
54: 						continue;
55: 					}
56: 					$existing_course_id = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->is_course_presynced( $course_data->id );
57: 					if ( ! is_numeric( $existing_course_id ) ) {
58: 						edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Creating a new course....' );
59: 						$course_id         = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->create_course_on_wordpress( $course_data, $sync_options );
60: 						$courses_created[] = $course_id;
61: 						edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Course created, ID is: ' . $course_id );
62: 					} elseif ( is_numeric( $existing_course_id ) && isset( $sync_options ) && 1 == $sync_options ) {
63: 						edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Updating existing course: ID is: ' . $existing_course_id );
64: 						$course_id = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->update_course_on_wordpress( $existing_course_id, $course_data, $sync_options );
65: 						edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Updated course....' );
66: 						$courses_updated[] = $course_id;
67: 					}
68: 				}
69: 			}
70: 			$response_array['course_success']          = $moodle_course_response['success'];
71: 			$response_array['course_response_message'] = $moodle_course_response['response_message'];
72: 		} else {
73: 			edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', 'Connection problem in synchronization, Response:' . $connected );
74: 		}
75: 		return $response_array;
76: 	}
77: 	public function get_selected_moodle_courses( $course_ids ) {
78: 		edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->logger()->add( 'course', "\n Fetching courses from moodle.... \n" );
79: 		$request_data = array( 'options' => array( 'ids' => $course_ids ) );
80: 		$webservice_function = 'core_course_get_courses';
81: 		$response            = edwiser\edwiser_bridge_instance()->connection_helper()->connect_moodle_with_args_helper( $webservice_function, $request_data );
82: 		return $response;
83: 	}
84: }

226: 			if ( ! empty( $user_creation_error ) ) {
227: 				$msg = __( 'Unable to create users with the following email ids.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
228: 				if ( 'create_and_link_user' === $bulk_action ) {
229: 					$msg = __( 'Error occred while creating or linking users with the following email ids.', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' );
230: 				}
231: 				$html .= '<div class="eb-ss-user-creation-error eb-ss-error-users-list" style="display: block;">
232: 							<i class="fa fa-times-circle eb-ss-msg-dismiss"></i>
233: 							<span class="eb-ss-error-message-lable">' . $msg . '
234: 							</span>
235: 							<ol>';
236: 				foreach ( $user_creation_error as $user_email ) {
237: 					$html .= '<li>' . $user_email . '</li>';
238: 				}
239: 				$html .= '</ol>';
240: 				$html .= '</div>';
241: 			}
242: 			$html .= '</div>';
243: 			return $html;
244: 		}
245: 		public function create_and_link_user( $first_name, $last_name, $user_name, $email, $moodle_user_id, $link_user ) {
246: 			$email_exists = email_exists( $email );
247: 			$linked       = '';
248: 			// Check if email is already present.
249: 			if ( $email_exists ) {
250: 				$old_moodle_user_id = get_user_meta( $email_exists, 'moodle_user_id', 1 );
251: 				if ( ! $old_moodle_user_id ) {
252: 					update_user_meta( $email_exists, 'moodle_user_id', $moodle_user_id );
253: 				}
254: 				if ( $link_user ) {
255: 					$linked = $this->link_user( $email_exists );
256: 				}
257: 				if ( 'error' === $linked ) {
258: 					return 'error';
259: 				}
260: 				return 'already-exist';
261: 			}
262: 			if ( username_exists( $user_name ) ) {
263: 				$user_name = sanitize_user( current( explode( '@', $email ) ), true );
264: 				$append            = 1;
265: 				$initial_user_name = $user_name;
266: 				while ( username_exists( $user_name ) ) {
267: 					$user_name = $initial_user_name . $append;
268: 					++$append;
269: 				}
270: 			}
271: 			$password = wp_generate_password();
272: 			$role = get_option( 'default_role' );
273: 			$wp_user_data = apply_filters(
274: 				'eb_ss_new_user_data',
275: 				array(
276: 					'first_name' => $first_name,
277: 					'last_name'  => $last_name,
278: 					'user_login' => $user_name,
279: 					'user_pass'  => $password,
280: 					'user_email' => $email,
281: 					'role'       => $role,
282: 				)
283: 			);
284: 			$wp_user_id = wp_insert_user( $wp_user_data );
285: 			if ( is_wp_error( $wp_user_id ) ) {
286: 				return 'error';
287: 			}
288: 			$args = array(
289: 				'user_email' => $email,
290: 				'username'   => $user_name,
291: 				'first_name' => $first_name,
292: 				'last_name'  => $last_name,
293: 				'password'   => $password,
294: 			);
295: 			do_action( 'eb_created_user_selective_sync', $args );
296: 			do_action( 'eb_ss_after_user_creation', $wp_user_id );
297: 			if ( $link_user ) {
298: 				update_user_meta( $wp_user_id, 'moodle_user_id', $moodle_user_id );
299: 				return $this->link_user( $wp_user_id );
300: 			}
301: 			return 'success';
302: 		}
303: 		public function link_user( $user_id ) {
304: 			global $wpdb;
305: 			$mdl_user_id = get_user_meta( $user_id, 'moodle_user_id', 1 );
306: 			$moodle_user_courses = \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->getMoodleCourses( $mdl_user_id );
307: 			$enrolled_courses = array();
308: 			if ( 1 === $moodle_user_courses['success'] ) {
309: 				foreach ( $moodle_user_courses['response_data'] as $course_data ) {
310: 					$existing_course_id = \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->is_course_presynced( $course_data->id );
311: 					if ( is_numeric( $existing_course_id ) ) {
312: 						$enrolled_courses[] = $existing_course_id;
313: 						$this->update_record_on_wordpress( $user_id, $existing_course_id );
314: 					}
315: 				}
316: 			} else {
317: 				return 'error';
318: 			}
319: 			$old_enrolled_courses = $wpdb->get_results(
320: 				"SELECT course_id
321:                 FROM {$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment
322:                 WHERE user_id = " . $user_id,
323: 				ARRAY_A
324: 			);
325: 			foreach ( $old_enrolled_courses as $existing_course ) {
326: 				if ( ! in_array( $existing_course['course_id'], $enrolled_courses, true ) ) {
327: 					$this->update_record_on_wordpress( $user_id, $existing_course['course_id'], 5, 1 );
328: 				}
329: 			}
330: 			return 'success';
331: 		}
332: 		public function update_record_on_wordpress( $user_id, $course_id, $role_id = '5', $unenrol = 0 ) {
333: 			global $wpdb;
334: 			if ( ! $unenrol ) {
335: 				if ( \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\edwiser_bridge_instance()->course_manager()->getMoodleCourseId( $course_id ) !== '' &&
336: 						! $this->user_has_course_access( $user_id, $course_id ) ) {
337: 					$wpdb->insert( // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
338: 						$wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment',
339: 						array(
340: 							'user_id'     => $user_id,
341: 							'course_id'   => $course_id,
342: 							'role_id'     => $role_id,
343: 							'time'        => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s' ),
344: 							'expire_time' => '0000-00-00 00:00:00',
345: 							'act_cnt'     => 1,
346: 						),
347: 						array(
348: 							'%d',
349: 							'%d',
350: 							'%d',
351: 							'%s',
352: 							'%s',
353: 							'%d',
354: 						)
355: 					);
356: 				}
357: 			} else {
358: 				$wpdb->delete(
359: 					$wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment',
360: 					array(
361: 						'user_id'   => $user_id,
362: 						'course_id' => $course_id,
363: 					),
364: 					array(
365: 						'%d',
366: 						'%d',
367: 					)
368: 				);
369: 			}
370: 		}
371: 		public function user_has_course_access( $user_id, $course_id ) {
372: 			global $wpdb;
373: 			$has_access = false;
374: 			if ( '' === $user_id || '' === $course_id ) {
375: 				return $has_access;
376: 			}
377: 			$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
378: 			$result = $wpdb->get_var("SELECT user_id FROM {$wpdb->prefix}moodle_enrollment WHERE course_id={$course_id} AND user_id={$user_id};" );
379: 			if ( (int) $result === $user_id ) {
380: 				$has_access = true;
381: 			}
382: 			return $has_access;
383: 		}
384: 	}
385: }

 3: class AccessToken

 7:      * Date when token expires.
 8:      *
 9:      * @var \DateTime|null
10:      */
11:     protected $expiresAt;

13:      * Create a new access token entity.
14:      *
15:      * @param string $accessToken
16:      * @param int    $expiresAt
17:      */
18:     public function __construct($accessToken, $expiresAt = 0)
19:     {
20:         $this->value = $accessToken;

22:             $this->setExpiresAtFromTimeStamp($expiresAt);
23:         }
24:     }

27:      *
28:      * @param string $appSecret The app secret.
29:      *
30:      * @return string
31:      */
32:     public function getAppSecretProof($appSecret)
33:     {
34:         return hash_hmac('sha256', $this->value, $appSecret);
35:     }
36:     public function getExpiresAt()
37:     {
38:         return $this->expiresAt;
39:     }
40:     public function isAppAccessToken()
41:     {
42:         return strpos($this->value, '|') !== false;
43:     }
44:     public function isLongLived()
45:     {
46:         if ($this->expiresAt) {
47:             return $this->expiresAt->getTimestamp() > time() + (60 * 60 * 2);
48:         }
49:         if ($this->isAppAccessToken()) {
50:             return true;
51:         }
52:         return false;
53:     }
54:     public function isExpired()
55:     {
56:         if ($this->getExpiresAt() instanceof \DateTime) {
57:             return $this->getExpiresAt()->getTimestamp() < time();
58:         }
59:         if ($this->isAppAccessToken()) {
60:             return false;
61:         }
62:         return null;
63:     }

65:     {
66:         return $this->value;
67:     }
68:     public function __toString()
69:     {
70:         return $this->getValue();
71:     }

73:     {
74:         $dt = new \DateTime();
75:         $dt->setTimestamp($timeStamp);
76:         $this->expiresAt = $dt;
77:     }

 41:         $metadata = $response->getDecodedBody();
 42:         return new AccessTokenMetadata($metadata);

 45:     {

 48:             'state' => $state,
 49:             'response_type' => 'code',
 50:             'sdk' => 'php-sdk-' . Facebook::VERSION,
 51:             'redirect_uri' => $redirectUrl,
 52:             'scope' => implode(',', $scope)
 53:         ];

 55:     }

 82:         }

  1: <?php
  2: namespace Facebook\Exceptions;
  3: use Facebook\FacebookResponse;
  4: class FacebookResponseException extends FacebookSDKException
  5: {
  6:     protected $response;
  7:     protected $responseData;
  8:     public function __construct(FacebookResponse $response, FacebookSDKException $previousException = null)
  9:     {
 10:         $this->response = $response;
 11:         $this->responseData = $response->getDecodedBody();
 12:         $errorMessage = $this->get('message', 'Unknown error from Graph.');
 13:         $errorCode = $this->get('code', -1);
 14:         parent::__construct($errorMessage, $errorCode, $previousException);
 15:     }
 16:     public static function create(FacebookResponse $response)
 17:     {
 18:         $data = $response->getDecodedBody();
 19:         if (!isset($data['error']['code']) && isset($data['code'])) {
 20:             $data = ['error' => $data];
 21:         }
 22:         $code = isset($data['error']['code']) ? $data['error']['code'] : null;
 23:         $message = isset($data['error']['message']) ? $data['error']['message'] : 'Unknown error from Graph.';
 24:         if (isset($data['error']['error_subcode'])) {
 25:             switch ($data['error']['error_subcode']) {
 26:                 case 458:
 27:                 case 459:
 28:                 case 460:
 29:                 case 463:
 30:                 case 464:
 31:                 case 467:
 32:                     return new static($response, new FacebookAuthenticationException($message, $code));
 33:                 case 1363030:
 34:                 case 1363019:
 35:                 case 1363033:
 36:                 case 1363021:
 37:                 case 1363041:
 38:                     return new static($response, new FacebookResumableUploadException($message, $code));
 39:                 case 1363037:
 40:                     $previousException = new FacebookResumableUploadException($message, $code);
 41:                     $startOffset = isset($data['error']['error_data']['start_offset']) ? (int) $data['error']['error_data']['start_offset'] : null;
 42:                     $previousException->setStartOffset($startOffset);
 43:                     $endOffset = isset($data['error']['error_data']['end_offset']) ? (int) $data['error']['error_data']['end_offset'] : null;
 44:                     $previousException->setEndOffset($endOffset);
 45:                     return new static($response, $previousException);
 46:             }
 47:         }
 48:         switch ($code) {
 49:             case 100:
 50:             case 102:
 51:             case 190:
 52:                 return new static($response, new FacebookAuthenticationException($message, $code));
 53:             case 1:
 54:             case 2:
 55:                 return new static($response, new FacebookServerException($message, $code));
 56:             case 4:
 57:             case 17:
 58:             case 32:
 59:             case 341:
 60:             case 613:
 61:                 return new static($response, new FacebookThrottleException($message, $code));
 62:             case 506:
 63:                 return new static($response, new FacebookClientException($message, $code));
 64:         }
 65:         if ($code == 10 || ($code >= 200 && $code <= 299)) {
 66:             return new static($response, new FacebookAuthorizationException($message, $code));
 67:         }
 68:         if (isset($data['error']['type']) && $data['error']['type'] === 'OAuthException') {
 69:             return new static($response, new FacebookAuthenticationException($message, $code));
 70:         }
 71:         return new static($response, new FacebookOtherException($message, $code));
 72:     }

 2: namespace Facebook\FileUpload;

 4: class FacebookFile
 5: {
 6:     protected $path;

 8:     private $offset;

11:     {
12:         $this->path = $filePath;
13:         $this->maxLength = $maxLength;
14:         $this->offset = $offset;
15:         $this->open();
16:     }
17:     public function __destruct()
18:     {
19:         $this->close();
20:     }
21:     public function open()
22:     {
23:         if (!$this->isRemoteFile($this->path) && !is_readable($this->path)) {
24:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Failed to create FacebookFile entity. Unable to read resource: ' . $this->path . '.');
25:         }
26:         $this->stream = fopen($this->path, 'r');
27:         if (!$this->stream) {
28:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Failed to create FacebookFile entity. Unable to open resource: ' . $this->path . '.');
29:         }
30:     }
31:     public function close()
32:     {
33:         if (is_resource($this->stream)) {
34:             fclose($this->stream);
35:         }
36:     }
37:     public function getContents()
38:     {
39:         return stream_get_contents($this->stream, $this->maxLength, $this->offset);
40:     }
41:     public function getFileName()
42:     {
43:         return basename($this->path);
44:     }
45:     public function getFilePath()
46:     {
47:         return $this->path;
48:     }
49:     public function getSize()
50:     {
51:         return filesize($this->path);
52:     }
53:     public function getMimetype()
54:     {
55:         return Mimetypes::getInstance()->fromFilename($this->path) ?: 'text/plain';
56:     }
57:     protected function isRemoteFile($pathToFile)
58:     {
59:         return preg_match('/^(https?|ftp):\/\/.*/', $pathToFile) === 1;
60:     }
61: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/src/FileUpload/FacebookResumableUploader.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\FileUpload;
 3: use Facebook\Authentication\AccessToken;
 4: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookResponseException;
 5: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookResumableUploadException;
 6: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookSDKException;
 7: use Facebook\FacebookApp;
 8: use Facebook\FacebookClient;
 9: use Facebook\FacebookRequest;
10: class FacebookResumableUploader
11: {
12:     protected $app;
13:     protected $accessToken;
14:     protected $client;
15:     protected $graphVersion;
16:     public function __construct(FacebookApp $app, FacebookClient $client, $accessToken, $graphVersion)
17:     {
18:         $this->app = $app;
19:         $this->client = $client;
20:         $this->accessToken = $accessToken;
21:         $this->graphVersion = $graphVersion;
22:     }
23:     public function start($endpoint, FacebookFile $file)
24:     {
25:         $params = [
26:             'upload_phase' => 'start',
27:             'file_size' => $file->getSize(),
28:         ];
29:         $response = $this->sendUploadRequest($endpoint, $params);
30:         return new FacebookTransferChunk($file, $response['upload_session_id'], $response['video_id'], $response['start_offset'], $response['end_offset']);
31:     }
32:     public function transfer($endpoint, FacebookTransferChunk $chunk, $allowToThrow = false)
33:     {
34:         $params = [
35:             'upload_phase' => 'transfer',
36:             'upload_session_id' => $chunk->getUploadSessionId(),
37:             'start_offset' => $chunk->getStartOffset(),
38:             'video_file_chunk' => $chunk->getPartialFile(),
39:         ];
40:         try {
41:             $response = $this->sendUploadRequest($endpoint, $params);
42:         } catch (FacebookResponseException $e) {
43:             $preException = $e->getPrevious();
44:             if ($allowToThrow || !$preException instanceof FacebookResumableUploadException) {
45:                 throw $e;
46:             }
47:             if (null !== $preException->getStartOffset() && null !== $preException->getEndOffset()) {
48:                 return new FacebookTransferChunk(
49:                     $chunk->getFile(),
50:                     $chunk->getUploadSessionId(),
51:                     $chunk->getVideoId(),
52:                     $preException->getStartOffset(),
53:                     $preException->getEndOffset()
54:                 );
55:             }
56:             return $chunk;
57:         }
58:         return new FacebookTransferChunk($chunk->getFile(), $chunk->getUploadSessionId(), $chunk->getVideoId(), $response['start_offset'], $response['end_offset']);
59:     }
60:     public function finish($endpoint, $uploadSessionId, $metadata = [])
61:     {
62:         $params = array_merge($metadata, [
63:             'upload_phase' => 'finish',
64:             'upload_session_id' => $uploadSessionId,
65:         ]);
66:         $response = $this->sendUploadRequest($endpoint, $params);
67:         return $response['success'];
68:     }
69:     private function sendUploadRequest($endpoint, $params = [])
70:     {
71:         $request = new FacebookRequest($this->app, $this->accessToken, 'POST', $endpoint, $params, null, $this->graphVersion);
72:         return $this->client->sendRequest($request)->getDecodedBody();
73:     }
74: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/src/GraphNodes/GraphNode.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\GraphNodes;
 3: class GraphNode extends Collection
 4: {
 5:     protected static $graphObjectMap = [];
 6:     public function __construct(array $data = [])
 7:     {
 8:         parent::__construct($this->castItems($data));
 9:     }
10:     public function castItems(array $data)
11:     {
12:         $items = [];
13:         foreach ($data as $k => $v) {
14:             if ($this->shouldCastAsDateTime($k)
15:                 && (is_numeric($v)
16:                     || $this->isIso8601DateString($v))
17:             ) {
18:                 $items[$k] = $this->castToDateTime($v);
19:             } elseif ($k === 'birthday') {
20:                 $items[$k] = $this->castToBirthday($v);
21:             } else {
22:                 $items[$k] = $v;
23:             }
24:         }
25:         return $items;
26:     }
27:     public function uncastItems()
28:     {
29:         $items = $this->asArray();
30:         return array_map(function ($v) {
31:             if ($v instanceof \DateTime) {
32:                 return $v->format(\DateTime::ISO8601);
33:             }
34:             return $v;
35:         }, $items);
36:     }
37:     public function asJson($options = 0)
38:     {
39:         return json_encode($this->uncastItems(), $options);
40:     }
41:     public function isIso8601DateString($string)
42:     {
43:         $crazyInsaneRegexThatSomehowDetectsIso8601 = '/^([\+-]?\d{4}(?!\d{2}\b))'
44:             . '((-?)((0[1-9]|1[0-2])(\3([12]\d|0[1-9]|3[01]))?'
45:             . '|W([0-4]\d|5[0-2])(-?[1-7])?|(00[1-9]|0[1-9]\d'
46:             . '|[12]\d{2}|3([0-5]\d|6[1-6])))([T\s]((([01]\d|2[0-3])'
47:             . '((:?)[0-5]\d)?|24\:?00)([\.,]\d+(?!:))?)?(\17[0-5]\d'
48:             . '([\.,]\d+)?)?([zZ]|([\+-])([01]\d|2[0-3]):?([0-5]\d)?)?)?)?$/';
49:         return preg_match($crazyInsaneRegexThatSomehowDetectsIso8601, $string) === 1;
50:     }
51:     public function shouldCastAsDateTime($key)
52:     {
53:         return in_array($key, [
54:             'created_time',
55:             'updated_time',
56:             'start_time',
57:             'end_time',
58:             'backdated_time',
59:             'issued_at',
60:             'expires_at',
61:             'publish_time',
62:             'joined'
63:         ], true);
64:     }
65:     public function castToDateTime($value)
66:     {
67:         if (is_int($value)) {
68:             $dt = new \DateTime();
69:             $dt->setTimestamp($value);
70:         } else {
71:             $dt = new \DateTime($value);
72:         }
73:         return $dt;
74:     }
75:     public function castToBirthday($value)
76:     {
77:         return new Birthday($value);
78:     }

80:     {
81:         return static::$graphObjectMap;
82:     }

103:     public function castAsGraphNodeOrGraphEdge(array $data, $subclassName = null, $parentKey = null, $parentNodeId = null)

114:     }
115:     public function safelyMakeGraphEdge(array $data, $subclassName = null, $parentKey = null, $parentNodeId = null)

121:         foreach ($data['data'] as $graphNode) {
122:             $dataList[] = $this->safelyMakeGraphNode($graphNode, $subclassName);
123:         }
124:         $metaData = $this->getMetaData($data);
125:         $parentGraphEdgeEndpoint = $parentNodeId && $parentKey ? '/' . $parentNodeId . '/' . $parentKey : null;
126:         $className = static::BASE_GRAPH_EDGE_CLASS;
127:         return new $className($this->response->getRequest(), $dataList, $metaData, $parentGraphEdgeEndpoint, $subclassName);
128:     }
129:     public function getMetaData(array $data)

134:     public static function isCastableAsGraphEdge(array $data)

140:     }
141:     public static function validateSubclass($subclassName)
142:     {

11:             $this->httpResponseCode = (int)$httpStatusCode;
12:         }
13:         if (is_array($headers)) {
14:             $this->headers = $headers;
15:         } else {
16:             $this->setHeadersFromString($headers);
17:         }
18:         $this->body = $body;

33:     {

35:         $this->httpResponseCode = (int) $status;
36:     }
37:     protected function setHeadersFromString($rawHeaders)
38:     {
39:         $rawHeaders = str_replace("\r\n", "\n", $rawHeaders);
40:         $headerCollection = explode("\n\n", trim($rawHeaders));
41:         $rawHeader = array_pop($headerCollection);
42:         $headerComponents = explode("\n", $rawHeader);
43:         foreach ($headerComponents as $line) {
44:             if (strpos($line, ': ') === false) {
45:                 $this->setHttpResponseCodeFromHeader($line);
46:             } else {
47:                 list($key, $value) = explode(': ', $line, 2);
48:                 $this->headers[$key] = $value;

50:         }
51:     }

25:             $body .= $this->getFileString($k, $v);

71:             $this->boundary,

73:             $value
74:         );
75:     }
76:     /**
77:      * Returns the params as an array of nested params.
78:      *
79:      * @param array $params
80:      *
81:      * @return array
82:      */
83:     private function getNestedParams(array $params)
84:     {
85:         $query = http_build_query($params, null, '&');
86:         $params = explode('&', $query);
87:         $result = [];
88:         foreach ($params as $param) {
89:             list($key, $value) = explode('=', $param, 2);
90:             $result[urldecode($key)] = urldecode($value);
91:         }
92:         return $result;
93:     }

95:     {
96:         return "\r\nContent-Type: {$file->getMimetype()}";

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/src/HttpClients/HttpClientsFactory.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\HttpClients;
 3: use GuzzleHttp\Client;
 4: use InvalidArgumentException;
 5: use Exception;
 6: class HttpClientsFactory
 7: {
 8:     private function __construct()
 9:     {
10:     }
11:     public static function createHttpClient($handler)
12:     {
13:         if (!$handler) {
14:             return self::detectDefaultClient();
15:         }
16:         if ($handler instanceof FacebookHttpClientInterface) {
17:             return $handler;
18:         }
19:         if ('stream' === $handler) {
20:             return new FacebookStreamHttpClient();
21:         }
22:         if ('curl' === $handler) {
23:             if (!extension_loaded('curl')) {
24:                 throw new Exception('The cURL extension must be loaded in order to use the "curl" handler.');
25:             }
26:             return new FacebookCurlHttpClient();
27:         }
28:         if ('guzzle' === $handler && !class_exists('GuzzleHttp\Client')) {
29:             throw new Exception('The Guzzle HTTP client must be included in order to use the "guzzle" handler.');
30:         }
31:         if ($handler instanceof Client) {
32:             return new FacebookGuzzleHttpClient($handler);
33:         }
34:         if ('guzzle' === $handler) {
35:             return new FacebookGuzzleHttpClient();
36:         }
37:         throw new InvalidArgumentException('The http client handler must be set to "curl", "stream", "guzzle", be an instance of GuzzleHttp\Client or an instance of Facebook\HttpClients\FacebookHttpClientInterface');
38:     }
39:     private static function detectDefaultClient()
40:     {
41:         if (extension_loaded('curl')) {
42:             return new FacebookCurlHttpClient();
43:         }
44:         if (class_exists('GuzzleHttp\Client')) {
45:             return new FacebookGuzzleHttpClient();
46:         }
47:         return new FacebookStreamHttpClient();
48:     }

 3: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookSDKException;
 4: use InvalidArgumentException;
 5: class PseudoRandomStringGeneratorFactory
 6: {
 7:     private function __construct()
 8:     {
 9:     }
10:     public static function createPseudoRandomStringGenerator($generator)
11:     {
12:         if (!$generator) {
13:             return self::detectDefaultPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
14:         }
15:         if ($generator instanceof PseudoRandomStringGeneratorInterface) {
16:             return $generator;
17:         }
18:         if ('random_bytes' === $generator) {
19:             return new RandomBytesPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
20:         }
21:         if ('mcrypt' === $generator) {
22:             return new McryptPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
23:         }
24:         if ('openssl' === $generator) {
25:             return new OpenSslPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
26:         }
27:         if ('urandom' === $generator) {
28:             return new UrandomPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
29:         }
30:         throw new InvalidArgumentException('The pseudo random string generator must be set to "random_bytes", "mcrypt", "openssl", or "urandom", or be an instance of Facebook\PseudoRandomString\PseudoRandomStringGeneratorInterface');
31:     }
32:     private static function detectDefaultPseudoRandomStringGenerator()
33:     {
34:         if (function_exists('random_bytes')) {
35:             return new RandomBytesPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
36:         }
37:         if (function_exists('mcrypt_create_iv')) {
38:             return new McryptPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
39:         }
40:         if (function_exists('openssl_random_pseudo_bytes')) {
41:             return new OpenSslPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
42:         }
43:         if (!ini_get('open_basedir') && is_readable('/dev/urandom')) {
44:             return new UrandomPseudoRandomStringGenerator();
45:         }
46:         throw new FacebookSDKException('Unable to detect a cryptographically secure pseudo-random string generator.');
47:     }
48: }

 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\PseudoRandomString;
 3: trait PseudoRandomStringGeneratorTrait
 4: {
 5:     public function validateLength($length)
 6:     {
 7:         if (!is_int($length)) {
 8:             throw new \InvalidArgumentException('getPseudoRandomString() expects an integer for the string length');
 9:         }
10:         if ($length < 1) {
11:             throw new \InvalidArgumentException('getPseudoRandomString() expects a length greater than 1');
12:         }
13:     }
14:     public function binToHex($binaryData, $length)
15:     {
16:         return \substr(\bin2hex($binaryData), 0, $length);
17:     }
18: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/src/PseudoRandomString/UrandomPseudoRandomStringGenerator.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\PseudoRandomString;
 3: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookSDKException;
 4: class UrandomPseudoRandomStringGenerator implements PseudoRandomStringGeneratorInterface
 5: {
 6:     use PseudoRandomStringGeneratorTrait;
 7:     const ERROR_MESSAGE = 'Unable to generate a cryptographically secure pseudo-random string from /dev/urandom. ';
 8:     public function __construct()
 9:     {
10:         if (ini_get('open_basedir')) {
11:             throw new FacebookSDKException(
12:                 static::ERROR_MESSAGE .
13:                 'There is an open_basedir constraint that prevents access to /dev/urandom.'
14:             );
15:         }
16:         if (!is_readable('/dev/urandom')) {
17:             throw new FacebookSDKException(
18:                 static::ERROR_MESSAGE .
19:                 'Unable to read from /dev/urandom.'
20:             );
21:         }
22:     }
23:     public function getPseudoRandomString($length)
24:     {
25:         $this->validateLength($length);
26:         $stream = fopen('/dev/urandom', 'rb');
27:         if (!is_resource($stream)) {
28:             throw new FacebookSDKException(
29:                 static::ERROR_MESSAGE .
30:                 'Unable to open stream to /dev/urandom.'
31:             );
32:         }
33:         if (!defined('HHVM_VERSION')) {
34:             stream_set_read_buffer($stream, 0);
35:         }
36:         $binaryString = fread($stream, $length);
37:         fclose($stream);
38:         if (!$binaryString) {
39:             throw new FacebookSDKException(
40:                 static::ERROR_MESSAGE .
41:                 'Stream to /dev/urandom returned no data.'
42:             );
43:         }
44:         return $this->binToHex($binaryString, $length);
45:     }
46: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/src/Url/FacebookUrlDetectionHandler.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace Facebook\Url;
 3: class FacebookUrlDetectionHandler implements UrlDetectionInterface
 4: {
 5:     public function getCurrentUrl()
 6:     {
 7:         return $this->getHttpScheme() . '://' . $this->getHostName() . $this->getServerVar('REQUEST_URI');
 8:     }
 9:     protected function getHttpScheme()
10:     {
11:         return $this->isBehindSsl() ? 'https' : 'http';
12:     }
13:     protected function isBehindSsl()
14:     {
15:         $protocol = $this->getHeader('X_FORWARDED_PROTO');
16:         if ($protocol) {
17:             return $this->protocolWithActiveSsl($protocol);
18:         }
19:         $protocol = $this->getServerVar('HTTPS');
20:         if ($protocol) {
21:             return $this->protocolWithActiveSsl($protocol);
22:         }
23:         return (string)$this->getServerVar('SERVER_PORT') === '443';
24:     }
25:     protected function protocolWithActiveSsl($protocol)
26:     {
27:         $protocol = strtolower((string)$protocol);
28:         return in_array($protocol, ['on', '1', 'https', 'ssl'], true);
29:     }
30:     protected function getHostName()
31:     {
32:         $header = $this->getHeader('X_FORWARDED_HOST');
33:         if ($header && $this->isValidForwardedHost($header)) {
34:             $elements = explode(',', $header);
35:             $host = $elements[count($elements) - 1];
36:         } elseif (!$host = $this->getHeader('HOST')) {
37:             if (!$host = $this->getServerVar('SERVER_NAME')) {
38:                 $host = $this->getServerVar('SERVER_ADDR');
39:             }
40:         }
41:         $host = strtolower(preg_replace('/:\d+$/', '', trim($host)));
42:         // Port number
43:         $scheme = $this->getHttpScheme();
44:         $port = $this->getCurrentPort();
45:         $appendPort = ':' . $port;
46:         // Don't append port number if a normal port.
47:         if (($scheme == 'http' && $port == '80') || ($scheme == 'https' && $port == '443')) {
48:             $appendPort = '';
49:         }
50:         return $host . $appendPort;
51:     }
52:     protected function getCurrentPort()
53:     {
54:         // Check for proxy first
55:         $port = $this->getHeader('X_FORWARDED_PORT');
56:         if ($port) {
57:             return (string)$port;
58:         }
59:         $protocol = (string)$this->getHeader('X_FORWARDED_PROTO');
60:         if ($protocol === 'https') {
61:             return '443';
62:         }
63:         return (string)$this->getServerVar('SERVER_PORT');
64:     }
65:     protected function getServerVar($key)
66:     {
67:         return isset($_SERVER[$key]) ? $_SERVER[$key] : '';
68:     }
69:     /**
70:      * Gets a value from the HTTP request headers.
71:      *
72:      * @param string $key
73:      *
74:      * @return string
75:      */
76:     protected function getHeader($key)
77:     {
78:         return $this->getServerVar('HTTP_' . $key);
79:     }
80:     protected function isValidForwardedHost($header)
81:     {
82:         $elements = explode(',', $header);
83:         $host = $elements[count($elements) - 1];
84:         return preg_match("/^([a-z\d](-*[a-z\d])*)(\.([a-z\d](-*[a-z\d])*))*$/i", $host)
85:             && 0 < strlen($host) && strlen($host) < 254
86:             && preg_match("/^[^\.]{1,63}(\.[^\.]{1,63})*$/", $host);
87:     }
88: }

  1: <?php
  2: namespace Facebook\Url;
  3: class FacebookUrlManipulator
  4: {
  5:     public static function removeParamsFromUrl($url, array $paramsToFilter)
  6:     {
  7:         $parts = parse_url($url);
  8:         $query = '';
  9:         if (isset($parts['query'])) {
 10:             $params = [];
 11:             parse_str($parts['query'], $params);
 12:             foreach ($paramsToFilter as $paramName) {
 13:                 unset($params[$paramName]);
 14:             }
 15:             if (count($params) > 0) {
 16:                 $query = '?' . http_build_query($params, null, '&');
 17:             }
 18:         }
 19:         $scheme = isset($parts['scheme']) ? $parts['scheme'] . '://' : '';
 20:         $host = isset($parts['host']) ? $parts['host'] : '';
 21:         $port = isset($parts['port']) ? ':' . $parts['port'] : '';
 22:         $path = isset($parts['path']) ? $parts['path'] : '';
 23:         $fragment = isset($parts['fragment']) ? '#' . $parts['fragment'] : '';
 24:         return $scheme . $host . $port . $path . $query . $fragment;
 25:     }
 26:     /**
 27:      * Gracefully appends params to the URL.
 28:      *
 29:      * @param string $url       The URL that will receive the params.
 30:      * @param array  $newParams The params to append to the URL.
 31:      *
 32:      * @return string
 33:      */
 34:     public static function appendParamsToUrl($url, array $newParams = [])
 35:     {
 36:         if (empty($newParams)) {
 37:             return $url;
 38:         }
 39:         if (strpos($url, '?') === false) {
 40:             return $url . '?' . http_build_query($newParams, null, '&');
 41:         }
 42:         list($path, $query) = explode('?', $url, 2);
 43:         $existingParams = [];
 44:         parse_str($query, $existingParams);
 45:         // Favor params from the original URL over $newParams
 46:         $newParams = array_merge($newParams, $existingParams);
 47:         // Sort for a predicable order
 48:         ksort($newParams);
 49:         return $path . '?' . http_build_query($newParams, null, '&');
 50:     }
 51:     /**
 52:      * Returns the params from a URL in the form of an array.
 53:      *
 54:      * @param string $url The URL to parse the params from.
 55:      *
 56:      * @return array
 57:      */
 58:     public static function getParamsAsArray($url)
 59:     {
 60:         $query = parse_url($url, PHP_URL_QUERY);
 61:         if (!$query) {
 62:             return [];
 63:         }
 64:         $params = [];
 65:         parse_str($query, $params);
 66:         return $params;
 67:     }
 68:     /**
 69:      * Adds the params of the first URL to the second URL.
 70:      *
 71:      * Any params that already exist in the second URL will go untouched.
 72:      *
 73:      * @param string $urlToStealFrom The URL harvest the params from.
 74:      * @param string $urlToAddTo     The URL that will receive the new params.
 75:      *
 76:      * @return string The $urlToAddTo with any new params from $urlToStealFrom.
 77:      */
 78:     public static function mergeUrlParams($urlToStealFrom, $urlToAddTo)
 79:     {
 80:         $newParams = static::getParamsAsArray($urlToStealFrom);
 81:         // Nothing new to add, return as-is
 82:         if (!$newParams) {
 83:             return $urlToAddTo;
 84:         }
 85:         return static::appendParamsToUrl($urlToAddTo, $newParams);
 86:     }
 87:     /**
 88:      * Check for a "/" prefix and prepend it if not exists.
 89:      *
 90:      * @param string|null $string
 91:      *
 92:      * @return string|null
 93:      */
 94:     public static function forceSlashPrefix($string)
 95:     {
 96:         if (!$string) {
 97:             return $string;
 98:         }
 99:         return strpos($string, '/') === 0 ? $string : '/' . $string;
100:     }
101:     /**
102:      * Trims off the hostname and Graph version from a URL.
103:      *
104:      * @param string $urlToTrim The URL the needs the surgery.
105:      *
106:      * @return string The $urlToTrim with the hostname and Graph version removed.
107:      */
108:     public static function baseGraphUrlEndpoint($urlToTrim)
109:     {
110:         return '/' . preg_replace('/^https:\/\/.+\.facebook\.com(\/v.+?)?\//', '', $urlToTrim);
111:     }
112: }

238:     public function fileToUpload($pathToFile)
239:     {
240:         return new FacebookFile($pathToFile);
241:     }

243:     {
244:         return new FacebookVideo($pathToFile);
245:     }
246:     public function uploadVideo($target, $pathToFile, $metadata = [], $accessToken = null, $maxTransferTries = 5, $graphVersion = null)
247:     {
248:         $accessToken = $accessToken ?: $this->defaultAccessToken;
249:         $graphVersion = $graphVersion ?: $this->defaultGraphVersion;
250:         $uploader = new FacebookResumableUploader($this->app, $this->client, $accessToken, $graphVersion);
251:         $endpoint = '/'.$target.'/videos';
252:         $file = $this->videoToUpload($pathToFile);
253:         $chunk = $uploader->start($endpoint, $file);
254:         do {
255:             $chunk = $this->maxTriesTransfer($uploader, $endpoint, $chunk, $maxTransferTries);
256:         } while (!$chunk->isLastChunk());
257:         return [
258:           'video_id' => $chunk->getVideoId(),
259:           'success' => $uploader->finish($endpoint, $chunk->getUploadSessionId(), $metadata),
260:         ];
261:     }
262:     private function maxTriesTransfer(FacebookResumableUploader $uploader, $endpoint, FacebookTransferChunk $chunk, $retryCountdown)
263:     {
264:         $newChunk = $uploader->transfer($endpoint, $chunk, $retryCountdown < 1);
265:         if ($newChunk !== $chunk) {
266:             return $newChunk;
267:         }
268:         $retryCountdown--;
269:         return $this->maxTriesTransfer($uploader, $endpoint, $chunk, $retryCountdown);
270:     }

 2: if (!function_exists('hash_equals')) {
 3:     function hash_equals($knownString, $userString)
 4:     {
 5:         if (function_exists('mb_strlen')) {
 6:             $kLen = mb_strlen($knownString, '8bit');
 7:             $uLen = mb_strlen($userString, '8bit');
 8:         } else {
 9:             $kLen = strlen($knownString);
10:             $uLen = strlen($userString);
11:         }
12:         if ($kLen !== $uLen) {
13:             return false;

19:         return 0 === $result;
20:     }

  1: <?php
  2: namespace Facebook;
  3: use Facebook\Exceptions\FacebookSDKException;
  4: class SignedRequest
  5: {
  6:     protected $app;
  7:     protected $rawSignedRequest;
  8:     protected $payload;
  9:     public function __construct(FacebookApp $facebookApp, $rawSignedRequest = null)
 10:     {
 11:         $this->app = $facebookApp;
 12:         if (!$rawSignedRequest) {
 13:             return;
 14:         }
 15:         $this->rawSignedRequest = $rawSignedRequest;
 16:         $this->parse();
 17:     }
 18:     public function getRawSignedRequest()
 19:     {
 20:         return $this->rawSignedRequest;
 21:     }
 22:     public function getPayload()
 23:     {
 24:         return $this->payload;
 25:     }
 26:     public function get($key, $default = null)
 27:     {
 28:         if (isset($this->payload[$key])) {
 29:             return $this->payload[$key];
 30:         }
 31:         return $default;
 32:     }
 33:     public function getUserId()
 34:     {
 35:         return $this->get('user_id');
 36:     }
 37:     public function hasOAuthData()
 38:     {
 39:         return $this->get('oauth_token') || $this->get('code');
 40:     }
 41:     public function make(array $payload)
 42:     {
 43:         $payload['algorithm'] = isset($payload['algorithm']) ? $payload['algorithm'] : 'HMAC-SHA256';
 44:         $payload['issued_at'] = isset($payload['issued_at']) ? $payload['issued_at'] : time();
 45:         $encodedPayload = $this->base64UrlEncode(json_encode($payload));
 46:         $hashedSig = $this->hashSignature($encodedPayload);
 47:         $encodedSig = $this->base64UrlEncode($hashedSig);
 48:         return $encodedSig . '.' . $encodedPayload;
 49:     }
 50:     protected function parse()
 51:     {
 52:         list($encodedSig, $encodedPayload) = $this->split();
 53:         $sig = $this->decodeSignature($encodedSig);
 54:         $hashedSig = $this->hashSignature($encodedPayload);
 55:         $this->validateSignature($hashedSig, $sig);
 56:         $this->payload = $this->decodePayload($encodedPayload);
 57:         $this->validateAlgorithm();
 58:     }
 59:     protected function split()
 60:     {
 61:         if (strpos($this->rawSignedRequest, '.') === false) {
 62:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Malformed signed request.', 606);
 63:         }
 64:         return explode('.', $this->rawSignedRequest, 2);
 65:     }
 66:     protected function decodeSignature($encodedSig)
 67:     {
 68:         $sig = $this->base64UrlDecode($encodedSig);
 69:         if (!$sig) {
 70:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Signed request has malformed encoded signature data.', 607);
 71:         }
 72:         return $sig;
 73:     }
 74:     protected function decodePayload($encodedPayload)
 75:     {
 76:         $payload = $this->base64UrlDecode($encodedPayload);
 77:         if ($payload) {
 78:             $payload = json_decode($payload, true);
 79:         }
 80:         if (!is_array($payload)) {
 81:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Signed request has malformed encoded payload data.', 607);
 82:         }
 83:         return $payload;
 84:     }
 85:     protected function validateAlgorithm()
 86:     {
 87:         if ($this->get('algorithm') !== 'HMAC-SHA256') {
 88:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Signed request is using the wrong algorithm.', 605);
 89:         }
 90:     }
 91:     protected function hashSignature($encodedData)
 92:     {
 93:         $hashedSig = hash_hmac(
 94:             'sha256',
 95:             $encodedData,
 96:             $this->app->getSecret(),
 97:             $raw_output = true
 98:         );
 99:         if (!$hashedSig) {
100:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Unable to hash signature from encoded payload data.', 602);
101:         }
102:         return $hashedSig;
103:     }
104:     protected function validateSignature($hashedSig, $sig)
105:     {
106:         if (\hash_equals($hashedSig, $sig)) {
107:             return;
108:         }
109:         throw new FacebookSDKException('Signed request has an invalid signature.', 602);
110:     }
111:     public function base64UrlDecode($input)
112:     {
113:         $urlDecodedBase64 = strtr($input, '-_', '+/');
114:         $this->validateBase64($urlDecodedBase64);
115:         return base64_decode($urlDecodedBase64);
116:     }
117:     public function base64UrlEncode($input)
118:     {
119:         return strtr(base64_encode($input), '+/', '-_');
120:     }
121:     protected function validateBase64($input)
122:     {
123:         if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9\/\r\n+]*={0,2}$/', $input)) {
124:             throw new FacebookSDKException('Signed request contains malformed base64 encoding.', 608);
125:         }
126:     }
127: }

 21: 		);

 32: 			$fb_user_mang = new Sso_Fb_User_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
 33: 			$fb_user_mang->facebook_login();
 34: 		}
 35: 		return true;
 36: 	}
 37: 	private function load_facebook_plus_config( $option ) {
 38: 		if ( false === $option ) {
 39: 			return;
 40: 		}
 41: 		$app_id     = $option['eb_sso_fb_app_id'];
 42: 		$app_secret = $option['eb_sso_fb_app_secret_key'];
 43: 		include_once 'src/autoload.php';
 44: 		self::$fb_client         = new \Facebook\Facebook(
 45: 			array(
 46: 				'app_id'                  => $app_id,
 47: 				'app_secret'              => $app_secret,
 48: 				'default_graph_version'   => 'v2.10',
 49: 				'persistent_data_handler' => 'memory',
 50: 			)
 51: 		);
 52: 		self::$fb_client_helper  = self::$fb_client->getRedirectLoginHelper();
 53: 		self::$fb_oauth2_service = self::$fb_client->getOAuth2Client();
 54: 	}
 55: 	private function get_setting_data( $keys = array() ) {
 56: 		$option = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 57: 		if ( false !== $option ) {
 58: 			foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
 59: 				if ( ! $this->check_is_set( $option, $key ) ) {
 60: 					$option = false;
 61: 				}
 62: 			}
 63: 		}
 64: 		return $option;
 65: 	}
 66: 	private function check_is_set( $data, $key ) {
 67: 		$value = false;
 68: 		if ( isset( $data[ $key ] ) ) {
 69: 			$value = trim( $data[ $key ] );
 70: 		}
 71: 		if ( empty( $value ) ) {
 72: 			$value = false;
 73: 		}
 74: 		return $value;
 75: 	}

 77: 		if ( isset( $data[ $key ] ) && 'no' === $data[ $key ] ) {

 79: 		}
 80: 		return true;
 81: 	}

100: 		$url = get_site_url() . '/?action=facebook_login';

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/facebook/class-sso-fb-logout-user.php

 1: <?php

 6: class Sso_Fb_Logout_User {

10: 		if ( \is_user_logged_in() ) {

17: 			if ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'] ) ) {
18: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
19: 			} elseif ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ) ) {
20: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'];
21: 			} else {
22: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
23: 			}

110: 			$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO Log: Facebook login Failed got facebook SDK exception.' . serialize( $e->getMessage() ) );
111: 			$this->reset_facebbok_session_data();
112: 			auth_redirect();
113: 			exit;
114: 		}
115: 	}
116: 	private function get_state() {
117: 		global $eb_user_id;
118: 		if ( empty( $eb_user_id ) ) {
119: 			if ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'] ) ) {
120: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
121: 			} elseif ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ) ) {
122: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'];
123: 			} else {
124: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
125: 			}
126: 			$eb_user_id = get_transient('eb_user_' . $ip_addr . '_eb_user_id');
127: 		}
128: 		$fb_session_data = maybe_unserialize( get_option( $eb_user_id ) );
129: 		if ( isset( $fb_session_data['state-data'] ) ) {
130: 			$state = base64_decode( $fb_session_data['state-data'] );
131: 			$state = json_decode( $state );
132: 			return $state;
133: 		}
134: 	}
135: 	public function reset_facebbok_session_data() {
136: 		global $eb_user_id;
137: 		if ( empty( $eb_user_id ) ) {
138: 			if ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'] ) ) {
139: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
140: 			} elseif ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ) ) {
141: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'];
142: 			} else {
143: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
144: 			}
145: 			$eb_user_id = get_transient('eb_user_' . $ip_addr . '_eb_user_id');
146: 		}
147: 		if ( ! empty( $eb_user_id ) ) {
148: 			delete_option( $eb_user_id );
149: 		}
150: 	}
151: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/google/Google/Auth/AssertionCredentials.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: require_once realpath(dirname(__FILE__) . '/../../../autoload.php');
 3: class Google_Auth_AssertionCredentials
 4: {
 5:   const MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECS = 3600;
 6:   public $serviceAccountName;
 7:   public $scopes;
 8:   public $privateKey;
 9:   public $privateKeyPassword;
10:   public $assertionType;
11:   public $sub;
12:   public $prn;
13:   private $useCache;
14:   public function __construct(
15:       $serviceAccountName,
16:       $scopes,
17:       $privateKey,
18:       $privateKeyPassword = 'notasecret',
19:       $assertionType = 'http://oauth.net/grant_type/jwt/1.0/bearer',
20:       $sub = false,
21:       $useCache = true
22:   ) {
23:     $this->serviceAccountName = $serviceAccountName;
24:     $this->scopes = is_string($scopes) ? $scopes : implode(' ', $scopes);
25:     $this->privateKey = $privateKey;
26:     $this->privateKeyPassword = $privateKeyPassword;
27:     $this->assertionType = $assertionType;
28:     $this->sub = $sub;
29:     $this->prn = $sub;
30:     $this->useCache = $useCache;
31:   }
32:   public function getCacheKey()
33:   {
34:     if (!$this->useCache) {
35:       return false;
36:     }
37:     $h = $this->sub;
38:     $h .= $this->assertionType;
39:     $h .= $this->privateKey;
40:     $h .= $this->scopes;
41:     $h .= $this->serviceAccountName;
42:     return md5($h);
43:   }
44:   public function generateAssertion()
45:   {
46:     $now = time();
47:     $jwtParams = array(
48:           'aud' => Google_Auth_OAuth2::OAUTH2_TOKEN_URI,
49:           'scope' => $this->scopes,
50:           'iat' => $now,
51:           'exp' => $now + self::MAX_TOKEN_LIFETIME_SECS,
52:           'iss' => $this->serviceAccountName,
53:     );
54:     if ($this->sub !== false) {
55:       $jwtParams['sub'] = $this->sub;
56:     } else if ($this->prn !== false) {
57:       $jwtParams['prn'] = $this->prn;
58:     }
59:     return $this->makeSignedJwt($jwtParams);
60:   }
61:   private function makeSignedJwt($payload)
62:   {
63:     $header = array('typ' => 'JWT', 'alg' => 'RS256');
64:     $payload = json_encode($payload);
65:     $payload = str_replace('\/', '/', $payload);
66:     $segments = array(
67:       Google_Utils::urlSafeB64Encode(json_encode($header)),
68:       Google_Utils::urlSafeB64Encode($payload)
69:     );
70:     $signingInput = implode('.', $segments);
71:     $signer = new Google_Signer_P12($this->privateKey, $this->privateKeyPassword);
72:     $signature = $signer->sign($signingInput);
73:     $segments[] = Google_Utils::urlSafeB64Encode($signature);
74:     return implode(".", $segments);
75:   }
76: }

23:     if (! in_array($code, self::$CACHEABLE_STATUS_CODES)) {
24:       return false;
25:     }
26:     $etag = $resp->getResponseHeader("etag");
27:     if (self::isExpired($resp) && $etag == false) {
28:       return false;
29:     }

31:     if (isset($cacheControl['no-store'])) {

36:       return false;

39:     if ($vary) {
40:       return false;

45:   {

48:     if (isset($responseHeaders['expires'])) {
49:       $rawExpires = $responseHeaders['expires'];
50:       if (empty($rawExpires) || (is_numeric($rawExpires) && $rawExpires <= 0)) {
51:         return true;
52:       }
53:       $parsedExpires = strtotime($rawExpires);
54:       if (false == $parsedExpires || $parsedExpires <= 0) {
55:         return true;
56:       }
57:     }
58:     $freshnessLifetime = false;
59:     $cacheControl = $resp->getParsedCacheControl();
60:     if (isset($cacheControl['max-age'])) {
61:       $freshnessLifetime = $cacheControl['max-age'];
62:     }
63:     $rawDate = $resp->getResponseHeader('date');
64:     $parsedDate = strtotime($rawDate);
65:     if (empty($rawDate) || false == $parsedDate) {
66:       throw new Google_Exception("All cacheable requests must have creation dates.");
67:     }
68:     if (false == $freshnessLifetime && isset($responseHeaders['expires'])) {
69:       $freshnessLifetime = $parsedExpires - $parsedDate;
70:     }
71:     if (false == $freshnessLifetime) {

75:     if (isset($responseHeaders['age'])) {

 59:     if (!isset($responseHeaders['Date']) && !isset($responseHeaders['date'])) {
 60:       $responseHeaders['date'] = date("r");
 61:     }
 62:     $request->setResponseHttpCode($respHttpCode);
 63:     $request->setResponseHeaders($responseHeaders);
 64:     $request->setResponseBody($responseData);
 65:     $this->setCachedRequest($request);
 66:     return $request;

 68:   public function getCachedRequest(Google_Http_Request $request)
 69:   {
 70:     if (false === Google_Http_CacheParser::isRequestCacheable($request)) {
 71:       return false;
 72:     }
 73:     return $this->client->getCache()->get($request->getCacheKey());
 74:   }
 75:   public function processEntityRequest(Google_Http_Request $request)
 76:   {
 77:     $postBody = $request->getPostBody();
 78:     $contentType = $request->getRequestHeader("content-type");
 79:     if (false == $contentType) {
 80:       $contentType = self::FORM_URLENCODED;
 81:       $request->setRequestHeaders(array('content-type' => $contentType));
 82:     }
 83:     if ($contentType == self::FORM_URLENCODED && is_array($postBody)) {
 84:       $postBody = http_build_query($postBody, '', '&');
 85:       $request->setPostBody($postBody);
 86:     }
 87:     // Make sure the content-length header is set.
 88:     if (!$postBody || is_string($postBody)) {
 89:       $postsLength = strlen($postBody);
 90:       $request->setRequestHeaders(array('content-length' => $postsLength));
 91:     }
 92:     return $request;
 93:   }
 94:   protected function checkMustRevalidateCachedRequest($cached, $request)
 95:   {
 96:     if (Google_Http_CacheParser::mustRevalidate($cached)) {
 97:       $addHeaders = array();
 98:       if ($cached->getResponseHeader('etag')) {
 99:         $addHeaders['If-None-Match'] = $cached->getResponseHeader('etag');
100:       } elseif ($cached->getResponseHeader('date')) {
101:         $addHeaders['If-Modified-Since'] = $cached->getResponseHeader('date');
102:       }
103:       $request->setRequestHeaders($addHeaders);
104:       return true;
105:     } else {
106:       return false;
107:     }
108:   }
109:   protected function updateCachedRequest($cached, $responseHeaders)
110:   {
111:     $hopByHop = self::$HOP_BY_HOP;
112:     if (!empty($responseHeaders['connection'])) {
113:       $connectionHeaders = array_map(
114:           'strtolower',
115:           array_filter(
116:               array_map('trim', explode(',', $responseHeaders['connection']))
117:           )
118:       );
119:       $hopByHop += array_fill_keys($connectionHeaders, true);
120:     }
121:     $endToEnd = array_diff_key($responseHeaders, $hopByHop);
122:     $cached->setResponseHeaders($endToEnd);
123:   }
124:   public function parseHttpResponse($respData, $headerSize)
125:   {
126:     foreach (self::$CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED_HEADERS as $established_header) {
127:       if (stripos($respData, $established_header) !== false) {
128:         $respData = str_ireplace($established_header, '', $respData);
129:         // Subtract the proxy header size unless the cURL bug prior to 7.30.0
130:         // is present which prevented the proxy header size from being taken into
131:         // account.
132:         if (!$this->needsQuirk()) {
133:           $headerSize -= strlen($established_header);
134:         }
135:         break;
136:       }
137:     }
138:     if ($headerSize) {
139:       $responseBody = substr($respData, $headerSize);
140:       $responseHeaders = substr($respData, 0, $headerSize);
141:     } else {
142:       $responseSegments = explode("\r\n\r\n", $respData, 2);
143:       $responseHeaders = $responseSegments[0];
144:       $responseBody = isset($responseSegments[1]) ? $responseSegments[1] :
145:                                                     null;
146:     }
147:     $responseHeaders = $this->getHttpResponseHeaders($responseHeaders);
148:     return array($responseHeaders, $responseBody);
149:   }
150:   /**
151:    * Parse out headers from raw headers
152:    * @param rawHeaders array or string
153:    * @return array
154:    */
155:   public function getHttpResponseHeaders($rawHeaders)
156:   {
157:     if (is_array($rawHeaders)) {
158:       return $this->parseArrayHeaders($rawHeaders);
159:     } else {
160:       return $this->parseStringHeaders($rawHeaders);
161:     }
162:   }
163:   private function parseStringHeaders($rawHeaders)
164:   {
165:     $headers = array();
166:     $responseHeaderLines = explode("\r\n", $rawHeaders);
167:     foreach ($responseHeaderLines as $headerLine) {
168:       if ($headerLine && strpos($headerLine, ':') !== false) {
169:         list($header, $value) = explode(': ', $headerLine, 2);
170:         $header = strtolower($header);
171:         if (isset($headers[$header])) {
172:           $headers[$header] .= "\n" . $value;
173:         } else {
174:           $headers[$header] = $value;
175:         }
176:       }
177:     }
178:     return $headers;
179:   }
180:   private function parseArrayHeaders($rawHeaders)
181:   {
182:     $header_count = count($rawHeaders);
183:     $headers = array();
184:     for ($i = 0; $i < $header_count; $i++) {
185:       $header = $rawHeaders[$i];
186:       // Times will have colons in - so we just want the first match.
187:       $header_parts = explode(': ', $header, 2);
188:       if (count($header_parts) == 2) {
189:         $headers[strtolower($header_parts[0])] = $header_parts[1];
190:       }
191:     }
192:     return $headers;
193:   }
194: }

26:       }
27:       curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_HTTPHEADER, $curlHeaders);

30:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_CUSTOMREQUEST, $request->getRequestMethod());
31:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_USERAGENT, $request->getUserAgent());
32:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_FOLLOWLOCATION, false);
33:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_SSL_VERIFYPEER, true);
34:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_SSLVERSION, 1);
35:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_RETURNTRANSFER, true);
36:     curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_HEADER, true);
37:     if ($request->canGzip()) {
38:       curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_ENCODING, 'gzip,deflate');
39:     }
40:     foreach ($this->options as $key => $var) {
41:       curl_setopt($curl, $key, $var);
42:     }
43:     if (!isset($this->options[CURLOPT_CAINFO])) {
44:       curl_setopt($curl, CURLOPT_CAINFO, dirname(__FILE__) . '/cacerts.pem');
45:     }

53:         )

57:       $error = curl_error($curl);
58:       $code = curl_errno($curl);
59:       $map = $this->client->getClassConfig('Google_IO_Exception', 'retry_map');
60:       $this->client->getLogger()->error('cURL ' . $error);
61:       throw new Google_IO_Exception($error, $code, null, $map);
62:     }
63:     $headerSize = curl_getinfo($curl, CURLINFO_HEADER_SIZE);
64:     list($responseHeaders, $responseBody) = $this->parseHttpResponse($response, $headerSize);
65:     $responseCode = curl_getinfo($curl, CURLINFO_HTTP_CODE);
66:     $this->client->getLogger()->debug(
67:         'cURL response',
68:         array(
69:             'code' => $responseCode,
70:             'headers' => $responseHeaders,
71:             'body' => $responseBody,

73:     );

 5:   public function __construct(
