10:   ) {
11:     if (version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '5.3.0') >= 0) {
12:       parent::__construct($message, $code, $previous);

14:       parent::__construct($message, $code);
15:     }

17:       $this->retryMap = $retryMap;
18:     }
19:   }

21:   {

26:   }

  1: <?php
  2: abstract class Google_Logger_Abstract
  3: {
  4:   const DEFAULT_LOG_FORMAT = "[%datetime%] %level%: %message% %context%\n";
  5:   const DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT = 'd/M/Y:H:i:s O';
  6:   const EMERGENCY = 'emergency';
  7:   const ALERT = 'alert';
  8:   const CRITICAL = 'critical';
  9:   const ERROR = 'error';
 10:   const WARNING = 'warning';
 11:   const NOTICE = 'notice';
 12:   const INFO = 'info';
 13:   const DEBUG = 'debug';
 14:   protected static $levels = array(
 15:       self::EMERGENCY  => 600,
 16:       self::ALERT => 550,
 17:       self::CRITICAL => 500,
 18:       self::ERROR => 400,
 19:       self::WARNING => 300,
 20:       self::NOTICE => 250,
 21:       self::INFO => 200,
 22:       self::DEBUG => 100,
 23:   );
 24:   protected $level = self::DEBUG;
 25:   protected $logFormat = self::DEFAULT_LOG_FORMAT;
 26:   protected $dateFormat = self::DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT;
 27:   protected $allowNewLines = false;
 28:   public function __construct(Google_Client $client)
 29:   {
 30:     $this->setLevel(
 31:         $client->getClassConfig('Google_Logger_Abstract', 'level')
 32:     );
 33:     $format = $client->getClassConfig('Google_Logger_Abstract', 'log_format');
 34:     $this->logFormat = $format ? $format : self::DEFAULT_LOG_FORMAT;
 35:     $format = $client->getClassConfig('Google_Logger_Abstract', 'date_format');
 36:     $this->dateFormat = $format ? $format : self::DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT;
 37:     $this->allowNewLines = (bool) $client->getClassConfig(
 38:         'Google_Logger_Abstract',
 39:         'allow_newlines'
 40:     );
 41:   }
 42:   public function setLevel($level)
 43:   {
 44:     $this->level = $this->normalizeLevel($level);
 45:   }
 46:   public function shouldHandle($level)
 47:   {
 48:     return $this->normalizeLevel($level) >= $this->level;
 49:   }
 50:   public function emergency($message, array $context = array())
 51:   {
 52:     $this->log(self::EMERGENCY, $message, $context);
 53:   }
 54:   public function alert($message, array $context = array())
 55:   {
 56:     $this->log(self::ALERT, $message, $context);
 57:   }
 58:   public function critical($message, array $context = array())
 59:   {
 60:     $this->log(self::CRITICAL, $message, $context);
 61:   }
 62:   public function error($message, array $context = array())
 63:   {
 64:     $this->log(self::ERROR, $message, $context);
 65:   }
 66:   public function warning($message, array $context = array())
 67:   {
 68:     $this->log(self::WARNING, $message, $context);
 69:   }
 70:   public function notice($message, array $context = array())
 71:   {
 72:     $this->log(self::NOTICE, $message, $context);
 73:   }
 74:   public function info($message, array $context = array())
 75:   {
 76:     $this->log(self::INFO, $message, $context);
 77:   }
 78:   public function debug($message, array $context = array())
 79:   {
 80:     $this->log(self::DEBUG, $message, $context);
 81:   }
 82:   public function log($level, $message, array $context = array())
 83:   {
 84:     if (!$this->shouldHandle($level)) {
 85:       return false;
 86:     }
 87:     $levelName = is_int($level) ? array_search($level, self::$levels) : $level;
 88:     $message = $this->interpolate(
 89:         array(
 90:             'message' => $message,
 91:             'context' => $context,
 92:             'level' => strtoupper($levelName),
 93:             'datetime' => new DateTime(),
 94:         )
 95:     );
 96:     $this->write($message);
 97:   }
 98:   protected function interpolate(array $variables = array())
 99:   {
100:     $template = $this->logFormat;
101:     if (!$variables['context']) {
102:       $template = str_replace('%context%', '', $template);
103:       unset($variables['context']);
104:     } else {
105:       $this->reverseJsonInContext($variables['context']);
106:     }
107:     foreach ($variables as $key => $value) {
108:       if (strpos($template, '%'. $key .'%') !== false) {
109:         $template = str_replace(
110:             '%' . $key . '%',
111:             $this->export($value),
112:             $template
113:         );
114:       }
115:     }
116:     return $template;
117:   }
118:   protected function reverseJsonInContext(array &$context)
119:   {
120:     if (!$context) {
121:       return;
122:     }
123:     foreach ($context as $key => $val) {
124:       if (!$val || !is_string($val) || !($val[0] == '{' || $val[0] == '[')) {
125:         continue;
126:       }
127:       $json = @json_decode($val);
128:       if (is_object($json) || is_array($json)) {
129:         $context[$key] = $json;
130:       }
131:     }
132:   }
133:   protected function export($value)
134:   {
135:     if (is_string($value)) {
136:       if ($this->allowNewLines) {
137:         return $value;
138:       }
139:       return preg_replace('/[\r\n]+/', ' ', $value);
140:     }
141:     if (is_resource($value)) {
142:       return sprintf(
143:           'resource(%d) of type (%s)',
144:           $value,
145:           get_resource_type($value)
146:       );
147:     }
148:     if ($value instanceof DateTime) {
149:       return $value->format($this->dateFormat);
150:     }
151:     if (version_compare(PHP_VERSION, '5.4.0', '>=')) {
152:       $options = JSON_UNESCAPED_SLASHES | JSON_UNESCAPED_UNICODE;
153:       if ($this->allowNewLines) {
154:         $options |= JSON_PRETTY_PRINT;
155:       }
156:       return @json_encode($value, $options);
157:     }
158:     return str_replace('\\/', '/', @json_encode($value));
159:   }
160:   protected function normalizeLevel($level)
161:   {
162:     if (is_int($level) && array_search($level, self::$levels) !== false) {
163:       return $level;
164:     }
165:     if (is_string($level) && isset(self::$levels[$level])) {
166:       return self::$levels[$level];
167:     }
168:     throw new Google_Logger_Exception(
169:         sprintf("Unknown LogLevel: '%s'", $level)
170:     );
171:   }
172:   abstract protected function write($message);
173: }

```php
  1: <?php
  2: class Google_Task_Runner
  3: {
  4:   private $maxDelay = 60;
  5:   private $delay = 1;
  6:   private $factor = 2;
  7:   private $jitter = 0.5;
  8:   private $attempts = 0;
  9:   private $maxAttempts = 1;
 10:   private $client;
 11:   private $name;
 12:   private $action;
 13:   private $arguments;
 14:   public function __construct(
 15:       Google_Client $client,
 16:       $name,
 17:       $action,
 18:       array $arguments = array()
 19:   ) {
 20:     $config = (array) $client->getClassConfig('Google_Task_Runner');
 21:     if (isset($config['initial_delay'])) {
 22:       if ($config['initial_delay'] < 0) {
 23:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 24:             'Task configuration `initial_delay` must not be negative.'
 25:         );
 26:       }
 27:       $this->delay = $config['initial_delay'];
 28:     }
 29:     if (isset($config['max_delay'])) {
 30:       if ($config['max_delay'] <= 0) {
 31:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 32:             'Task configuration `max_delay` must be greater than 0.'
 33:         );
 34:       }
 35:       $this->maxDelay = $config['max_delay'];
 36:     }
 37:     if (isset($config['factor'])) {
 38:       if ($config['factor'] <= 0) {
 39:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 40:             'Task configuration `factor` must be greater than 0.'
 41:         );
 42:       }
 43:       $this->factor = $config['factor'];
 44:     }
 45:     if (isset($config['jitter'])) {
 46:       if ($config['jitter'] <= 0) {
 47:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 48:             'Task configuration `jitter` must be greater than 0.'
 49:         );
 50:       }
 51:       $this->jitter = $config['jitter'];
 52:     }
 53:     if (isset($config['retries'])) {
 54:       if ($config['retries'] < 0) {
 55:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 56:             'Task configuration `retries` must not be negative.'
 57:         );
 58:       }
 59:       $this->maxAttempts += $config['retries'];
 60:     }
 61:     if (!is_callable($action)) {
 62:         throw new Google_Task_Exception(
 63:             'Task argument `$action` must be a valid callable.'
 64:         );
 65:     }
 66:     $this->name = $name;
 67:     $this->client = $client;
 68:     $this->action = $action;
 69:     $this->arguments = $arguments;
 70:   }
 71:   public function canAttmpt()
 72:   {
 73:     return $this->attempts < $this->maxAttempts;
 74:   }
 75:   public function run()
 76:   {
 77:     while ($this->attempt()) {
 78:       try {
 79:         return call_user_func_array($this->action, $this->arguments);
 80:       } catch (Google_Task_Retryable $exception) {
 81:         $allowedRetries = $exception->allowedRetries();
 82:         if (!$this->canAttmpt() || !$allowedRetries) {
 83:           throw $exception;
 84:         }
 85:         if ($allowedRetries > 0) {
 86:           $this->maxAttempts = min(
 87:               $this->maxAttempts,
 88:               $this->attempts + $allowedRetries
 89:           );
 90:         }
 91:       }
 92:     }
 93:   }
 94:   public function attempt()
 95:   {
 96:     if (!$this->canAttmpt()) {
 97:       return false;
 98:     }
 99:     if ($this->attempts > 0) {
100:       $this->backOff();
101:     }
102:     $this->attempts++;
103:     return true;
104:   }
105:   private function backOff()
106:   {
107:     $delay = $this->getDelay();
108:     $this->client->getLogger()->debug(
109:         'Retrying task with backoff',
110:         array(
111:             'request' => $this->name,
112:             'retry' => $this->attempts,
113:             'backoff_seconds' => $delay
114:         )
115:     );
116:     usleep($delay * 1000000);
117:   }
118:   private function getDelay()
119:   {
120:     $jitter = $this->getJitter();
121:     $factor = $this->attempts > 1 ? $this->factor + $jitter : 1 + abs($jitter);
122:     return $this->delay = min($this->maxDelay, $this->delay * $factor);
123:   }
124:   private function getJitter()
125:   {
126:     return $this->jitter * 2 * mt_rand() / mt_getrandmax() - $this->jitter;
127:   }
128: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/sso/social-login/google/class-sso-google-plus-init.php
```php
  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\sso;
  3: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
  4: 	exit( 'This is not the way to call me!' );
  5: }
  6: class Sso_Google_Plus_Init {
  7: 	private $plugin_name;
  8: 	private $version;
  9: 	protected static $g_client = null;
 10: 	protected static $g_oauth2_service = null;
 11: 	public function __construct( $plugin_name, $version ) {
 12: 		$this->plugin_name = $plugin_name;
 13: 		$this->version     = $version;
 14: 	}
 15: 	public function load_dependencies() {
 16: 		$keys   = array(
 17: 			'eb_sso_gp_client_id',
 18: 			'eb_sso_gp_secret_key',
 19: 			'eb_sso_gp_enable',
 20: 		);
 21: 		$option = $this->get_setting_data( $keys );
 22: 		if ( false === $option || ! $this->check_is_social_login_enabled( $option, 'eb_sso_gp_enable' ) ) {
 23: 			return;
 24: 		}
 25: 		$this->load_google_plus_config( $option );
 26: 		include_once 'class-sso-gp-logout-user.php';
 27: 		include_once 'class-sso-gp-user-manager.php';
 28: 		$gp_logout = new Sso_Gp_Logout_User();
 29: 		$gp_logout->init();
 30: 		if ( ! is_user_logged_in() && isset( $_GET['code'] ) ) {
 31: 			$user_manager = new Sso_Gp_User_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
 32: 			$user_manager->google_login();
 33: 		}
 34: 		return true;
 35: 	}
 36: 	private function get_setting_data( $keys = array() ) {
 37: 		$option = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
 38: 		if ( false !== $option ) {
 39: 			foreach ( $keys as $key ) {
 40: 				if ( ! $this->check_is_set( $option, $key ) ) {
 41: 					$option = false;
 42: 				}
 43: 			}
 44: 		}
 45: 		return $option;
 46: 	}
 47: 	private function check_is_social_login_enabled( $data, $key ) {
 48: 		if ( isset( $data[ $key ] ) && 'no' === $data[ $key ] ) {
 49: 			return false;
 50: 		}
 51: 		return true;
 52: 	}

 57: 		}

 61: 		return $value;

 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\sso;

13: 		$this->lugin_name       = $lugin_name;
14: 		$this->version          = $version;

16: 		$this->google_client    = Sso_Google_Plus_Init::get_google_client();

18: 	}
19: 	public function google_login() {
20: 		global $eb_user_id;
21: 		$user_data = null;
22: 		try {
23: 			if ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'] ) ) {
24: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_CLIENT_IP'];
25: 			} elseif ( ! empty( $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'] ) ) {
26: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['HTTP_X_FORWARDED_FOR'];
27: 			} else {
28: 				$ip_addr = $_SERVER['REMOTE_ADDR'];
29: 			}
30: 			if ( empty( $eb_user_id ) ) {
31: 				$eb_user_id = get_transient( 'eb_user_' . $ip_addr . '_eb_user_id' );
32: 			}
33: 			if ( empty( $eb_user_id ) ) {
34: 				$eb_user_id = bin2hex(openssl_random_pseudo_bytes(16));
35: 			}
36: 			set_transient(
37: 				'eb_user_' . $ip_addr . '_eb_user_id',
38: 				$eb_user_id,
39: 				HOUR_IN_SECONDS
40: 			);
41: 			if ( isset( $_GET['code'] ) ) {
42: 				$this->google_client->authenticate( $_GET['code'] );
43: 				$token = $this->google_client->getAccessToken();
44: 				set_transient(
45: 					'eb_user_' . $eb_user_id . '_token',
46: 					$token,
47: 					HOUR_IN_SECONDS
48: 				);
49: 			} else {
50: 				return;
51: 			}
52: 			if ( ! empty( $token ) ) {
53: 				try {
54: 					$this->google_client->setAccessToken( $token );
55: 				} catch ( Exception $e ) {
56: 					$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO Log: Google OAuth login access token exception' . serialize( $e->getMessage() ) );
57: 				}
58: 			}
59: 			if ( $this->google_client->getAccessToken() ) {
60: 				try {
61: 					$gp_user_profile = $this->g_oauth2_service->userinfo->get();
62: 					$gp_user_data    = array(
63: 						'oauth_provider' => 'google',
64: 						'oauth_uid'      => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'id' ),
65: 						'first_name'     => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'given_name' ),
66: 						'last_name'      => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'family_name' ),
67: 						'email'          => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'email' ),
68: 						'gender'         => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'gender' ),
69: 						'locale'         => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'locale' ),
70: 						'picture'        => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'picture' ),
71: 						'link'           => getArrayDataByIndex( $gp_user_profile, 'link' ),
72: 					);
73: 				} catch ( Exception $e ) {
74: 					$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO Log: Google OAuth login failed to fetch google OAuth profile data.' . serialize( $e->getMessage() ) );
75: 					auth_redirect();
76: 					exit();
77: 				}
78: 				$user_manager = new Sso_Social_Login_User_Manager( $this->lugin_name, $this->version );
79: 				$redirect     = $this->get_state();
80: 				$user_data    = $user_manager->check_user_details( $gp_user_data, $redirect );
81: 			}
82: 		} catch ( Exception $e ) {
83: 			$this->eb_logger->logger()->add( 'SSO Log: Google OAuth login failed with exception: ' . serialize( $e->getMessage() ) );
84: 		}
85: 	}
86: 	private function get_state() {
87: 		if ( isset( $_GET['state'] ) ) {
88: 			$state = base64_decode( $_GET['state'] );
89: 			$state = json_decode( $state );
90: 			return $state;
91: 		} else {
92: 			return get_site_url();
93: 		}
94: 	}
95: }

 14: 		}
 15: 		if ( ! defined( 'EB_MOODLE_LOGOUT_URL' ) ) {

 17: 		}

 25: 		add_shortcode( 'wdm_generate_link', array( $this, 'generate_link_message' ) );
 26: 		add_action( 'template_redirect', array( $this, 'generate_link' ) );
 27: 		add_filter( 'eb_course_access_button', array( $this, 'course_access_button' ), 10, 2 );
 28: 		add_action( 'wp_logout', array( $this, 'logged_out' ), 11 );
 29: 		add_action( 'wp_login', array( $this, 'logged_in' ), 10, 2 );
 30: 		add_action( 'template_redirect', array( $this, 'mdl_triggered_action' ) );
 31: 		add_action( 'template_redirect', array( $this, 'eb_login_from_course_link' ) );
 32: 	}
 33: 	public function eb_login_from_course_link() {
 34: 		if ( isset( $_GET['mdl_course_id'] ) ) {
 35: 			$user = wp_get_current_user();
 36: 			if ( $user->ID ) {
 37: 				$mdl_logout = new Sso_Manage_Moodle_Login( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
 38: 				$mdl_logout->mdl_logged_in( $user->user_login, $user );
 39: 			}
 40: 		}
 41: 	}
 42: 	private function get_mdl_connection_url( $conn_options ) {
 43: 		$mdl_url = false;
 44: 		if ( isset( $conn_options['eb_url'] ) ) {
 45: 			$mdl_url = $conn_options['eb_url'];
 46: 		}
 47: 		return $mdl_url;
 48: 	}
 49: 	private function get_mdl_access_token( $conn_options ) {
 50: 		$mdl_token = false;
 51: 		if ( isset( $conn_options['eb_access_token'] ) ) {
 52: 			$mdl_token = $conn_options['eb_access_token'];
 53: 		}
 54: 		return $mdl_token;
 55: 	}
 56: 	private function prepare_token_verify_request( $mdl_url, $mdl_token, $web_function, $token ) {
 57: 		$req_url      = $mdl_url . '/webservice/rest/server.php?wstoken=';
 58: 		$req_url     .= $mdl_token . '&wsfunction=' . $web_function . '&moodlewsrestformat=json';
 59: 		$request_args = array(
 60: 			'body'    => array( 'token' => $token ),
 61: 			'timeout' => 500,
 62: 		);
 63: 		return wp_remote_post( $req_url, $request_args );
 64: 	}
 65: 	public function enqueue_scripts() {
 66: 		if ( is_user_logged_in() && current_user_can( 'manage_options' ) ) {

 70: 					EB_PRO_PLUGIN_URL . 'admin/assets/jquery.blockUI.js',
 71: 					array( 'jquery' )
 72: 				);
 73: 				wp_enqueue_script( 'eb_sso_moodle_js', '', array( 'jquery', 'eb_sso_blockUI_js' ) );
 74: 				$data = array(
 75: 					'error_message' => __( 'Please set the same secret key on WordPress as well as on Moodle', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ),
 76: 				);
 77: 				wp_localize_script( 'eb_sso_moodle_js', 'eb_sso_data', $data );
 78: 			}
 79: 		}
 80: 	}
 81: 	public function admin_scripts() {
 82: 		wp_enqueue_style( 'ebsso_admin_setings_css', EBSSO_URL . '/assets/admin-settings.css' );
 83: 		wp_enqueue_script(
 84: 			'ebsso_admin_setings_js',
 85: 			EBSSO_URL . '/assets/admin-settings.js',
 86: 			array( 'jquery' )
 87: 		);
 88: 		$nonce = wp_create_nonce( 'ebsso-verify-key' );
 89: 		$data = array(
 90: 			'ajaxurl' => admin_url( 'admin-ajax.php' ),
 91: 			'nonce'   => $nonce,
 92: 		);
 93: 		wp_localize_script( 'ebsso_admin_setings_js', 'ebssoAdSet', $data );
 94: 	}
 95: 	public function verify_key() {
 96: 		$conn_options = get_option( 'eb_connection' );
 97: 		$mdl_url      = $this->get_mdl_connection_url( $conn_options );
 98: 		$mdl_token    = $this->get_mdl_access_token( $conn_options );
 99: 		if ( ! $mdl_url || ! $mdl_token ) {
100: 			wp_send_json_error( __( 'Please check your Edwiser Bridge Connection Settings first!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
101: 		}

103: 		$msg      = '';

106: 			if ( function_exists( '\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\wdm_log_json' ) ) {

108: 				wp_get_current_user();
109: 				$error_data = array(

113: 					'responsecode' => '',
114: 					'exception'    => '',
115: 					'errorcode'    => '',
116: 					'message'      => $msg,
117: 					'backtrace'    => wp_debug_backtrace_summary( null, 0, false ),
118: 				);
119: 				\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\wdm_log_json( $error_data );
120: 			}
121: 		} elseif ( 200 === wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response ) ) {
122: 			$body = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $response ) );
123: 			if ( isset( $body->exception ) && 'webservice_access_exception' === $body->exception ) {
124: 				wp_send_json_error( __( 'Web service function is not added into the external services. Please check your Edwiser Bridge Connection Settings first!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
125: 			} elseif ( isset( $body->exception ) && 'dml_missing_record_exception' === $body->exception ) {
126: 				wp_send_json_error( __( 'Please check your Edwiser Bridge Connection Settings first!', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
127: 			}
128: 			if ( isset( $body->exception ) && function_exists( '\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\wdm_log_json' ) ) {
129: 				global $current_user;
130: 				wp_get_current_user();
131: 				$error_data = array(

135: 					'responsecode' => wp_remote_retrieve_response_code( $response ),

140: 				);
141: 				\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\wdm_log_json( $error_data );
142: 			}
143: 			if ( true === $body->success ) {
144: 				wp_send_json_success( __( 'Token verified successfully !', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) );
145: 			} else {
146: 				$msg = $body->msg;
147: 				if ( function_exists( '\app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\wdm_log_json' ) ) {

168: 	public function generate_link_message() {

177: 	public function generate_link() {
178: 		global $post;
179: 		if ( isset( $post ) && has_shortcode( $post->post_content, 'wdm_generate_link' ) ) {
180: 			$pattern = get_shortcode_regex();
181: 			preg_match_all( '/' . $pattern . '/s', $post->post_content, $matches );
182: 			$atts = array();
183: 			if ( isset( $matches[2] ) && in_array( 'wdm_generate_link', $matches[2] ) ) {
184: 				$i = 0;
185: 				foreach ( $matches[2] as $key => $value ) {
186: 					if ( 'wdm_generate_link' === $value ) {
187: 						$i = $key;
188: 						break;
189: 					}
190: 				}
191: 				if ( isset( $matches[3][ $i ] ) ) {
192: 					$atts = shortcode_parse_atts( $matches[3][ $i ] );
193: 				}
194: 			}
195: 			if ( is_user_logged_in() ) {
196: 				$moodle_user_id = get_user_meta( get_current_user_id(), 'moodle_user_id', true );
197: 				if ( $moodle_user_id ) {
198: 					$redirect_url = eb_get_mdl_url();
199: 					if ( isset( $atts['course_id'] ) && '' !== $atts['course_id'] ) {
200: 						$redirect_url .= '/course/view.php?id=' . $atts['course_id'];
201: 					}
202: 					$user       = wp_get_current_user();
203: 					$mdl_logout = new Sso_Manage_Moodle_Login( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
204: 					$mdl_logout->mdl_logged_in( $user->user_login, $user, '', $redirect_url );
205: 				}
206: 			}
207: 		}
208: 	}
209: 	/**
210: 	 * Changed the url of course access button.

212: 	 * @param string $access_button access button html.

214: 	 * @since 1.0.0
215: 	 */
216: 	public function course_access_button( $access_button, $access_params ) {
217: 		if ( ! is_user_logged_in() ) {
218: 			return $access_button;

220: 		$post_id          = $access_params['post']->ID;
221: 		$moodle_course_id = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'moodle_course_id', true );
222: 		if ( '' == $moodle_course_id ) { // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
223: 			return $access_button;
224: 		}
225: 		$moodle_user_id = get_user_meta( get_current_user_id(), 'moodle_user_id', true );
226: 		if ( '' == $moodle_user_id ) { // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
227: 			return $access_button;
228: 		}

233: 		$final_url = get_site_url() . '?mdl_course_id=' . $moodle_course_id;

252: 	public function mdl_triggered_action() {
253: 		$setting = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
254: 		$wp_key  = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
255: 		if ( isset( $_GET['wdmaction'] ) && isset( $_GET['mdl_uid'] ) && isset( $_GET['verify_code'] ) ) {
256: 			$setting     = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
257: 			$redirect_to = eb_get_mdl_url();
258: 			$wp_user_id = eb_get_wp_user_id_from_moodle_id( $_GET['mdl_uid'] );
259: 			if ( $wp_user_id ) {
260: 				$eb_session_data = get_user_meta( $wp_user_id, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session', 1 );
261: 				delete_user_meta( $wp_user_id, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session' );
262: 				if ( $eb_session_data ) {
263: 					$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $eb_session_data, $wp_key );
264: 				}
265: 				if ( isset( $decrypted_args ) && getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_one_time_code' ) === $_GET['verify_code'] ) {
266: 					$mdl_key   = (string) getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' );
267: 					$mdl_uid   = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_uid' );
268: 					$mdl_email = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_email' );
269: 					$redirect_to = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'redirect_to' );
270: 					if ( ! filter_var( $redirect_to, FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
271: 						if ( filter_var( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
272: 							$redirect_to = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
273: 						} else {
274: 							$redirect_to = site_url();
275: 						}
276: 					}
277: 					if ( ! empty( $wp_key ) && $mdl_key === $wp_key ) {
278: 						if ( 'logout' === $_GET['wdmaction'] ) {
279: 							add_action(
280: 								'wp_logout',
281: 								function() use ( $redirect_to ) {
282: 									wp_redirect( $redirect_to );
283: 									exit();
284: 								}
285: 							);
286: 							triggerLogout( $mdl_uid );
287: 						} elseif ( 'login' === $_GET['wdmaction'] ) {
288: 							triggerLogin( $mdl_uid, $mdl_email );
289: 						}
290: 					}
291: 				}
292: 			}
293: 			wp_redirect( $redirect_to );
294: 			exit();
295: 		} elseif ( isset( $_GET['wdmaction'] ) && isset( $_GET['data'] ) ) {
296: 			$conn_options = get_option( 'eb_connection' );
297: 			$mdl_url      = $this->get_mdl_connection_url( $conn_options );
298: 			if ( is_user_logged_in() ) {
299: 				$wp_key = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
300: 				// Check if Moodle user is already logged in.
301: 				$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $_GET['data'], $wp_key );
302: 				if ( getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' ) === $wp_key ) {
303: 					$user = wp_get_current_user();
304: 					if ( $user->ID ) {
305: 						$mdl_logout = new Sso_Manage_Moodle_Login( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
306: 						$mdl_logout->mdl_logged_in( $user->user_login, $user, '', $mdl_url );
307: 					}
308: 				}
309: 			} else {
310: 				// If not logged in then redirect to the WordPress login page.
311: 				$settings   = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_redirection' );
312: 				$login_page = isset( $settings['ebsso_login_page'] ) ? $settings['ebsso_login_page'] : '';
313: 				if ( $login_page ) {
314: 					$login_page = get_permalink( $login_page );
315: 				} else {
316: 					// get user-account page.
317: 					$login_page = site_url( '/user-account' );
318: 				}
319: 				wp_redirect( add_query_arg( array( 'redirect_to' => $mdl_url, 'login_action' => 'moodle' ), $login_page ) );
320: 			}
321: 		}
322: 	}
323: 	public function eb_sso_login_api_registration() {
324: 		register_rest_route(
325: 			'edwiser-bridge',
326: 			'/sso/',
327: 			array(
328: 				'methods'             => 'POST, GET',
329: 				'callback'            => array( $this, 'external_api_endpoint_def' ),
330: 				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
331: 			)
332: 		);
333: 	}
334: 	public function external_api_endpoint_def( $request_data ) {
335: 		if ( isset( $_POST['wdmargs'] ) ) {
336: 			$setting = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_general' );
337: 			$wp_key  = isset( $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] ) ? (string) $setting['eb_sso_secret_key'] : '';
338: 			$decrypted_args = getDecryptedQueryArgs( $_POST['wdmargs'], $wp_key );
339: 			$mdl_key        = (string) getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_key' );
340: 			$mdl_uid        = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_uid' );
341: 			$mdl_email      = getKeyValue( $decrypted_args, 'mdl_email' );
342: 			if ( $mdl_key === $wp_key ) {
343: 				$user = get_user_by( 'email', $mdl_email );
344: 				if ( isset( $user->ID ) && ! empty( $user->ID ) ) {
345: 					update_user_meta( $user->ID, 'eb_sso_user_login_logout_session', $_POST['wdmargs'] );
346: 				}
347: 			}
348: 		}
349: 	}
350: }

13: 	public function get_login_redirect_url( $user, $default_redirect_url = '', $ignore_setting_redirect_url = 0 ) {
14: 		$post_content             = null;
15: 		$user_redirect_url_status = $this->get_user_redirect_url( $user );
16: 		$redirect_url             = $user_redirect_url_status;
17: 		$user_redirect_url_status = ( $user_redirect_url_status ) ? $user_redirect_url_status : $ignore_setting_redirect_url;
18: 		if ( $ignore_setting_redirect_url && ! empty( $default_redirect_url ) ) {
19: 			$redirect_url = $default_redirect_url;
20: 		} elseif ( empty( $redirect_url ) ) {
21: 			if ( ! empty( $default_redirect_url ) ) {
22: 				$redirect_url = $default_redirect_url;
23: 			} else {
24: 				$redirect_url = get_site_url();
25: 			}
26: 		}
27: 		$get = array();
28: 		if ( isset( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] ) && filter_var( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) ) {
29: 			$postid       = url_to_postid( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'] );
30: 			$post_content = $postid ? get_post( $postid )->post_content : null;
31: 			$parsed_url   = parse_url( $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'], PHP_URL_QUERY );
32: 			if ( ! empty( $parsed_url ) ) {
33: 				parse_str( $parsed_url, $get );
34: 			}
35: 		}
36: 		if ( ! $user_redirect_url_status ) {
37: 			$redirect_url = getRedirectUrl( $get, $post_content, $redirect_url );
38: 		} else {
39: 			$redirect_url = $redirect_url;
40: 		}
41: 		if ( isset( $post_content ) && has_shortcode( $post_content, 'bridge_woo_single_cart_checkout' ) && ! $ignore_setting_redirect_url ) {
42: 			$redirect_url = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
43: 		} elseif ( isset( $post_content ) && has_shortcode( $post_content, 'woocommerce_checkout' ) && ! $ignore_setting_redirect_url ) {
44: 			$redirect_url = $_SERVER['HTTP_REFERER'];
45: 		} elseif ( isset( $get['login_action'] ) && 'moodle' === $get['login_action'] ) {
46: 			$redirect_url = $get['redirect_to'];
47: 		}
48: 		if ( isset( $get['redirect_to'] ) && filter_var( $get['redirect_to'], FILTER_VALIDATE_URL ) && isset( $get['is_enroll'] ) ) {
49: 			$redirect_url = $get['redirect_to'];
50: 			$redirect_url = add_query_arg( 'auto_enroll', 'true', $redirect_url );
51: 		}
52: 		return apply_filters( 'eb_sso_login_url', $redirect_url );
53: 	}
54: 	private function get_user_redirect_url( $user ) {
55: 		$redirect_urls = get_option( 'eb_sso_settings_redirection' );
56: 		if ( isset( $redirect_urls['ebsso_role_base_redirect'] ) && 'no' === $redirect_urls['ebsso_role_base_redirect'] ) {
57: 			return $this->get_redirect_url( $redirect_urls, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url' );
58: 		} else {
59: 			return $this->get_redirect_url( $redirect_urls, 'ebsso_login_redirect_url_' . $user->roles[0] );
60: 		}
61: 	}
62: 	private function get_redirect_url( $data, $role ) {
63: 		$redirect = false;
64: 		if ( isset( $_GET['mdl_course_id'] ) && ! empty( $_GET['mdl_course_id'] ) ) {
65: 			$redirect = eb_get_mdl_url() . '/course/view.php?id=' . $_GET['mdl_course_id'];
66: 		} elseif ( isset( $data[ $role ] ) && ! empty( $data[ $role ] ) ) {
67: 			$redirect = $data[ $role ];
68: 		} elseif ( isset( $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'] ) && ! empty( $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'] ) ) {
69: 			$redirect = $data['ebsso_login_redirect_url'];
70: 		}

25:  * @param string $key key to check.
26:  */
27: function check_value_set( $data_array, $key ) {
28: 	$value = false;
29: 	if ( is_array( $data_array ) && array_key_exists( $key, $data_array ) && $data_array[ $key ] ) {
30: 		$value = empty( $data_array[ $key ] ) ? false : $data_array[ $key ];

  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\wooInt;
  3: class Bridge_Woo_Membership_Handler {
  4: 	private $version;
  5: 	private $plugin_name;
  6: 	public function __construct( $plugin_name, $version ) {
  7: 		$this->plugin_name = $plugin_name;
  8: 		$this->version     = $version;
  9: 	}
 10: 	public function get_membership_id( $course_id, $user_id ) {
 11: 		global $wpdb;
 12: 		$tbl_name        = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
 13: 		$old_memberships = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT membership_id FROM $tbl_name WHERE course_id = %d AND user_id = %d", array( $course_id, $user_id ) ) );
 14: 		$old_memberships = maybe_unserialize( $old_memberships );
 15: 		return $old_memberships;
 16: 	}
 17: 	public function get_products_from_membership_id( $membership_id ) {
 18: 		$associated_products = get_post_meta( $membership_id, '_product_ids', 1 );
 19: 		return $associated_products;
 20: 	}
 21: 	public function get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id ) {
 22: 		$products_list = $this->get_products_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
 23: 		$total_courses = array();
 24: 		foreach ( $products_list as $product_id ) {
 25: 			$new_courses = get_wp_courses_from_product_id( $product_id );
 26: 			if ( is_array( $new_courses ) ) {
 27: 				$total_courses = array_unique( array_merge( $total_courses, $new_courses ) );
 28: 			}
 29: 		}
 30: 		return $total_courses;
 31: 	}
 32: 	public function add_membership_column_in_moodle_enrollment() {
 33: 		global $wpdb;
 34: 		$usr_enrol_tbl = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
 35: 		$col_name      = 'membership_id';
 36: 		$col_type      = 'varchar( 200 )';
 37: 		$query         = "SHOW COLUMNS FROM `$usr_enrol_tbl` LIKE '$col_name';";
 38: 		$exists        = $wpdb->query( $query );
 39: 		if ( ! $exists ) {
 40: 			$query = "ALTER TABLE `$usr_enrol_tbl` ADD COLUMN ( `$col_name` $col_type );";
 41: 			$wpdb->query( $query );
 42: 		}
 43: 	}
 44: 	public function handle_membsership_order( $order, $user_id ) {
 45: 		$order_id = $order->get_id();
 46: 		$order_memberships = $order->get_meta( 'eb_order_associated_memberships', 1 );
 47: 		$order_memberships = maybe_unserialize( $order_memberships );
 48: 		if ( $order_memberships && ! empty( $order_memberships ) ) {
 49: 			foreach ( $order_memberships as $membership ) {
 50: 				$membership_products = $this->get_products_from_membership_id( $membership );
 51: 				foreach ( $membership_products as $product_id ) {
 52: 					$courses = get_wp_courses_from_product_id( $product_id );
 53: 					foreach ( $courses as $course_id ) {
 54: 						$this->update_membership_id_on_moodle_enrollment_tbl( $course_id, $user_id, $order_memberships );
 55: 					}
 56: 				}
 57: 			}
 58: 			$order->delete_meta_data( 'eb_order_associated_memberships' );
 59: 			$order->save();
 60: 		}
 61: 	}
 62: 	public function get_products_associated_with_membership( $single_item ) {
 63: 		$total_product_memberships = array();
 64: 		$product                   = wc_get_product( $single_item['product_id'] );
 65: 		$membership_plans          = $this->get_membership_plans();
 66: 		$variation_memberships     = array();
 67: 		$product_id                = $single_item['product_id'];
 68: 		if ( $product && $product->is_type( 'variable' ) && isset( $single_item['variation_id'] ) ) {
 69: 			$variation_id = $single_item['variation_id'];
 70: 			$variation_memberships = $this->return_memberships_associated_with_product( $variation_id, $membership_plans );
 71: 		}
 72: 		$total_product_memberships = $this->return_memberships_associated_with_product( $product_id, $membership_plans );
 73: 		$total_product_memberships = array_unique( array_merge( $total_product_memberships, $variation_memberships ) );
 74: 		return $total_product_memberships;
 75: 	}
 76: 	public function return_memberships_associated_with_product( $product_id, $membership_plans ) {
 77: 		$associated_memberships = array();
 78: 		foreach ( $membership_plans as $membership ) {
 79: 			if ( in_array( $product_id, $membership['associated_products'] ) && ! in_array( $membership['membership_id'], $associated_memberships ) ) {
 80: 				array_push( $associated_memberships, $membership['membership_id'] );
 81: 			}
 82: 		}
 83: 		return $associated_memberships;
 84: 	}
 85: 	public function update_membership_id_on_moodle_enrollment_tbl( $course_id, $user_id, $new_memberships ) {
 86: 		global $wpdb;
 87: 		$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
 88: 		$old_memberships = $this->get_membership_id( $course_id, $user_id );
 89: 		if ( ! empty( $old_memberships ) ) {
 90: 			$new_memberships = array_unique( array_merge( $old_memberships, $new_memberships ) );
 91: 		}
 92: 		$new_memberships = maybe_serialize( $new_memberships );
 93: 		$wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "UPDATE $tbl_name SET membership_id = %s WHERE course_id = %d AND user_id = %d", array( $new_memberships, $course_id, $user_id ) ) );
 94: 	}
 95: 	public function get_membership_plans() {
 96: 		$membership_plans_array = array();
 97: 		$args              = array( 'posts_per_page' => -1 );
 98: 		$args['post_type'] = 'wc_membership_plan';
 99: 		$membership_plans  = get_posts( $args );
100: 		if ( ! empty( $membership_plans ) ) {
101: 			foreach ( $membership_plans as $membership ) {
102: 				$associated_products = $this->get_products_from_membership_id( $membership->ID );
103: 				if ( ! empty( $associated_products ) ) {
104: 					array_push(
105: 						$membership_plans_array,
106: 						array(
107: 							'membership_id'       => $membership->ID,
108: 							'associated_products' => $associated_products,
109: 						)
110: 					);
111: 				}
112: 			}
113: 		}
114: 		return $membership_plans_array;
115: 	}
116: 	public function handle_membsership_status_change( $user_membership, $old_status, $new_status ) {
117: 		$user_id       = $user_membership->get_user_id();
118: 		$membership_id = $user_membership->get_plan_id();
119: 		$order_manager = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
120: 		switch ( $new_status ) {
121: 			case 'active':
122: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
123: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
124: 					$this->add_enrollment_entry_with_membership_id( $total_courses, $user_id, $membership_id );
125: 				}
126: 				break;
127: 			case 'paused':
128: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
129: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
130: 					$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 1 );
131: 				}
132: 				break;
133: 			case 'expired':
134: 			case 'cancelled':
135: 				$option_name = 'wi_on_membership_' . $new_status;
136: 				$total_courses = $this->get_courses_from_membership_id( $membership_id );
137: 				if ( ! empty( $total_courses ) ) {
138: 					$woo_int_settings = maybe_unserialize( get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', false ) );
139: 					if ( isset( $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) && 'suspend' === $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) {
140: 						$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 1 );
141: 					} elseif ( isset( $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) && 'unenroll' === $woo_int_settings[ $option_name ] ) {
142: 						$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, $total_courses, 0, 1 );
143: 					}
144: 				}
145: 				break;
146: 			default:
147: 				break;
148: 		}
149: 	}
150: 	public function add_enrollment_entry_with_membership_id( $total_courses, $user_id, $membership_id ) {
151: 		global $wpdb;
152: 		$tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
153: 		foreach ( $total_courses as $course_id ) {
154: 			$old_memberships = $wpdb->get_var( $wpdb->prepare( "SELECT membership_id, act_cnt FROM $tbl_name WHERE course_id = %d AND user_id = %d", array( $course_id, $user_id ) ) );
155: 			$old_memberships = maybe_unserialize( $old_memberships );
156: 			$order_manager = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Order_Manager( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
157: 			if ( empty( $old_memberships ) ) {
158: 				$order_manager->enroll_user_in_courses( $user_id, array( $course_id ) );
159: 			}
160: 			$membsership_array = array( $membership_id );
161: 			$this->update_membership_id_on_moodle_enrollment_tbl( $course_id, $user_id, $membsership_array );
162: 		}
163: 	}
164: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/woo-int/class-bridge-woo-product-api.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\wooInt;
 3: use \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\EdwiserBridge;
 4: class Bridge_Woo_Product_API {
 5: 	public function wi_get_edwiser_products_list() {
 6: 		register_rest_route(
 7: 			'edwiser-bridge',
 8: 			'/woo-products/',
 9: 			array(
10: 				'methods'             => 'GET',
11: 				'callback'            => array( $this, 'wi_get_edwiser_products' ),
12: 				'permission_callback' => '__return_true',
13: 			)
14: 		);
15: 	}
16: 	public function wi_get_edwiser_products() {
17: 		global $wpdb;
18: 		$products = array();
19: 		$query  = 'SELECT DISTINCT `product_id` FROM `' . $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products`';
20: 		$result = $wpdb->get_results( $query, ARRAY_A );
21: 		foreach ( $result as $products_id_arr ) {
22: 			$product_id = $products_id_arr['product_id'];
23: 			$product    = wc_get_product( $product_id );
24: 			$post = get_post( $product_id, ARRAY_A );
25: 			$terms      = get_the_terms( $product_id, 'product_cat' );
26: 			$categories = array();
27: 			foreach ( $terms as $term ) {
28: 				$categories[] = array(
29: 					'id'   => $term->id,
30: 					'name' => $term->name,
31: 					'slug' => $term->slug,
32: 				);
33: 			}
34: 			$products[] = array(
35: 				'id'            => $product_id,
36: 				'name'          => $post['post_title'],
37: 				'permalink'     => get_post_permalink( $product_id ),
38: 				'slug'          => $post['post_name'],
39: 				'date_created'  => $post['post_date'],
40: 				'date_modified' => $post['post_modified'],
41: 				'type'          => $product->get_type( $product_id ),
42: 				'status'        => $post['post_status'],
43: 				'description'   => $post['post_content'],
44: 				'price'         => $product->get_price(),
45: 				'regular_price' => $product->get_regular_price(),
46: 				'sale_price'    => $product->get_sale_price(),
47: 				'categories'    => $categories,
48: 				'image-link'    => wp_get_attachment_image_src( get_post_thumbnail_id( $product_id ), 'single-post-thumbnail' ),
49: 			);
50: 		}
51: 		return $products;
52: 	}
53: }
```

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/woo-int/class-bridge-woocommerce-ajax.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes\wooInt;
 3: use \app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridge\EdwiserBridge;
 4: use app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes as includes;
 5: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
 6: 	exit;
 7: }
 8: class Bridge_Woocommerce_Ajax {
 9: 	private $edwiser_bridge;
10: 	public function __construct() {
11: 		add_action( 'wp_ajax_nopriv_handle_product_synchronization', array( $this, 'handle_product_synchronization_callback' ) );
12: 		add_action( 'wp_ajax_handle_product_synchronization', array( $this, 'handle_product_synchronization_callback' ) );
13: 		require_once WP_PLUGIN_DIR . '/edwiser-bridge/includes/class-eb.php';
14: 		$this->edwiser_bridge = new EdwiserBridge();
15: 	}
16: 	public function handle_product_synchronization_callback() {
17: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Initiating Product sync process....' );
18: 		if ( ! isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ) {
19: 			die( 'Busted!' );
20: 		}
21: 		$nonce = isset( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) ? esc_attr( $_POST['_wpnonce_field'] ) : ''; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
22: 		// verifying generated nonce we created earlier.
23: 		if ( ! wp_verify_nonce( $nonce, 'check_product_sync_action' ) ) {
24: 			die( 'Busted !' );
25: 		}
26: 		$sync_options = isset( $_POST['sync_options'] ) ? esc_attr( $_POST['sync_options'] ) : ''; // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
27: 		// get sync options.
28: 		$sync_options      = json_decode( str_replace( '\\', '', html_entity_decode( $sync_options ) ), 1);
29: 		$course_woo_plugin = new Bridge_Woocommerce_Course( includes\edwiser_bridge_pro()->get_plugin_name(), includes\edwiser_bridge_pro()->get_version() );
30: 		$response          = $course_woo_plugin->bridge_woo_product_sync_handler( $sync_options );
31: 		echo json_encode( $response );
32: 		die();
33: 	}
34: }
35: new Bridge_Woocommerce_Ajax();
```

233: 			$category_respone = $this->bridge_woo_sync_product_categories();

235: 		if ( isset( $sync_options['bridge_woo_synchronize_product_update'] ) && 1 == $sync_options['bridge_woo_synchronize_product_update'] ) {
236: 			$response = $this->bridge_woo_sync_update_product( $sync_options );

238: 		if ( isset( $sync_options['bridge_woo_synchronize_product_create'] ) && 1 == $sync_options['bridge_woo_synchronize_product_create'] ) {
239: 			if ( empty( $response ) ) {
240: 				$response = $this->bridge_woo_sync_create_product( $sync_options );
241: 			} else {
242: 				$response = array_merge_recursive( $response, $this->bridge_woo_sync_create_product( $sync_options ) );
243: 			}
244: 		}
245: 		if ( ! empty( $category_respone ) ) {
246: 			$response = array_merge_recursive( $response, $category_respone );
247: 		}
248: 		return $response;

250: 	public function wdm_array_column( $input = null, $column_key = null, $index_key = null ) {
251: 		if ( empty( $input ) ) {
252: 			$input = null;
253: 		}
254: 		if ( empty( $column_key ) ) {
255: 			$column_key = null;
256: 		}
257: 		if ( empty( $index_key ) ) {
258: 			$index_key = null;
259: 		}
260: 		$argc              = func_num_args();
261: 		$params            = func_get_args();
262: 		$params_input      = $params[0];
263: 		$params_column_key = ( null !== $params[1] ) ? (string) $params[1] : null;
264: 		$params_index_key  = null;
265: 		if ( isset( $params[2] ) ) {
266: 			if ( is_float( $params[2] ) || is_int( $params[2] ) ) {
267: 				$params_index_key = (int) $params[2];
268: 			} else {
269: 				$params_index_key = (string) $params[2];
270: 			}
271: 		}
272: 		$result_array = array();
273: 		$result_array = $this->get_result_arr( $params_input, $params_index_key, $params_column_key );
274: 		return $result_array;
275: 	}
276: 	public function get_result_arr( $params_input, $params_index_key, $params_column_key ) {
277: 		$result_array = array();
278: 		foreach ( $params_input as $row ) {
279: 			$key       = null;
280: 			$value     = null;
281: 			$key_set   = false;
282: 			$value_set = false;
283: 			if ( null !== $params_index_key && array_key_exists( $params_index_key, $row ) ) {
284: 				$key_set = true;
285: 				$key     = (string) $row[ $params_index_key ];
286: 			}
287: 			if ( null === $params_column_key ) {
288: 				$value_set = true;
289: 				$value     = $row;
290: 			} elseif ( is_array( $row ) && array_key_exists( $params_column_key, $row ) ) {
291: 				$value_set = true;
292: 				$value     = $row[ $params_column_key ];
293: 			}
294: 			if ( $value_set ) {
295: 				if ( $key_set ) {
296: 					$result_array[ $key ] = $value;
297: 				} else {
298: 					$result_array[] = $value;
299: 				}
300: 			}
301: 		}
302: 		return $result_array;
303: 	}
304: }

230: 		}
231: 	}
232: 	public function get_moodle_course_ids_for_order( $order, $skip_subscription = 0 ) {
233: 		$order_id                     = $order->get_id();
234: 		$list_of_course_ids           = array();
235: 		$total_associated_memberships = array();
236: 		$order_id = $order->get_id();
237: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'user', 'Check Line Items for Order ID - ' . $order_id );
238: 		$membership_handler = new Bridge_Woo_Membership_Handler( $this->plugin_name, $this->version );
239: 		$items = $order->get_items();
240: 		foreach ( $items as $single_item ) {
241: 			$product_id = '';
242: 			if ( isset( $single_item['product_id'] ) ) {
243: 				$_product = wc_get_product( $single_item['product_id'] );
244: 				if ( 1 === $skip_subscription && defined( 'WOOINT_WCS_VER' ) && \WC_Subscriptions_Product::is_subscription( $_product ) ) {
245: 						continue;
246: 				}
247: 				$product_id = eb_get_product_id_from_product( $_product, $single_item );
248: 			}
249: 			if ( is_numeric( $product_id ) ) {
250: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
251: 				$group_purchase  = 'no';
252: 				if ( 'no' === apply_filters( 'is_order_group_purchase', $group_purchase, $single_item->get_id() ) ) {
253: 					if ( check_value_set( $product_options, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) ) {
254: 						$line_item_course_ids = $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'];
255: 						if ( ! empty( $list_of_course_ids ) ) {
256: 							$list_of_course_ids = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_course_ids, $line_item_course_ids ), SORT_REGULAR );
257: 						} else {
258: 							$list_of_course_ids = $line_item_course_ids;
259: 						}
260: 					}
261: 				}
262: 			}
263: 			$membership_processed_data    = $this->merge_membership_courses( $membership_handler, $list_of_course_ids, $single_item, $total_associated_memberships );
264: 			$list_of_course_ids           = $membership_processed_data['course_list'];
265: 			$total_associated_memberships = $membership_processed_data['total_memberships'];
266: 		}
267: 		if ( ! empty( $total_associated_memberships ) ) {
268: 			$order->update_meta_data( 'eb_order_associated_memberships', maybe_serialize( $total_associated_memberships ) );
269: 			$order->save();
270: 		}
271: 		$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'user', 'Courses IDs from Line Items  ' . serialize( $list_of_course_ids ) );
272: 		return $list_of_course_ids;
273: 	}
274: 	public function merge_membership_courses( $membership_handler, $list_of_course_ids, $single_product_item, $total_associated_memberships ) {
275: 		if ( check_woocommerce_membership_is_active() ) {
276: 			$associated_memberships = $membership_handler->get_products_associated_with_membership( $single_product_item );
277: 			if ( ! empty( $associated_memberships ) ) {
278: 				foreach ( $associated_memberships as $membership ) {
279: 					$membership_products = $membership_handler->get_products_from_membership_id( $membership );
280: 					foreach ( $membership_products as $product_id ) {
281: 						$list_of_course_ids = is_array( $list_of_course_ids ) ? $list_of_course_ids : array();
282: 						$new_courses        = get_wp_courses_from_product_id( $product_id );
283: 						$new_courses        = is_array( $new_courses ) ? $new_courses : array();
284: 						$list_of_course_ids = array_unique( array_merge( $list_of_course_ids, $new_courses ) );
285: 					}
286: 				}
287: 				$total_associated_memberships = array_unique( array_merge( $total_associated_memberships, $associated_memberships ) );
288: 			}
289: 		}
290: 		return array(
291: 			'course_list'       => $list_of_course_ids,
292: 			'total_memberships' => $total_associated_memberships,
293: 		);
294: 	}
295: 	public function wcs_status_updated( $subscription, $new_status, $old_status ) {
296: 		if ( get_class( $subscription ) !== 'WC_Subscription' ) {
297: 			return;
298: 		}
299: 		if ( 'pending-cancel' === $new_status ) {
300: 			return;
301: 		}
302: 		if ( 'active' === $new_status ) {
303: 			update_post_meta( $subscription->get_id(), '_eb_subscription_processed', 1 );
304: 		}
305: 		$is_processed = get_post_meta( $subscription->get_id(), '_eb_subscription_processed', true );
306: 		if ( ( 'on-hold' === $new_status || 'cancelled' === $new_status ) && ! $is_processed ) {
307: 			return;
308: 		}
309: 		$statuses = array(
310: 			'completed' => true,
311: 			'active'    => false,
312: 			'failed'    => true,
313: 			'on-hold'   => true,
314: 			'cancelled' => true,
315: 			'switched'  => true,
316: 			'expired'   => true,
317: 		);
318: 		$statuses = apply_filters( 'eb_subscription_suspend_status', $statuses );
319: 		$do_not_proceed_arr = array(
320: 			'pending-cancel',
321: 		);
322: 		$process_rquest_array = array();
323: 		if ( array_key_exists( $new_status, $statuses ) ) {
324: 			$suspend = isset( $statuses[ $new_status ] ) && ! $statuses[ $new_status ] ? 0 : 1;
325: 			$user    = get_user_by( 'id', $subscription->get_user_id() );
326: 			$order_id = $subscription->get_parent_id();
327: 			$unenroll           = 0;
328: 			$sub_expire_setting = $this->check_subscription_expiration_settings( $new_status );
329: 			if ( -1 === $sub_expire_setting ) {
330: 				return;
331: 			}
332: 			extract( $sub_expire_setting, EXTR_OVERWRITE );
333: 			$items = $subscription->get_items();
334: 			if ( version_compare( WOOCOMMERCE_VERSION, '3.0.0', '>=' ) ) {
335: 				foreach ( $items as $item ) {
336: 					$product_id = $item->get_product_id();
337: 					$product    = $item->get_product( $product_id );
338: 					if ( $product->is_type( 'subscription_variation' ) ) {
339: 						$product_id = $item->get_variation_id();
340: 					} else {
341: 						$product_id = $item->get_product_id();
342: 					}
343: 					$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
344: 					if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
345: 						if ( isset( $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) && 'yes' === $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) {
346: 							$end_date = $subscription->get_date( 'end' );
347: 						} else {
348: 							$end_date = false;
349: 						}
350: 						$course_enrolled = self::enroll_user_in_courses(
351: 							$subscription->get_user_id(),
352: 							$product_options['moodle_post_course_id'],
353: 							$suspend,
354: 							$unenroll,
355: 							$subscription->get_date( 'start' ),
356: 							$end_date
357: 						);
358: 						$email_args = array(
359: 							'user_email' => $user->user_email,
360: 							'order_id'   => $order_id,
361: 							'username'   => $user->user_login,
362: 							'first_name' => $user->first_name,
363: 							'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
364: 						);
365: 						if ( 1 === $course_enrolled && ! $suspend ) {
366: 							include_once 'emails/class-eb-woo-int-emailer.php';
367: 							$plugin_emailer = new Eb_Woo_Int_Emailer();
368: 							$plugin_emailer->send_course_enrollment_email( $email_args );
369: 						}
370: 					}
371: 				}
372: 			} else {
373: 				foreach ( $items as $item ) {
374: 						$product_id           = $item['product_id'];
375: 						$product_variation_id = $item['variation_id'];
376: 						$product              = \wc_get_product( $product_id );
377: 					if ( $product->is_type( 'variable' ) || $product->is_type( 'subscription_variation' ) ) {
378: 						$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_variation_id, 'product_options', true );
379: 					} else {
380: 						$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
381: 					}
382: 					if ( isset( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
383: 						if ( isset( $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) && 'yes' === $product_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) {
384: 							$end_date = $subscription->get_date( 'end' );
385: 						} else {
386: 							$end_date = false;
387: 						}
388: 						$course_enrolled = self::enroll_user_in_courses(
389: 							$subscription->order->user_id,
390: 							$product_options['moodle_post_course_id'],
391: 							$suspend,
392: 							$unenroll,
393: 							$subscription->get_date( 'start' ),
394: 							$end_date
395: 						);
396: 						$email_args = array(
397: 							'user_email' => $user->user_email,
398: 							'order_id'   => $order_id,
399: 							'username'   => $user->user_login,
400: 							'first_name' => $user->first_name,
401: 							'last_name'  => $user->last_name,
402: 						);
403: 						if ( 1 === $course_enrolled ) {
404: 							include_once 'emails/class-eb-woo-int-emailer.php';
405: 							$plugin_emailer = new Eb_Woo_Int_Emailer();
406: 							$plugin_emailer->send_course_enrollment_email( $email_args );
407: 						}
408: 					}
409: 				}
410: 			}
411: 		}
412: 	}
413: 	private function check_subscription_expiration_settings( $new_status ) {
414: 		$sub_expire_setting = array();
415: 		if ( 'expired' === $new_status || 'cancelled' === $new_status ) {
416: 			$woo_int_settings           = get_option( 'eb_woo_int_settings', array() );
417: 			$on_subscription_expiration = $woo_int_settings['wi_on_subscription_expiration'];
418: 			if ( 'do-nothing' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
419: 				return -1;
420: 			} elseif ( 'suspend' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
421: 				$sub_expire_setting['suspend'] = 1;
422: 			} elseif ( 'unenroll' === $on_subscription_expiration ) {
423: 				$sub_expire_setting['unenroll'] = 1;
424: 			}
425: 		}
426: 		return $sub_expire_setting;
427: 	}
428: 	public function wc_order_status_changed( $order_id, $old_status, $new_status ) {
429: 		$statuses = array(
430: 			'completed'  => true,
431: 			'processing' => false,
432: 			'on-hold'    => false,
433: 			'cancelled'  => false,
434: 			'failed'     => false,
435: 			'refunded'   => false,
436: 		);
437: 		if ( isset( $statuses[ $new_status ] ) && true === $statuses[ $new_status ] ) {
438: 			$this->handle_order_complete( $order_id );
439: 		} elseif ( 'cancelled' === $new_status && false === $statuses[ $new_status ] ) {
440: 			$this->handle_order_cancel( $order_id );
441: 		}
442: 		do_action( 'wooint_after_order_status_changed', $order_id, $old_status, $new_status );
443: 	}
444: 	public function disable_guest_checkout( $value ) {
445: 		if ( is_admin() ) {
446: 			return $value;
447: 		}
448: 		if ( WC()->cart ) {
449: 			$cart = WC()->cart->get_cart();
450: 			foreach ( $cart as $item ) {
451: 				$_product    = $item['data'];
452: 				$_product_id = $_product->get_id();
453: 				$product_options = get_post_meta( $_product_id, 'product_options', true );
454: 				if ( check_value_set( $product_options, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) ) {
455: 					$value = 'no';
456: 					break;
457: 				}
458: 			}
459: 		}
460: 		return $value;
461: 	}
462: 	public function show_purchase_for_someone_else_data( $order ) {
463: 		$is_for_someone_else = $order->get_meta( '_order_for_someone_else', true );
464: 		if ( ! empty( $is_for_someone_else ) && 'yes' === $is_for_someone_else ) {
465: 			$user_email               = $order->get_meta( '_recipient_email', true );
466: 			$user                     = get_user_by( 'email', $user_email );
467: 			echo '<p><strong>' . __( 'Course purchased for someone else: ', 'edwiser-bridge-pro'). '</strong>' . __( 'Yes', 'edwiser-bridge-pro' ) . '</p>';
468: 			echo '<p><strong>' . __( 'Enrolled User: ', 'edwiser-bridge-pro'). '</strong><a href="' . esc_url( get_edit_user_link( $user->ID ) ) . '">' . $user_email . '</a></p>';
469: 		}
470: 	}
471: }

171: 	public function handle_post_options_save( $post_id ) {
172: 		global $pagenow;
173: 		$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
174: 		if ( self::is_valid_to_save_meta() && in_array( $post_type, array( 'product' ) ) && 'admin-ajax.php' !== $pagenow ) {
175: 			$update_post_options = array();
176: 			$fields = $this->populate_metabox_fields( $post_type );
177: 			$post_options = check_value_set( $_POST, $post_type . '_options' );
178: 			if ( ! empty( $post_options ) ) {
179: 				foreach ( $fields as $key => $values ) {
180: 					$option_name  = $key;
181: 					$option_value = $this->wdm_isset_null( $post_options[ $key ] );
182: 					switch ( sanitize_title( $values['type'] ) ) {
183: 						case 'checkbox':
184: 							$option_value = is_null( $option_value ) ? 'no' : 'yes';
185: 							break;
186: 						case 'textarea':
187: 							$option_value = wp_kses_post( trim( $option_value ) );
188: 							break;
189: 						case 'text':
190: 						case 'text_secret':
191: 						case 'number':
192: 						case 'select':
193: 						case 'password':
194: 						case 'radio':
195: 							$option_value = wpClean( $option_value );
196: 							break;
197: 						case 'select_multi':
198: 						case 'checkbox_multi':
199: 							$option_value = array_filter( array_map( 'wpClean', (array) $option_value ) );
200: 							break;
201: 						default:
202: 							break;
203: 					}
204: 					if ( ! is_null( $option_value ) ) {
205: 						$update_post_options[ $option_name ] = $option_value;
206: 					}
207: 				}
208: 			}
209: 			$product = wc_get_product( $post_id );
210: 			if ( class_exists( 'WC_Subscriptions_Product' ) && \WC_Subscriptions_Product::is_subscription( $product ) ) {
211: 				if ( isset( $_POST['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) && 'yes' === $_POST['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] ) {
212: 					$update_post_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] = 'yes';
213: 				} else {
214: 					$update_post_options['eb_apply_subscription_expiry'] = 'no';
215: 				}
216: 			}
217: 			self::bridge_woo_save_meta( $update_post_options, $post_id, 'product' );
218: 			return true;
219: 		}
220: 	}
221: 	public static function is_valid_to_save_meta() {
222: 		if ( empty( $_POST ) ) {
223: 			return false;
224: 		}
225: 		if ( isset( $_POST['action'] ) && 'handle_product_synchronization' === $_POST['action'] ) {
226: 			return false;
227: 		}
228: 		if ( defined( 'DOING_AUTOSAVE' ) && DOING_AUTOSAVE ) {
229: 			return false;
230: 		}
231: 		return true;
232: 	}

234: 		if ( isset( $var ) ) {
235: 			return $var;
236: 		} else {
237: 			return null;
238: 		}
239: 	}
240: 	public function bridge_woo_save_meta( $update_post_options, $product_id, $post_type ) {
241: 		global $wpdb;
242: 		$course_id_list = array();
243: 		if ( is_array( $update_post_options ) ) {
244: 			if ( isset( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) && is_array( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
245: 				foreach ( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] as $key => $moo_post_course_id ) {
246: 					if ( -1 === intval( $moo_post_course_id ) ) {
247: 						array_splice( $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'], $key, 1 );
248: 						continue;
249: 					}
250: 					$moodle_course_id = get_post_meta( $moo_post_course_id, 'moodle_course_id', true );
251: 					array_push( $course_id_list, $moodle_course_id );
252: 					$insert_query = 'INSERT INTO `' . $wpdb->prefix . "eb_moodle_course_products`(`product_id`, `moodle_post_id`, `moodle_course_id` ) SELECT * FROM (SELECT '{$product_id}' as `product_id`, '{$moo_post_course_id}' as `moodle_post_id`, '{$moodle_course_id}' as `moodle_course_id` ) AS tmp
253: 					WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT `product_id`,`moodle_post_id` FROM `" . $wpdb->prefix . "eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `product_id` = '{$product_id}' AND `moodle_post_id` = '{$moo_post_course_id}'
254: 					) LIMIT 1;";
255: 					$wpdb->get_results($insert_query );
256: 				}
257: 				$moo_course_id_list = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
258: 				if ( check_value_set( $moo_course_id_list, 'moodle_post_course_id' ) && is_array( $moo_course_id_list['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
259: 					$course_list_diff = array_diff( $moo_course_id_list['moodle_post_course_id'], $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] );
260: 					if ( is_array( $course_list_diff ) ) {
261: 						if ( 'product_variation' === $post_type ) {
262: 							$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
263: 							$where           = array(
264: 								'product_id'     => $product_id,
265: 								'moodle_post_id' => implode( ',', $course_list_diff ),
266: 							);
267: 							$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
268: 						} else {
269: 							$product_permalink = get_permalink( $product_id );
270: 							foreach ( $course_list_diff as $single_course_diff ) {
271: 								$course_options = get_post_meta( $single_course_diff, 'eb_course_options', true );
272: 								if ( ! empty( $course_options ) && isset( $course_options['course_closed_url'] ) ) {
273: 									if ( 0 === strcmp( $course_options['course_closed_url'], $product_permalink ) ) {
274: 										$course_options['course_closed_url'] = '';
275: 										update_post_meta( $single_course_diff, 'eb_course_options', $course_options );
276: 									}
277: 								}
278: 								$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
279: 								$where           = array(
280: 									'product_id'     => $product_id,
281: 									'moodle_post_id' => $single_course_diff,
282: 								);
283: 								$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
284: 							}
285: 						}
286: 					}
287: 				}
288: 				if ( '-1' != $update_post_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) {
289: 					$update_post_options['moodle_course_id'] = implode( ',', $course_id_list );
290: 				} else {
291: 					$update_post_options = '';
292: 				}
293: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $update_post_options );
294: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'is_product_a_moodle_course', 'yes' );
295: 			} else {
296: 				$product_options = array(
297: 					'moodle_post_course_id' => array(),
298: 					'moodle_course_id'      => '',
299: 				);
300: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $product_options );
301: 				update_post_meta( $product_id, 'is_product_a_moodle_course', 'no' );
302: 			}
303: 		} else {
304: 		}
305: 	}
306: 	public function handle_post_options_delete( $post_id ) {
307: 		global $wpdb;
308: 		$post_type = get_post_type( $post_id );
309: 		$post_permalink = get_permalink( $post_id );
310: 		if ( 'product' === $post_type ) {
311: 			$query                = "SELECT * FROM `{$wpdb->prefix}eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `product_id` = " . $post_id;
312: 			$linked_course_result = $wpdb->get_results( $query );
313: 			if ( ! empty( $linked_course_result ) ) {
314: 				$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Perform operation on Product delete  ' . $post_id );
315: 				foreach ( $linked_course_result as $single_course_result ) {
316: 					$moodle_post_id = $single_course_result->moodle_post_id;
317: 					$course_options = get_post_meta( $moodle_post_id, 'eb_course_options', true );
318: 					if ( ! empty( $course_options ) ) {
319: 						if ( 0 === strcmp( rtrim( $course_options['course_closed_url'], '/' ), rtrim( $post_permalink, '/' ) ) ) {
320: 							$course_options['course_closed_url'] = '';
321: 							update_post_meta( $moodle_post_id, 'eb_course_options', $course_options );
322: 							$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'product', 'Course ID ' . $moodle_post_id . ' closed url is reset.' );
323: 						}
324: 					}
325: 				}
326: 				$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
327: 				$where           = array( 'product_id' => $post_id );
328: 				$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
329: 			}
330: 		} elseif ( 'eb_course' === $post_type ) {
331: 			$query          = "SELECT * FROM `{$wpdb->prefix}eb_moodle_course_products` WHERE `moodle_post_id` = " . $post_id;
332: 			$product_result = $wpdb->get_results( $query );
333: 			$cur_moodle_course_id = get_post_meta( $post_id, 'moodle_course_id', true );
334: 			if ( ! empty( $product_result ) ) {
335: 				$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Perform operation on Course delete  ' . $post_id );
336: 				foreach ( $product_result as $single_product ) {
337: 					$find_key   = false;
338: 					$product_id = $this->wdm_isset_null( $single_product->product_id );
339: 					if ( ! empty( $product_id ) ) {
340: 						$product_options = get_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', true );
341: 						if ( ! empty( $product_options ) && is_array( $product_options ) ) {
342: 							$moodle_post_id_list = $this->wdm_isset_null( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] );
343: 							if ( ! empty( $moodle_post_id_list ) && is_array( $moodle_post_id_list ) ) {
344: 								$find_key = array_search( $post_id, $moodle_post_id_list );
345: 								if ( is_numeric( $find_key ) ) {
346: 									unset( $moodle_post_id_list[ $find_key ] );
347: 								}
348: 								$product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] = $moodle_post_id_list;
349: 							}
350: 							$course_id_list = isset( $product_options['moodle_course_id'] ) ? $product_options['moodle_course_id'] : '';
351: 							$find_key       = false;
352: 							if ( ! empty( $course_id_list ) ) {
353: 								$course_id_list = explode( ',', $course_id_list );
354: 								$find_key = array_search( $cur_moodle_course_id, $course_id_list ); // @codingStandardsIgnoreLine
355: 								if ( is_numeric( $find_key ) ) {
356: 									unset( $course_id_list[ $find_key ] );
357: 								}
358: 								$product_options['moodle_course_id'] = implode( ',', $course_id_list );
359: 							}
360: 						}
361: 						update_post_meta( $product_id, 'product_options', $product_options );
362: 						$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Product association is removed for Product ID ' . $product_id );
363: 						if ( empty( $product_options['moodle_post_course_id'] ) ) {
364: 							wp_delete_post( $product_id );
365: 							$this->edwiser_bridge->logger()->add( 'course', 'Product deleted, Product ID ' . $product_id );
366: 						}
367: 					}
368: 				}
369: 				$course_tbl_name = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
370: 				$where           = array( 'moodle_post_id' => $post_id );
371: 				$wpdb->delete( $course_tbl_name, $where );
372: 			}
373: 		}
374: 	}
375: }

295: 	public function eb_pro_shop_page_per_page( $woo_per_page ) {
296: 		$eb_shop_page = get_option('eb_pro_elementor_shop_page_template_id');
297: 		$is_page_shop = false;
298: 		if( 'publish' == get_post_status( $eb_shop_page ) ) {
299: 			$conditions = get_post_meta( $eb_shop_page, '_elementor_conditions', true );
300: 			if ( ! empty( $conditions ) ) {
301: 				foreach( $conditions as $condition ) {
302: 					if( strpos( $condition, 'shop_page' ) !== false ) {
303: 						$is_page_shop = true;
304: 						break;
305: 					}
306: 				}
307: 			}
308: 		}
309:         $per_page = get_option('eb_pro_shop_page_product_per_page');
310: 		if($per_page && $is_page_shop) {
311: 			return $per_page;
312: 		} else {
313: 			return $woo_per_page;
314: 		}
315:     }

256: 	public static function modify_table_schema() {
257: 		global $wpdb;
258: 		$tbl_cohort = $wpdb->prefix . 'bp_cohort_info';
259: 		if ( $wpdb->query( "SHOW TABLES LIKE '" . $tbl_cohort . "'" ) === 1 ) {
260: 			$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE `$tbl_cohort` MODIFY COLUMN COHORT_NAME varchar(300);" );
261: 		}
262: 		$new_columns = array(
263: 			'idnumber' => 'varchar(500)',
264: 			'NAME'     => 'varchar(300)',
265: 			'COURSES'  => 'text',
266: 		);
267: 		foreach ( $new_columns as $col_name => $col_type ) {
268: 			$exists = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "SHOW COLUMNS FROM {$tbl_cohort} LIKE '%s';", $col_name ) );
269: 			if ( ! $exists ) {
270: 				$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE {$tbl_cohort} ADD {$col_name} {$col_type};" );
271: 			} else {
272: 				$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE {$tbl_cohort} MODIFY {$col_name} {$col_type};" );
273: 			}
274: 		}
275: 		$usr_enrol_tbl = $wpdb->prefix . 'moodle_enrollment';
276: 		if ( $wpdb->get_var( "SHOW TABLES LIKE '{$usr_enrol_tbl}'" ) === $usr_enrol_tbl ) {
277: 			$columns = array(
278: 				'enrolled_by'   => 'varchar(10)',
279: 				'product_id'    => 'int(11)',
280: 				'mdl_cohort_id' => 'int(20)',
281: 				'role'          => 'varchar(20)',
282: 			);
283: 			foreach ( $columns as $col_name => $col_type ) {
284: 				$exists = $wpdb->query( $wpdb->prepare( "SHOW COLUMNS FROM {$usr_enrol_tbl} LIKE '%s';", $col_name ) );
285: 				if ( ! $exists ) {
286: 					$wpdb->query( "ALTER TABLE {$usr_enrol_tbl} ADD {$col_name} {$col_type};" );
287: 				}
288: 			}
289: 		}
290: 		$woo_moo_course_tbl = $wpdb->prefix . 'woo_moodle_course';
291: 		$woo_moo_course_tbl_new = $wpdb->prefix . 'eb_moodle_course_products';
292: 		if ( $wpdb->get_var( "SHOW TABLES LIKE '{$woo_moo_course_tbl}'" ) === $woo_moo_course_tbl && $wpdb->get_var( "SHOW TABLES LIKE '{$woo_moo_course_tbl_new}'" ) !== $woo_moo_course_tbl_new ) {
293: 			$wpdb->query( "RENAME TABLE {$woo_moo_course_tbl} TO {$wpdb->prefix}eb_moodle_course_products;" );
294: 		}
295: 	}

 68: 		public static function get_site_list( $plugin_slug ) {

 83: 					}

101: 			if ( 'valid' === $license_status ) {
102: 				self::$license_data = 'available';
103: 			} elseif ( 'expired' === $license_status && ( ! empty( $active_site ) || '' !== $active_site ) ) {
104: 				self::$license_data = 'unavailable';
105: 			} elseif ( 'expired' === $license_status ) {
106: 				self::$license_data = 'available';
107: 			} else {
108: 				self::$license_data = 'unavailable';
109: 			}
110: 			if ( $set_trans ) {
111: 				switch ( $license_status ) {
112: 					case 'invalid':
113: 					case 'no_activations_left':
114: 						$time = 0;
115: 						break;
116: 					case 'failed':
117: 						$time = 86400;
118: 						break;
119: 					case 'expired':
120: 						$time = 86400 * 2;
121: 						break;
122: 					case 'disabled':
123: 						$time = 86400 * 4;
124: 						break;
125: 					case 'valid':
126: 						$time = 86400 * 7;
127: 						break;
128: 					default:
129: 						$time = 86400 * 7;
130: 						break;
131: 				}
132: 				set_transient( 'wdm_' . $plugin_slug . '_license_trans', $license_status, $time );
133: 			}
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: }
```

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/class-eb-pro-loader.php
```php
 1: <?php
 2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes;
 3: class Eb_Pro_Loader {
 4: 	protected $actions;
 5: 	protected $filters;
 6: 	public function __construct() {
 7: 		$this->actions = array();
 8: 		$this->filters = array();
 9: 	}
10: 	public function add_action( $hook, $component, $callback, $priority = 10, $accepted_args = 1 ) {
11: 		$this->actions = $this->add( $this->actions, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args );
12: 	}
13: 	public function add_filter( $hook, $component, $callback, $priority = 10, $accepted_args = 1 ) {
14: 		$this->filters = $this->add( $this->filters, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args );
15: 	}
16: 	private function add( $hooks, $hook, $component, $callback, $priority, $accepted_args ) {
17: 		$hooks[] = array(
18: 			'hook'          => $hook,
19: 			'component'     => $component,
20: 			'callback'      => $callback,
21: 			'priority'      => $priority,
22: 			'accepted_args' => $accepted_args,
23: 		);
24: 		return $hooks;
25: 	}
26: 	public function run() {
27: 		foreach ( $this->filters as $hook ) {
28: 			add_filter( $hook['hook'], array( $hook['component'], $hook['callback'] ), $hook['priority'], $hook['accepted_args'] );
29: 		}
30: 		foreach ( $this->actions as $hook ) {
31: 			add_action( $hook['hook'], array( $hook['component'], $hook['callback'] ), $hook['priority'], $hook['accepted_args'] );
32: 		}
33: 	}
34: }

## File: edwiser-bridge-pro/includes/class-eb-pro-plugin-updater.php
```php
  1: <?php
  2: namespace app\wisdmlabs\edwiserBridgePro\includes;
  3: if ( ! defined( 'ABSPATH' ) ) {
  4: 	exit;
  5: }
  6: if ( ! class_exists( 'Eb_Pro_Plugin_Updater' ) ) {
  7: 	class Eb_Pro_Plugin_Updater {
  8: 		private $api_url = '';
  9: 		/**
 10: 		 * Api data.
 11: 		 *
 12: 		 * @var      string    $api_data  api data .
 13: 		 */
 14: 		private $api_data = array();
 15: 		/**
 16: 		 * Plugin name.
 17: 		 *
 18: 		 * @var      string    $name  name .
 19: 		 */
 20: 		private $name = '';
 21: 		/**
 22: 		 * Plugin slug.
 23: 		 *
 24: 		 * @var      string    $slug  slug .
 25: 		 */
 26: 		private $slug = '';
 27: 		/**
 28: 		 * Plugin version.
 29: 		 *
 30: 		 * @var      string    $version  version .
 31: 		 */
 32: 		private $version = '';
 33: 		/**
 34: 		 * Api response data from edwiser.org
 35: 		 *
 36: 		 * @var      string    $response_data  response_data .
 37: 		 */
 38: 		private static $response_data;
 39: 		/**
 40: 		 * Class constructor.
 41: 		 *
 42: 		 * @param string $_api_url The URL pointing to the custom API endpoint.
 43: 		 * @param string $_plugin_file Path to the plugin file.
 44: 		 * @param array  $_api_data Optional data to send with API calls.
 45: 		 * @return void
 46: 		 */
 47: 		public function __construct( $_api_url, $_plugin_file, $_api_data = null ) {
 48: 			$this->api_url  = trailingslashit( $_api_url );
 49: 			$this->api_data = urlencode_deep( $_api_data );
 50: 			$this->name     = plugin_basename( $_plugin_file );
 51: 			$this->slug     = basename( $_plugin_file, '.php' );
 52: 			$this->version  = $_api_data['version'];
 53: 			$this->hook();
 54: 		}
 55: 		private function hook() {
 56: 			add_filter(
 57: 				'pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins',
 58: 				array(
 59: 					$this,
 60: 					'pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins_filter',
 61: 				)
 62: 			);
 63: 			add_filter(
 64: 				'pre_set_transient_update_plugins',
 65: 				array(
 66: 					$this,
 67: 					'pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins_filter',
 68: 				)
 69: 			);
 70: 			add_filter( 'plugins_api', array( $this, 'plugins_api_filter' ), 10, 3 );
 71: 		}
 72: 		public function pre_set_site_transient_update_plugins_filter( $_transient_data ) {
 73: 			if ( empty( $_transient_data ) ) {
 74: 				return $_transient_data;
 75: 			}
 76: 			$to_send = array( 'slug' => $this->slug );
 77: 			$api_response = $this->api_request( $to_send );
 78: 			if ( false !== $api_response && is_object( $api_response ) && isset( $api_response->new_version ) ) {
 79: 				if ( version_compare( $this->version, $api_response->new_version, '<' ) ) {
 80: 					$_transient_data->response[ $this->name ] = $api_response;
 81: 				}
 82: 			}
 83: 			return $_transient_data;
 84: 		}
 85: 		public function plugins_api_filter( $_data, $_action = '', $_args = null ) {
 86: 			if ( ( 'plugin_information' !== $_action ) || ! isset( $_args->slug ) || ( $_args->slug !== $this->slug ) ) {
 87: 				return $_data;
 88: 			}
 89: 			$to_send      = array( 'slug' => $this->slug );
 90: 			$api_response = $this->api_request( $to_send );
 91: 			if ( false !== $api_response ) {
 92: 				$_data = $api_response;
 93: 			}
 94: 			return $_data;
 95: 		}
 96: 		private function api_request( $_data ) {
 97: 			if ( null !== self::$response_data ) {
 98: 				return self::$response_data;
 99: 			}
100: 			$data = is_array( $this->api_data ) ? array_merge( $this->api_data, $_data ) : $this->api_data;
101: 			if ( $data['slug'] !== $this->slug ) {
102: 				return;
103: 			}
104: 			if ( empty( $data['license'] ) ) {
105: 				return;
106: 			}
107: 			$api_params = array(
108: 				'edd_action' => 'get_version',
109: 				'license'    => $data['license'],
110: 				'name'       => $data['item_name'],
111: 				'slug'       => $this->slug,
112: 				'author'     => $data['author'],
113: 			);
114: 			$request    = wp_remote_post(
115: 				$this->api_url,
116: 				array(
117: 					'timeout'    => 15,
118: 					'sslverify'  => false,
119: 					'body'       => $api_params,
120: 					'user-agent' => 'WordPress/' . get_bloginfo( 'version' ) . '; ' . get_bloginfo( 'url' ) . ' Edwiser Bridge Pro Update Check',
121: 				)
122: 			);
123: 			if ( ! is_wp_error( $request ) ) {
124: 				$request = json_decode( wp_remote_retrieve_body( $request ) );
125: 				if ( $request && isset( $request->sections ) ) {
126: 					$request->sections = maybe_unserialize( $request->sections );
127: 				}
128: 				self::$response_data = $request;
129: 				return $request;
130: 			} else {
131: 				self::$response_data = false;
132: 				return false;
133: 			}
134: 		}
135: 	}
136: }
```
